description: Ultrabalaton 2026 will be held for the 20th time, Hungary's most popular community sports event. The race is a single lap around Lake Balaton, which is the longest running race in Central Europe, and can be completed individually or in teams of 2-6 people, either running or cycling. The distance is 209 kilometers, available for individual participants and teams of 2 to 6 members. The event has a friendly, community atmosphere and offers attractive programs for runners, supporters, and cyclists.
course_highlights: 209-kilometer single lap around Lake Balaton
Longest running race in Central Europe
Opportunity to participate individually or in teams of 2-6 members
additional: Race office address: 1134 Budapest, Tüzér utca 9-11, opening hours Monday and Tuesday 10:00-13:00. Support available for competitors through #PROJEKT418, refreshment points, and stage calculator in the StafetApp. There are also programs for supporters and cyclists. The registration deadline is September 27, 2025. The race will take place from April 23 to 26, 2026, with the start on April 25, 2026. Participants can pick up their race kits at the race center, and the lap time calculator is available in the StafetApp.

The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nocturnal sports experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting, in a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances of 4 km and 10 km
Night running in Cluj-Napoca
Urban route accessible for all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked routes, online registration options, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The 'Tsvetanka Hristova' tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria's greatest athletes. The competition is organized for the 17th time and includes the second round of the youth athletics series 'A1 Athletics for Youth'. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and gathers athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors the legacy of Tsvetanka Hristova and encourages the development of young talents.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the 'A1 Athletics for Youth' series
Memorial tournament in honor of Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Hristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 100 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition, held in the hilly and forested area of Fruška Gora near Novi Sad. The courses pass through natural beauty and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as through historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive routes are certified by ITRA and serve as qualifications for Ultra Trail Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive routes, there are nine recreational trails that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: Courses pass through 97% forested terrain of Fruška Gora
Passing through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro and Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climbing to the highest peak of Fruška Gora (539 m) and descending past the Dumbovački waterfall
additional: The competitive routes are ITRA certified and serve as qualifications for Ultra Trail Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different trails of various lengths and elevation differences, ranging from an ultra-extreme marathon of 134 km to recreational routes. The courses include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registration and communication. 14 routes of different lengths, certified by ITRA, including ultra and recreational distances, passing through medieval monasteries, natural and cultural landmarks.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Race is a challenging race through the pristine nature of the Gledić Mountains, featuring two courses that test runners' strength and endurance. The longer Prkos course is 17.5 km with 1000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter Zamah course is 8 km with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep ascents and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a rich start package and a surprise lunch.
course_highlights: Prkos Course: 17.5 km with 1000 m elevation gain
Zamah Course: 8 km with 450 m elevation gain
Highest point: Cerovi Peak 775 m, lowest 330 m
additional: Packet pickup is exclusively on race day from 08:00 to 09:45 at the start zone. Cut-off times are 5h30min for Prkos and 3h30min for Zamah. The start package includes a medal, dry fit t-shirt, race bib with chip, refreshments, professional photos, marked trail, aid stations, and a surprise lunch. Prizes are prepared for the best in the short course, especially for men and women. The event is scheduled for April 25, 2026, at Kragujevac / Adžine Livade. More information will be available on the organizer's Instagram page.

description: The Power Trail is a trail race in the beautiful nature of Adžini Livadi, designed for runners who want to push their limits and experience challenging terrain. The race consists of two routes: Prkos, 17.5 km with 1000 m ascent, and Zamah, 8 km with 450 m ascent. The course combines steep climbs and technical descents along water channels, requiring a secure footing, concentration, and courage. At the finish line, victory is not reserved for the fastest, but for those who conquer the course and its strength. The start is on April 25, 2026, in Adžini Livadi, beginning at 10:00 AM for the longer route and 10:30 AM for the shorter one.
course_highlights: Prkos route: 17.5 km with 1000 m ascent (±5%)
Zamah route: 8.0 km with 450 m ascent (±5%)
Technical descents along water channels requiring secure footing and concentration
additional: Each participant receives a starter pack with a race number and chip, a t-shirt, refreshments at control points and finish line, marked course, trek, and finisher medal. No additional registration is available after the registration list closes or on race day. Course lengths: 17.5 km and 8 km, up to 1000 m ascent, technical terrain, registration via the platform MyRace.rs, starter packs include t-shirts, medals, and marked courses.

The event gathers nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience through beautiful landscapes and demanding terrains. Organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transportation to the start and rich support during the race.

description: Jablanik Trail is an UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometers long with a total ascent of 1837 meters, offering a challenging and attractive terrain for runners. This trail provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through mountain landscapes. The race attracts experienced runners and trail running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly environment.
course_highlights: Distance: 34 km
Total ascent: 1837 meters
Mountain terrain in western Serbia
additional: Early registration offers discounts before March 25, 2026, and the race is part of a series of events promoting nature and outdoor activities in the region.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running race organized by the Municipality of Csepel as part of the Active Csepel series. The race starts at the beautiful Csepel Danube bank, from the György Kolonics Leisure Center, and offers four distances for movement: 3.5 km, 7 km, 400 m children's run, and a special race for people with disabilities. The goal of the race is to share the community experience and the joy of movement for all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Wearing a bib number is mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The race route runs along Kolonics promenade, on the Danube bank
Chip timing and absolute male and female podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances
The children's run route passes under the two-arched bridge, with parental supervision allowed
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are advised to use their own softcup, bottle, or cup. Medals are awarded to the youngest participants, while older runners receive a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish line. Starting with a stroller is only permitted at your own risk. The special race for people with disabilities is a joyful run where walking and strolling are also allowed. Multiple distances require registration, environmentally friendly chip timing, awards, family and special categories, route along the Danube, outdoor event, rain or sunshine.

Runners can register according to age groups and gender. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place in the scenic lakeside environment, providing both a challenge and an experience for participants. The start begins at 10:00 AM, and registration is open until 6:00 PM on April 23.

Scenic Tata Tópart promenade environment
Category and gender-specific race distances

description: The Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultramarathon race that continues until the last person is left. Participants complete a 6706-meter loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is organized as a age-group championship, where the best female and male runners are awarded in 11 age categories. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete up to 160 kilometers also receive recognition.
course_highlights: 6706-meter loop that must be completed every hour
Race until the last person, who finishes before the next start
Age-group championship in 11 categories for both women and men
additional: The race is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is organized as an age-group championship, awarding the best female and male runners in 11 categories. Entry fees can be paid by credit card or bank transfer, with an invoice sent in case of bank transfer. The Backyard MINI race includes 6 laps (40.236 km), where the fastest female and male runners are awarded gold medals. Participants can earn multiple medals and trophies. On-site registration is possible depending on available spots at a higher price. The race location is Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya, with detailed registration and prize information available on the official website. The event celebrates endurance and community, allowing runners to push their limits.

description: In Petrovaselo, in the vineyard, is a sporting event dedicated to trail running, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and to increase the number of outdoor runners. The event, organized by the Sports Club Association Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, offers three running races with varied distances, held on scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience in nature, with well-marked trails and refreshment points, in a friendly and organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, offered based on the race number.
course_highlights: Trail running routes through the vineyard, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route involves running twice the 14 km route, with the second loop in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at the direction change points
additional: Participants must arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. The start of the 14 km and 28 km races is at 09:00, and the 5 km race begins at 09:15. There is a time limit for finishing each race (5 km - 10:15, 14 km - 11:05, 28 km - 13:00). After the race, participants receive goulash and wine based on their race number. The routes may have muddy areas depending on weather conditions. Transfer between races is allowed before the start, subject to availability. Participants can register and check the participant list online; the event combines sport with the vineyard landscapes of Recaș.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run Bucharest is a non-timed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are colored with colored powder every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the end. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, on the route along Unirii Boulevard and surrounding areas, offering a festive experience accessible to all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, with special moments such as the cloud of colored powder and live music.
course_highlights: 5 km route along Unirii Boulevard and surrounding areas in Bucharest
Coloring points with powder every kilometer traveled
The colored powder cloud moment at the end, accompanied by music
additional: Kit pickup is available at Mega Mall Bucharest from April 18 to 24, with extended hours. The event begins with access to the event area at 12:00 PM, with successive starts between 2:00 PM and 2:20 PM, and the colored powder cloud occurs at 4:00 PM to 4:15 PM. Children aged 0-6 can participate for free without a kit, and multiple registrations are possible by adding participants in the form. The event is non-timed and open to all ages, including people with disabilities who benefit from free access. The route includes urban areas; registration includes medals and colored powder; the event features multiple waves of start and kit pickup points.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The Codrului Marathon, 5th edition, is an event organized by the Pro Racers Sports Club and the Romanian Cycling Federation, which will take place on April 25, 2026, at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition dedicated to both amateurs and professionals, with MTB and Trail Run disciplines on spectacular forest trails, offering challenges for all levels. The event features new and more challenging routes for the MTB disciplines, as well as hobby categories with short routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants benefit from a start package, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, pasta party, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, without the road section in the last 5 km
Varied Trail Run routes, from 6 km to 43.5 km, with significant climbs
Kids Race dedicated to children, with a 2 km route and 70 m elevation gain
additional: Participation fee includes a start package with race number and sponsor products, photos from the course, hydration points on the route and at the finish, medical emergency services and Salvamont, timing, finisher medal, and pasta party. The routes may undergo modifications until the race date. Routes for MTB and Trail Run, age categories, online registration, finisher medals, technical T-shirts, event for family and community.

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail running competition on a rugged course with moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by the Run For Freedom Sports Club together with the XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four different routes, suitable for various levels of runners. The start and finish are at the Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are well marked on forest roads. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Marked forest trail routes
Moderate elevation changes: 460 m for the half marathon, 230 m for cross, 20 m for mini
Start and finish at the Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through registration; the cost of the T-shirt is 100 lei, purchased separately. Participants under 18 must present a medical certificate and parental consent. Organizers may disqualify competitors who are intoxicated or without proper equipment. Registration is exclusively through the official webshop. Trail running routes in the forest, three different routes, organized by local sports clubs, first edition in spring 2022.

description: RotaRUN for Charity is a sports and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the Oncology Institute "Prof. dr. Ion Chiricuță" in Cluj-Napoca. The event on April 25, 2026, includes races of 3 km, 9 km, and a 2-hour run, offering participants the opportunity to run for a noble cause and contribute to creating a modern and welcoming environment for children with cancer. Participants receive a participation kit with a t-shirt, number, and timing chip, as well as access to hydration and food points. All funds collected from registration fees are directed towards completing the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department.
course_highlights: Running route along Promenada Someșului, Cluj-Napoca
3 km race (one lap of the circuit) and RotaRun 9 km (3 laps of the circuit)
Long Run - endurance race of 2 hours
additional: The size of the t-shirt is guaranteed for registrations until April 10, 2026; after this date, sizes will be allocated in the order of registration, subject to availability. Participants receive a race number and a timing chip, access to hydration and food points with sweet and salty foods, isotonic drinks, and supplements. The top 3 male and female finishers in each event will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age groups. The event also supports the purchase of modern furniture and medical equipment for the pediatric oncology department, serving as a fundraising and community awareness project.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: The Vinul Marathon powered by OMV Petrom is the first charity mountain bike race in Romania, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, amidst the hills, vineyards, and wineries of the area. Participants can choose from several routes tailored to their level, from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateurs and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The start for children (4 and 8 km) is at 09:00, for the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and for the Family walk at 10:45. Package pickup is available in Bucharest and on-site at specific times. Participants in the Tura Family do not receive a race kit and can go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, with a cut-off time of 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, as well as support for social and educational causes, promoting wine culture and local tourism.

name: RotaRun 2026

description: Asenovgrad Bairi is a competition and festival that combines sport and entertainment in the nature of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the nature and sights of the region. Organized by the Association "ASENOVGRADSKI BAIRI", the competition offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and levels of fitness. Participation requires good physical condition and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at sports and nature enthusiasts.

Opportunity to visit sights and evening entertainment between the days

The event is part of the federation's sports calendar for 2026 and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.

Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while having fun with music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social contacts.

The race passes through the historic nature of Takovo and a newly opened route, with many ascents and descents, offering both a challenge and enjoyment of natural beauty. Organizers invite runners to join and enjoy collective running, results, and socializing at the finish line. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher's medal, and the best are awarded cash prizes and trophies.

Route through historic nature of Takovo and a newly opened trail
Significant ascents and descents on the course

description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy Race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held at St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the maximum distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. It is possible to count a "hotel lap" when leaving and returning to the track at certain points. Consumption of alcohol, smoking, and drug use are prohibited within the camp and on the track. There is a minimum dress code for running and in the park, prohibiting running without upper clothing. Official results are published the next day around 9:00 AM on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Another evening trail running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, on a wooded and hilly terrain known as "Világlátó." Participants can choose to run or practice Nordic Walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, trying to complete as many laps as possible of 1.6 km with a elevation gain of +60 m. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, offering a pleasant atmosphere with music and a bar on site. It is an excellent opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural and friendly environment.
course_highlights: Wooded and hilly terrain known as "Világlátó"
Lap of 1.6 km with +60 m elevation gain
Challenge of 2, 4, or 6 hours with Nordic Walking option
additional: Sticks for Nordic Walking are available in limited numbers upon request via email. On site, there will be music and Wunderbar. Each participant receives a start pack with a race number and other promotional materials. The event is a combination of running and mental challenge, with the possibility to complete as many laps as possible within the chosen interval. Trail challenge with 1.6 km loops, options for running or Nordic walking, part of the Szent György Napok event.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, as well as a 1 km children's run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, emotions, and a charitable cause, with 40% of the entry fees donated to charity. The route is flat, suitable for all levels, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere with prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat route suitable for all levels
Passes along the Maritsa River and relaxation zones with water views
10 km route consists of 2 laps around the park
additional: Start packages can be collected in advance on May 1st from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. Races are on May 2nd: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and a 1 km children's run at 10:20. An award ceremony will take place at 11:40. 40% of the entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, and winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. There will be sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a raffle with prizes. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kozha Kaya is Bulgaria's first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kozha Kaya peak area. The race offers various distances with significant positive elevation gains and no support stations, making it a true test of endurance and skills. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset, enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. This is an event for adventure and mountain running enthusiasts, leaving a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4400 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
42 km marathon with over 2700 m positive elevation gain without support stations
30 km Sky with 1950 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
additional: All distances are with full autonomy, without support stations. There is an additional challenge - a speed ascent of Kozha Kaya 3.6 km with 500 m positive elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural environment rich in flora and fauna, offering breathtaking views and challenging terrains. The race is scheduled for May 1-2, 2026, with participants able to choose between different distances suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: MaritsaRun 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances - 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sports challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a good atmosphere with music, an audience, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children's run, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is possible online or on-site on the day of the event if there are available starting numbers. Late registration is possible after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and monetary and material prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on-site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children's run and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Overshoot Marathon will be held on May 3, 2026, at Lake Malomvölgy in Pécs. This running race, organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, has a friendly atmosphere and features a loop course that allows participants to complete marathon and half-marathon distances. The course is forested, compacted earth and crushed stone, with a 30-meter elevation change, offering varied terrain for competitors. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and refreshment stations provide abundant supplies.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course, with the marathon consisting of 8 laps
Forested, compacted earth and crushed stone paths, with 30 meters of elevation change
Combination of the lakeside walking trail and designated course
additional: Chip timing is on the back of the bib. Refreshment station at the start/finish line offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and salty biscuits, sandwiches, fruits, vegetables, and chocolate. Participant limit: maximum 250 people. T-shirt available for an additional 3,500 HUF, order by April 15. Time limits: 5.2 km - 50 minutes, 10.4 km - 1 hour 40 minutes, half-marathon - 3 hours, marathon - 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt pickup on race day between 7:00 and 7:45, with on-site registration also available. Multiple distances, forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, limited capacity (max 250), time limits and fees per distance, accommodation options nearby.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Dűlő and Cellar Run is a scenic trail running race in Gyöngyös along the Farkasmály vineyard row, taking place among vineyards and wine cellars. The race offers multiple distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer, 8.5 km loop with ascents. Runners can enjoy close contact with nature, cellar visits, and varied terrain suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Club, which has decades of experience in organizing sports events.
course_highlights: Dűlő-loop: 3000 m, 40 m elevation, 2 laps among the vineyards with cellar visits
Farkasmályi-loop: 8500 m, 190 m elevation, 4 laps with ascents and cellar visits
Relay race 4x1500 m and Spritz Run for teams of 3 with 800 m distance and spritz stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00, on-site registration closes a quarter of an hour before the start of each race. Parking is available on the grassy area next to Szilue Hotel. The race location coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30. Participants can look forward to awards and wine tasting.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts from Zalaegerszeg and ends in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. During the run, participants pass through beautiful Zala landscapes, with ten relay points, and the entire distance is tracked with chip timing. The event prominently supports premature babies, for whom a relay run is also part of the program. At the finish line, teams can arrive together to share the experience and success. The start and pasta party are held at the Zala Zone Vehicle Testing Track, and the run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km distance between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay and refreshment points at the Göcsej Village Museum
Route marked with small bear symbols and ribbons approximately every 200 meters
additional: Time measurement is done using a chip placed on the bib. The total time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. A pasta party will be held on May 2 at 17:00 at the Zala Zone Vehicle Testing Track. The route crosses two railway crossings, with participants passing through the first under escort by medical personnel. The relay run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00 from the Keszthely Castle Park to the Main Square. The event includes several related activities such as registration, race packet pickup, relay points, and finishing, with options for individual or team registration.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at the Olympic Square. The courses pass through mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners are awarded cash and material prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain from 420 m to 1640 m
Start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Start packages are distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at the Olympic Square. Participants under 16 years old can only participate in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and prizes for the top three places include cash and material awards. It is recommended to fill out participation declarations in advance. Payment at the moment is only via bank transfer. The distances include 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1640 m respectively; start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses are in mountain and forest terrains.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill and downhill for men and women, as well as for boys and girls under 20, under 18, and under 16, is held in Chepelare. The competition offers a challenging mountain terrain that tests the endurance and skills of the participants. This is an important sports event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional organization and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18, and 16
Held in the picturesque area of Chepelare
additional: For all inquiries, participants should contact the organizer directly at the provided email. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is officially supported. It is included in the national mountain running calendar and offers participation opportunities across various age groups.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together corporate participants and all interested individuals for a shared experience of movement, where individual and team spirit are both celebrated. Runners can choose from three distances: 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3x2.7 km), and a 2 km stadium walk. The event is accompanied by music, parties, and street food, ensuring an unforgettable experience for participants after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track of the National Athletics Centre
Three different distances: 5 km individual, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk
Running near the Danube, stadium experience, and lively party atmosphere
additional: Participants can pay by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account registration. Finishers receive a unique finisher medal. After the race, a lively party with music and street food awaits participants. In the 3-person relay, each runner completes approximately 2.7 km. The event also offers free e-training and charity opportunities. Distances: 5 km, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk. The event location is the National Athletics Centre, Budapest. Participation is possible through online and on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event scheduled for May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race welcomes not only corporate participants but also anyone interested in moving, competing, and having fun together. The event features three distances: a 5 km individual race, a relay race with three members (3x2.7 km), and a 2 km stadium walk. Participants receive a unique finisher medal at the finish line, and the atmosphere is enhanced with music, street food, and an evening party.
course_highlights: The iconic track of the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: 5 km individual, 3x2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walk
Unique location by the Danube River
additional: Online registration is only possible with a bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires BSI account registration. Finishers receive a unique finisher medal. The event features music, street food, and an evening party. Registration office contact details are available on the website. The event offers music, street food, and a festive atmosphere; the venue is the National Athletics Centre, where community programs also take place alongside the run.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Heidiushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete in climbing the iconic trail from the start to the large fountain near the Karanli Hotel, with various route options of different difficulty levels. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund, and results are officially recorded and published for each participant who completes the trail in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for mountain running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Climbing the iconic Heidiushka Path in Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with various variations - the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain near Karanli Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder's name is inscribed on a special plaque at the beginning of the trail. Participants with times under 1 hour have their results published on the Foundation "Stari Bryast" website. The event includes trail running with different routes and no categories or prizes, emphasizing personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 are held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6th, in honor of Haji Dimitar's birthday and Gergyovden - the Day of Bravery. The event is dedicated to the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, including games and competitions that they used to measure their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region's historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Oak Foundation, which works to preserve the cultural heritage and nature of Sliven.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park with alpine-type terrain
The course passes along ancient hajduk trails and near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
A place with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves, and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the traditional patriotic causes of the Old Oak Foundation, held in honor of historical figures and events related to the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Information Center of Sinite Kamani Nature Park; competitions include stone throwing and knife throwing; participants in folk costumes are encouraged.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging outdoor race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding trails and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race gathers trail running enthusiasts and adventure lovers, offering a unique experience through forest and mountain terrains. Organizers West Serbia Trails guarantee a top-notch atmosphere and good organization for all participants.
course_highlights: Trails through forest and mountain areas of Western Serbia
Difficult ascents and technical parts of the trail
Beautiful natural landscapes and untouched nature
additional: Organizer is West Serbia Trails, known for organizing the best trail parties in Western Serbia.

name: Pusztafutás 1 / 5 / 11
description: The Pusztafutás is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race held annually since 2016 in Solt Szőlőhegy. The race offers multiple distances for both children and adults, with a varied and exciting route that features hilly and interesting terrain rather than the usual flat plains of the puszta. Finishers receive a unique, connectable finisher medal, and on-site services include parking, a refreshment stand, and a playhouse. The goal of the event is to provide an experience for all age groups and to be a comprehensive event for runners.
course_highlights: Varied, exciting terrain on the western edge of Kiskunság
580-meter secured route with minimal elevation change
Start center at Szőlőhegy, next to Krammer Pince
additional: The race will only be held if at least 100 valid registrations are received by the end of the first registration period. A maximum of 400 runners can register, including up to 100 in the preschool and lower elementary categories. Accompanying parents cannot physically assist their child's run and do not need to register separately. Participants can choose to register without a medal at a lower price. On-site facilities include parking, restrooms, a playhouse, first aid station, and a refreshment stand. The race will not be held in 2026 due to insufficient registrations to meet the minimum required by the organizers.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail running race held at sunset around the Naszály Mountain. Participants receive a unique wooden finisher medal, and the top three male and female finishers in each distance will be awarded special prizes. The event offers plentiful refreshment stations, changing rooms, and baggage storage, with runners advised to use headlamps and hydration packs. The atmosphere of the race and the proximity to nature guarantee an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Running at sunset around Naszály Mountain
Unique wooden finisher medal for all distances
Abundant refreshments at aid stations and finish line
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. Headlamp use is mandatory, in working condition, charged. Mobile phones should be fully charged, turned on, and on loudspeaker. Hydration packs, bottles, or cups are required, as disposable cups will not be available at aid stations and the finish. Trail running event with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes, and gear recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
location: Naszály, Bocskai utca 1, Naszály, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail running race taking place at sunset in the picturesque surroundings of Naszály. Participants will receive a unique wooden finisher medal for each distance, and the top finishers will be awarded special medals. The event offers plentiful refreshment stations, changing rooms, and baggage storage. It is recommended to use a headlamp and hydration pack for safe completion. The atmosphere of the race and the proximity to nature guarantee an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Running at sunset in the natural environment of Naszály
Unique wooden finisher medal for all distances
Abundant refreshments at aid stations and finish line
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Special medals awarded to the top three male and female finishers in each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage available at the base. Headlamp usage is mandatory, in working condition and fully charged. Mobile phone must be charged, turned on, operational, and loud. Using a hydration pack, bottle, or cup is recommended, as disposable cups will not be available at aid stations and the finish. A personal ID or readable copy is required for registration. Trail running event offering plentiful provisions, safety equipment, and memorable experiences for participants.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race that takes participants through the unique landscape of Deliblatska Peščara, offering options between three distances: 5 km recreational, 12 km challenging, and 21 km trail half marathon. This event will be held on May 9, 2026, in Čardak and is intended for all nature and running enthusiasts, whether beginners or experienced runners. The course is carefully designed to provide an authentic trail running experience through nature with appropriate challenges and scenic beauty of the Peščara.
course_highlights: The course runs through the unique landscape of Deliblatska Peščara
Three distances: 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km trail half marathon
Aid stations with water, fruit, and other refreshments
additional: There will be one aid station on the course with water, fruit, peanuts, and sugar. Two fountains for additional hydration are located near the course. Registration is open until April 22, 2026; the event is aimed at trail running and nature lovers.

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
description: The SzalamandRUN running day is a race offering a variety of distances in Solymár, welcoming runners for 3, 5, 11, 21, and 42 km courses. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to challenge themselves on different distances. The race takes place in a natural environment, providing an enjoyable running experience for participants. The organizers offer professional timing and convenient registration options for entrants.
course_highlights: Natural environment running course around Solymár
Variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21, and 42 km
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided at the race. Registration is available on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment options are also accessible. Bib numbers are produced and safety pins are provided for participants. The race is held in multiple categories and distances, with opportunities for children’s races, and the organizers prioritize the athletes' experience.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: The Overtake the Cogwheel Railway! is a traditional sports event in District XII that will welcome runners, cyclists, and relay teams again in 2026. The goal of the race is for participants to reach the finish line before the Cogwheel Railway, while completing a roughly 4 km course with a 325-meter elevation gain in the Buda Hills. The race challenges athletes of all fitness levels and is also a great community program for families and colleagues. The event is organized by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Ltd. and Városmajor Swimming Pool.
course_highlights: Approximately 4.0 km distance
325 meters elevation gain
Scenic environment of the Buda Hills
additional: Participants can compete in running, cycling, and relay categories. Rules for bib number wearing and chip usage, as well as data management information and general terms and conditions, are available in the official documents. Athletes of all age groups, under and over 18, can participate, and results from previous years are accessible in the archive. The race is known for its extreme challenge, with awards, individual or relay options, and registration details available on the official website.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hajdú-Bihar County, Hungary
description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity running event scheduled for May 9, 2026, in Debrecen, at the Southern Industrial Park. The race aims to promote sports and physical activity, showcase the venue, and support the Foundation for Children with Leukemia, with all registration fees and donations doubled by Krones Hungary being donated. Participants can choose from multiple distances, and each finisher receives a unique medal. The event provides a MIZUNO event t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshment stations, and at the end of the race, Athletes Garden welcomes runners.
course_highlights: 10 km individual race, 4-lap course
Located within the Southern Industrial Park, where Krones Hungary was the first tenant
MIZUNO event t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments at refreshment points
additional: Registration is done via the StafétApp mobile application, which is available for free. The race kit pickup is also through StafétApp. Every runner finishing within the time limit receives a unique medal. At the end of the event, Athletes Garden provides on-site activities. Eco-friendly, Oeko race kits are used, and plastic usage is minimized. All registration fees are donated to charity, with online and on-site registration options available. The participation package includes a MIZUNO t-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Pest County, Hungary
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a family-friendly recreational trail running event organized by EDUSPORT Sports Association. The race takes place in Gödöllő, at Erzsébet Park, offering races for all ages, from children's runs to half marathons. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and community experience, with expert support and diverse programs. Participants receive a finishing pack, medal, and refreshments, and the day concludes with a colorful Color Run.
course_highlights: Trail running course in Gödöllő Erzsébet Park
Flat terrain, easy distances to complete
Children's and team runs for families
additional: Number pickup and on-site registration from 07:30, warm-up at 09:00, children's runs from 13:30, Color Run at 15:30. The registration fee includes timing, bib, finisher medal, finishing pack, and refreshments. There are changing rooms, restrooms, and baggage storage available at the event. Children's runs, team runs, Color Run, prize draw, online and on-site registration, detailed routes, refreshment points, commemorative medal, and finishing pack.

name: EDURACE
location: Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a diverse trail running race that will be held in 2026 in Gödöllő, at Erzsébet Park. The race offers multiple distances, from 500-meter kids' runs to half marathons, making it suitable for all ages and running experience. Alongside natural routes and a community atmosphere, participants will receive a unique finisher medal and enjoy a good mood. The event aims to appeal to families and sports enthusiasts alike and promote a healthy, active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Forest routes in Erzsébet Park with varied terrain
Elevation changes from 24 m to 340 m across different distances
Unique finisher medal and family-friendly programs at the finish line
additional: Number pickup on October 31st from 16:00, with free cloakroom and luggage storage provided. On-site registration is available in limited numbers, but advance online registration is recommended. Medical personnel will be available during the race, and participation is at your own risk. The event features various distances, family and children's runs, team competitions, pet-friendly runs, online and on-site registration, and post-race programs.

name: FUT A VÁROS
location: Fő tér, Szombathely, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Szombathely Running Race, called Run the City, will be held on May 9, 2026, in the heart of the city at Fő tér. The race offers running opportunities across multiple distances, so every age group and runner can find a suitable option: 400-meter children’s race, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km individual, as well as a 4×2.5 km relay. The event aims to promote sports and a healthy lifestyle, with participants receiving unique finisher medals and chip timing. The atmosphere of the race is family-friendly, taking place on routes through the city’s historic sites, with refreshment points and medical supervision provided.
course_highlights: Running through Szombathely's historic sites, including Fő tér, Fountain, and Sportliget
Partially or fully closed routes maintained throughout the race
Refreshment points at the finish line and chip timing
additional: The race uses chip timing, and each participant receives a unique finisher medal. Participants under 14 years old must submit a parental consent form for distances over 2 km. Race packets can be collected on-site from 7:30 AM. During the race, the use of mobile phones and other audio devices with headphones is prohibited. Chip timing and race packet pickup are available at the race center, with registration starting at 07:30, and different start times according to categories.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
location: Halassy Olivér Sportközpont, Budapest IV. kerület, Budapest, Hungary
organizer: Budapest Főváros IV. ker. Újpest Önkormányzata
description: The Újpest Half Marathon is a popular running event scheduled for May 9, 2026, at the Olivér Halassy Sports Center in Budapest District IV. The race offers options for individual and relay registrations, with distances of a quarter marathon and a half marathon. The event aims to promote sports and community experience in Újpest in a friendly and family-oriented atmosphere. During registration, participants can choose their T-shirt size, and organizers ensure smooth execution of the event.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Olivér Halassy Sports Center, one of Budapest's popular sports venues.
Distances include the 21 km half marathon and the 10.5 km quarter marathon, with relay categories also available.
The race provides refreshment stations, chip timing, and medals upon finishing.
additional: Registration is possible in individual and relay categories for the quarter marathon and half marathon distances. T-shirt size options are available during registration (XS-3XL). A maximum of 5 people can register at once in the individual category. It is mandatory to provide a contact person in case of an accident. Registration is only online, and the participation fee includes a race kit, T-shirt, sports drinks, refreshments, medal, and health insurance. The race route partly follows a creek embankment and partly runs on asphalt.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: The Schrödinger Deluxe Ultra 2026 is an off-road running race around Piliscsaba, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The race starts at Csemetekert at 8:00 AM. Runners will traverse diverse terrains, passing several notable locations and natural points in the Pilis Mountains. The race offers a unique experience for nature and challenge enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain in the Pilis Mountains
Passing numerous natural and local landmarks, such as Sas-szikla, Fehér-hegy, Saint-Gobain Lookout
Challenging elevation gains and forest sections
additional: The race starts at Csemetekert. Organizer contact: info@gulyakor.hu, +36 20 2992446. The race is part of the Gulyakör off-road family, which includes multiple distances and events. Registration is available online, but specific prices are not provided in the sources. Trail relay race, 35 checkpoints, unknown order, approximately 143 km, with specified registration deadlines and fees.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, Semimaraton, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Categoria de vârstă 14–17 ani beneficiază de taxă redusă: 150 lei pe toată perioada înscrierilor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fun Race – 125 lei / persoană, indiferent de vârstă

description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of the Goruna forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied routes, from Fun Race to Ultramarathon, test the endurance and perseverance of runners in a spectacular natural setting. The event gathers both amateurs and professionals in a friendly and motivating atmosphere, with start and finish at the 'Stejarul' Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and to experience the joy of running in nature.
course_highlights: Trails in the Goruna forest, with scenic wooded hills

The routes start and end in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with ascents and descents on stone roads, trail, and asphalt. Along the course, there are revitalization points with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Participation is open to all capable runners, with special conditions for minors under 18.

Steep ascents and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with a 170 m positive difference
Last kilometers on asphalt, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Participation confirmation is done on Saturday between 16:00 - 20:00 or on race day between 8:00 - 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. Technical meeting on Saturday 09.05.2026 between 19:00 - 19:30 and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 revitalization points along the route for the 16 km Cross and 1 point for the 8 km Eco Cross with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Registrations are only valid after payment of the fee, and changes or cancellations can only be made in writing until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not allowed to participate. The event is not timed, with an emphasis on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of colors applied every kilometer. The urban course starts and ends in Unirii Square, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple successive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the end. Participants receive a kit with a t-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

Application of colored powder every kilometer
Explosion of colored powder at the finish, accompanied by live music

Participants receive a participation kit with a t-shirt, race number, bandana, tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle; pets and vehicles are not allowed on the course.

Organizers provide GPX files for the routes to assist participants in their preparation.

Area "Kara Dere" with scenic views and natural beauty
Held within a folklore festival with a rich cultural program

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run along the rugged rocks of Bulgaria's northern coast, offering three distances - 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance and the beauty of the seaside landscape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. This is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km rugged coastal beauty with endless horizon
17 km through breathtaking cliffs and sea breeze
7 km fast and impressive kilometers along the coast
additional: Start packages are available in the cities of Varna and Shabla with a signed participation declaration. When collecting a start package for another participant, a signed declaration from them is required. Participants under 18 years old need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, waves, and the path, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from the partner Villa Daros. The event includes races of various distances, supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amidst the natural beauty of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual "Catcher Car," which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of registration fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot "Sun" in Borisova Gradina and join via the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular "Sun" area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of asphalt paths in the park
1.2 km of dirt and gravel trail, followed by 1.8 km of wide asphalt road
additional: The race is accessible for wheelchair participants. The virtual "Catcher Car" begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of registration fees and donations are directed to spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to participate and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or on-site, as the event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

Participants can choose between three distances - 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km, which pass through open terrains with diverse conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural environment.

The route is open, without shade, with diverse terrains
Held in the Plana mountain near Sofia

The race is held annually in May in the area of the village of Plana. Trail races, distances 5.5 km, 11 km, 16.5 km, taking place in the area of the village of Plana.

Includes a mass start of 800 meters for younger participants
Held in a scenic natural and urban environment

The event attracts both children and national competitors, providing opportunities for young talents and established athletes to showcase their skills. Participation is a demonstration of solidarity and hope for those in need.

Charitable support for the children of the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association through the Casa InimiiLor project

The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, providing an opportunity to support the children of the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association through participation and donations.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Sky Heights Race on Zlatibor represents the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Mountaineering Club Tornik from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer red course of 21 km with 1400 meters of elevation gain intended for seniors, and a shorter blue course of 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The courses pass through pristine nature of Zlatibor, crossing peaks such as Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering attractive and wild landscapes. The race gathers competitors from all over Serbia and abroad, and the scoring in the National Series is regulated by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA).
course_highlights: Two loop courses: 21 km with 1400 m elevation gain and 10 km with 500 m elevation gain
Courses pass over peaks Ljujaš (1269 m), Orlić (1235 m), Jelova Gora (1311 m), Bandera-Tornik (1496 m), and Liska (1346 m)
Race runs through untouched nature and lesser-known parts of Zlatibor
additional: The race base is at the elementary school in the village of Jablanica. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series with five rounds for seniors and three races for juniors. Participation requires a validated competition book from the Serbian Mountaineering Association (PSS) or a medical certificate. Senior scoring includes bonus points from the national championship and ultra trail races. The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain trails, and the race is part of a broader national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

name: Nebeski visovi 2026

This race is the first of the year within the national mountain running series organized by the Mountaineering Association of Serbia and is intended for athletes, recreational runners, and nature lovers. The race offers two circular routes starting and ending at the school in the center of Jablanica, passing through areas with spectacular views. Participants can choose between the red route of 21 km with 1400 m of cumulative ascent and the blue route of 10 km with 500 m of ascent.

Finish time limits are 4h30min for the red route and 3h for the blue route within the PSS, and 6h and 4h in open competition. Terrain conditions include mountain trails with significant ascents; registration on-site; categories for different age groups and team competition categories.

The routes are composed of approximately 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic outdoor running experience with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.
