The event includes an award ceremony for the timed races and sessions for warm-up and technical briefing before the start. Volunteers receive a volunteer kit and a volunteer contract in accordance with the law. The event features races for children and adults, non-timed and timed races, urban routes, online registration, participation kits, medals and diplomas for participants, and is organized in partnership with Lugoj City Hall and the European Drăgan University.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event gathers cycling enthusiasts from all over the country, providing an energetic and friendly atmosphere, ideal for opening the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km route through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, suitable for an accessible experience
Classic Bucharest - Snagov route
additional: Packet pickup is available on Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrains and diverse landscapes, making it a landmark event for mountain biking in Romania.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race takes place along historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, which the rebels traversed 150 years ago. The courses offer various levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. The event combines sport, nature, and history, commemorating the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses with different difficulty levels: 3 km with 75 m elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m elevation gain, 26 km with 1514 m elevation gain
Routes pass through historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: Organizers are the Apriltsi Municipality, the Association "Troyan in the Future," and the National Defense "Tradition" - 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with proceeds directed towards causes related to cancer fight and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event aims to combine sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different difficulty levels and suitable for both professionals and amateurs. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside city, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course passes through the beautiful Varna coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Varna coastline with sea views
The race takes place in the seaside city of Bulgaria
Atmosphere with support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late registration on-site is possible subject to availability at the information center operating from May 12 to 16, 2026. Bib numbers are only available on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square near the Varna Opera. The event also includes a 2 km city cross with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; registration online and on-site; event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: Plovdiv Friendship Marathon is a traditional event held on May 17, 2026, in the center of Plovdiv. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km, relay race, and Vidas Run Kids children's marathon. The routes are certified and pass through scenic parts of the city and Kyulak Park, combining sport with a charity cause to support medical students. Organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a rich program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turnaround points
Refreshment stations every 5-6 km and water points every 3 km along the route
The route passes through Kyulak Park and scenic parts of Plovdiv
additional: Start packages are distributed at the Children's Work Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed over on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and ambulance on the route. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIЗ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 years old and people with disabilities upon request with documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Route, registration, charity cause, children's marathon.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spici i Bodli 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held at the foot of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers various routes with different difficulty levels, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sports competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival with live music, summer cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hobby route is 37 km with a positive elevation of 1274 m, suitable for cyclists of all levels
Difficult route is 47 km with an elevation of 1781 m, including serious climbs and technical descents for advanced riders
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the course overlapping the Hobby route
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, refreshment points with food and drinks, medical team, as well as festival activities at the start-finish line such as live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children's race for kids up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start-finish line. It includes a children's race, tent camp, insurance, support points, and charity activities.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: Memorial athletic race Dragutin Tomašević is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in honor of the first Serbian Olympian. This 21st jubilee race gathers runners of all ages and categories, providing an opportunity for competition in men's and women's categories, as well as by age groups. Participants receive chip-timed start numbers and "Joma" Dry fit shirts, and the organizer provides transportation and a ceremonial dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Bistrica, Petrovac na Mlavi
Chip-timed personalized start number and "Joma" Dry fit sports shirt
Transportation from the registration center to the race start and a ceremonial dinner at Olimpik pools
additional: The participant package includes transportation from Belgrade (Arena) to Petrovac na Mlavi and back, with a guide. Limited to 50 competitors with early payments. Participants receive a 50% discount on a daily ticket to Banje Ždrelo. There are special accommodation benefits at Olimpik pool for race participants. The race is part of the annual events in honor of Dragutin Tomašević, with organization including timing, promotion, shirts, and medals for participants.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia that brings together runners of various skill levels through several routes of different lengths and difficulties. The races are held in beautiful natural areas of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, providing an unforgettable outdoor running experience. Notably, the Golija PREMIUM race starts at the top of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. Organizers provide start packages, refreshments, lunch, transportation, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through fantastic landscapes with viewpoints, clearings, and meadows
Race starts at altitudes from 800 to 1833 meters above sea level
Electronic timing and designated refreshment stations
additional: Free transportation from Ivanjica to the start of the Golija PREMIUM 29K race and back from Kovilje is provided. The ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race with overnight stay at a school in Kovilje, four meals, six refreshment stations, and campfire socializing. The first stage of ULTRA 66K starts at 11:00 AM, and the second at 09:00 AM the following day. The start package includes a bib number, finisher medal, refreshments, and lunch. More distances, a two-day event, a list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, start packages with medals and meals are available.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race held for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously in multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being twice listed in the Guinness Book of Records as the largest half marathon with a synchronized start worldwide. The race is open to everyone, with four available distances, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sports and outdoor activities. This year, we are running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, with the goal of becoming part of a new attempt to break the Guinness record for the first time in Serbia.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start in multiple countries and continents
Event with two Guinness records for the largest half marathon with a synchronized start
additional: Registration is at the Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište from 08:00 to 11:30 in a tent. The start package includes a bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, live results, and a PDF diploma. The race program includes warm-up at 12:45, start of the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races at 13:30, and the award ceremony at 15:30. The event features various race distances, is open to all ages, and start packages and medals are available for participants. It takes place in the center of Veliko Gradište, with registration in the morning and competitions in the afternoon.

name: LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a loving community event in Magyarpolány that focuses on the movement and rejuvenation of body and soul. Participants of all ages can take part in the running race, followed by a day filled with delicious foods and meditative programs such as labyrinth walking and gong sound baths. This event is not just a sport activity but a lively, breathing community celebration held in the embrace of nature. The event is organized by the Habitus Foundation and is part of the Polányi Pentecost series of events.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented running race for families and all age groups
Meditative labyrinth walk offering a unique inner experience
Gong sound bath for inner silence and rejuvenation
additional: The event is part of the Polányi Pentecost series. After the running race, participants can enjoy a communal picnic with delicious foods, including chili con carne and vegan salads. The program features a gong sound bath and meditative labyrinth walk, providing a special inner experience. Several special awards are given out, emphasizing the community aspect. The event includes running races, a family picnic, relaxation programs, refreshments, and spring water. Prior registration is required to participate.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon - relay race is a team event between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering a distance of 42.2 km divided into six sections for teams of 4-6 members. The route passes through picturesque towns, and runners complete the full distance by relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment points and goulash served at the finish line, while cultural programs add variety to the day. The race will be held on August 23, 2025, and registration is available online until August 20. After that, registration is only possible on-site if spots remain.
course_highlights: 42.2 km relay race in 6 sections, each 5-7.8 km long
Route passing through Salgótarján, Somoskoujfalu, Radzovce, Rátka, Trebeľovce, Hladký Majer, and Lučenec
Refreshment points approximately every 5 km, with goulash and cultural programs at the finish
additional: Relay teams consist of a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 6 members, with handovers at relay points. Participants can start from age 15. The entire route runs on the left side of the road alongside traffic, and traffic rules must be followed. The first 30 teams will receive medals, and the top three in each category will win cups. The course passes through multiple towns, with refreshment points every 5 km. Online registration is available, with on-site registration possible if spots remain. Cultural programs and concerts are held at the finish line.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometer trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna, including the famous "two spikes," which present a special challenge for runners. This race offers a unique finish line experience in Hungary, provided only by UTH. The event is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the Ultra-Trail Hungary atmosphere and trail running challenges.
course_highlights: 22-kilometer distance around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna
The dreaded elevation of the two spikes
Unique finish line experience in Hungary
additional: Registration was open until May 1, 2026, and submissions and distance changes could be handled on that day. The race is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary series, which offers multiple distances and events. The event is supported by various sponsors and media partners. The race location is Dömös, Szentfa-Kápolna; bus transfer is included in the registration fee; there is no water station at the start location.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail running race that starts from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and leads to the city center of Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging parts of the Visegrád Mountains, traversing varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail running enthusiasts alike. The event is traditionally of high quality and provides well-organized support along the course.
course_highlights: 30 km distance from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád to Szentendre
The most beautiful and difficult-to-traverse parts of the Visegrád Mountains
Varied terrain and natural environment
additional: Registration has closed as the maximum of 1600 participants has been reached. The race center and expo are located in Szentendre, at Áprily Lajos tér 3, in the Ferences Sports Hall. There is a luggage storage at the Reformed High School building. Among the supporters of the race are well-known brands such as Salomon, TUI, Leki, Petzl, Garmin, and Rudy Project. Information about other distances, registration, volunteer opportunities, supporters, and media partners is available.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania
price_range: 50 lei donație pentru acces la zonele Food & Drinks (pentru ediția Harvest) sau 120-150 RON pentru cursele de alergare
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The race combines running and cycling on scenic routes that pass through the Jidvei vineyard, offering participants spectacular landscapes and an authentic experience in nature. The event includes races for all levels of fitness, from children to adults, and offers recreational and oenogastronomic activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular landscapes in the Jidvei vineyard, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Participation kits are available for races of 42km, 21km, 10km, and 5km, as well as for children's races of 1km and 2km. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and oenogastronomic experiences are included in the event. Organizers prepare a world full of fun and creative workshops for children, in a safe and friendly setting. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races, and the event also features a grape harvest competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation differences and diverse obstacles designed to test both the physical endurance and willpower of participants. The event offers an initiation and reconnection experience with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with specific difficulties and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and struggle, and after the race, participants are invited to discover local culture and enjoy traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1060 m elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and kit pickup will be on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00, at the Dacian Village Domain. The routes include various obstacles such as fences, jumps over logs, rings, sandbags, log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, mud canal, wall crossing, and a surprise obstacle. There are prize categories by age and gender, with cash prizes for top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a difficult OCR. The event includes different distance categories and routes, open to both amateur and advanced runners.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, which will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes' Day and promoting mass sports activities. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half marathon race and other sporting events. The route starts from the Central Square and passes through the main streets of the city, organized under the patronage of Prince Radu and with the support of several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the regulations, register, and donate to support the cause.
course_highlights: Urban route with start and finish in the Central Square of Bistrița
Passes through the main streets of the city: Dornei Street, Șincai Street, Mihai Eminescu Street, Republic Boulevard, Barbu Șt. Delavrancea Street
Event dedicated to commemorating Heroes' Day and promoting mass sports
additional: Online registrations are validated until May 1, 2026; the event is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association - Bistrița Branch, under the High Patronage of Prince Radu; participants can obtain the official Invictus T-shirt and related merchandise; the event also includes other sporting events besides the half marathon; reading the regulations is recommended for details about equipment, timing, and prizes. Four different routes, simplified registration, donation required for the T-shirt, event for all ages, solidarity activities, and expressions of gratitude.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bukovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere under the stars. The event is organized to promote outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, involving the local community and supporting the education of underprivileged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from half marathon to children's races, enjoying an authentic nature experience with hydration points, hot meals, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly and environmentally responsible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Spectacular night routes through the forests and ridges of Bukovina
Hydration and feeding points along the course
Festival atmosphere with general access and hot meal at the finish
additional: Participants receive a personalized bib with timing chip, access to hydration and feeding points, a general access bracelet to the festival area, a hot meal at the finish, and cash prizes in age categories and OPEN. The festival offers accommodation options in camping sites or partner hotels and recommends traveling by train or bus to reduce environmental impact. Multiple race distances, festival atmosphere, prizes, real-time results, participant facilities, charitable purpose.

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the Mujdeni Lake area, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers diverse routes for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, catering to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked trails and significant elevation changes, set in a picturesque natural environment. Organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the competitive and friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon Route: 44 km with an elevation gain of 1180 m
MTB Race Route: 34 km with an elevation gain of 930 m
Trail Running Half Marathon: 25 km with an elevation gain of 990 m
additional: The routes have significant elevation differences, from 184 m for Fun Run (6 km) to 1180 m for MTB Marathon (44 km). Registration of minors requires written consent from parents or guardians. The organizer is Societatea Carpatină Ardeleană - Satu Mare. Phone contact: +40-743-419443. Participation is exclusively online, and the event includes various routes from 6 km to marathon, adapted for different levels of preparation.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultra-marathon race held in the 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a paved track of 1222.75 meters, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and amateur endurance runners, offering a transformative experience and a significant mental and physical challenge. Additionally, there are races of 50 and 100 km, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: Paved track of 1222.75 meters in 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park
The track is illuminated at night for runners' safety
Two hydration and refreshment points along the course, with water, glucose, electrolytes, fruits, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal equipment, food, and sleeping bags. The participation kit can be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except for relays. The event includes a briefing for runners and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved and illuminated route, with the possibility to participate in multiple distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous ascents and descents, all starting and ending at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as an UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior experience in mountain running for the longer races, and all finishers within the time limits receive a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Trails through narrow paths and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish at Bran Castle area
additional: Technical SportHG shirts available until May 1, 2026, later replaced with neckwarmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between control points. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail running experience, and registrations are made online, with limited spots.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race organized in Timisoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting injured soldiers. The event promotes the spirit of victory and national values through sport, being part of the Invictus Romania project. The 4th edition continues the tradition of bringing together runners and supporters in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support injured soldiers.
course_highlights: Symbolic routes in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
Event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition of over a decade
additional: The event is part of a larger project, Invictus Romania, which includes other sports competitions and activities to support injured soldiers. Official T-shirts of the Invictus Heroes Half Marathon are available for supporters. No details were found regarding start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timisoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalanga Marathon is a jubilee event that in 2026 marks its 10th anniversary. It takes place in Sinemorets village and offers mountain running distances of 42, 21, 13 km and 3 km for children, as well as mountain biking on 42 and 21 km. The routes pass through the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, combining sport, nature, and community. The event includes start packages, awards, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Strandzha Nature Park
Circular tracks with start and finish at Veleka Beach
Stations with fresh fruits, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running starts are on May 23 with checkpoint times for each distance. On May 24, mountain biking takes place with two distances. The starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). Food and drink stations are provided along the routes. MTB bikes without electric assistance are allowed for cycling. After the race, there is a party at the 'Kora' bar. Early reservation for accommodation is recommended, for example at Casa Domingo in Sinemorets. Running and cycling routes, on-site registration, anniversary edition, natural routes in Strandzha.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
description: Tibužde Trail is a nature race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, and provides participants with the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and natural beauty. The race starts in the morning at 7 AM and the event lasts until 5 PM, creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Nature terrain around the village of Tibužde
Two distances: 27 km and 7 km
Views and challenging terrain
additional: The race lasts from 7 AM to 5 PM. Terrain: mountain, registration: online, included categories: multiple, including a children's race, after the race organized gathering with lunch and music

name: 1. Tibužde Trail

The event starts in the morning and lasts throughout the day, providing participants with a unique outdoor running experience.

Shorter 7 km trail with 3000 meters of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
description: The Salomon Szentendre Trail is a 54-kilometer trail running race held in Szentendre and its surroundings, with an elevation gain of 1800 meters. Runners cross the Apátkúti stream twelve times and pass through beautiful landscapes, including Visegrád and the Calvary. The finish line is located in Szentendre's main square and on the Duna promenade, where tourists applaud the finishers. This race offers a unique experience by combining nature and urban environment.
course_highlights: 54 km distance, 1800 meters elevation gain
Twelve crossings of the Apátkúti stream
Beautiful views in Visegrád and at the Calvary
additional: 54 km, 1800 meters elevation gain, trail, registration, volunteer opportunities, multiple distances (30k, 42k, 84k, 111k) available

description: The Salomon Szentlászló Trail is an exciting trail running race in Szentendre, offering the steepest ascents of the Visegrád Mountains. The race starts at dawn, and participants run across the misty Sikárosi Meadow, where the cuckoo greets them. Before reaching the finish line, tourists applaud the runners along the promenade and in the Main Square. This challenge provides an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail running enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: The steepest ascents of the Visegrád Mountains
Crossing the misty Sikárosi Meadow
Finish at Szentendre Main Square, where tourists applaud
additional: Registration was open until noon on May 1, 2026, with the number of entries reaching the maximum of 1600. The race begins at dawn, when the bell strikes two. During the race, runners move through natural environments and varied terrain, with the finish expected before 7 PM. Multiple distances (54K, 84K, 30K, 22K, 42K, 111K), diverse terrain, registration options, start at 14:00, multiple sponsors, and categories.

description: Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary's most prestigious trail running race, consisting of six separate distances with approximately 1500 trail runners participating. The race takes place on varied terrain through dense and dark forests, challenging participants with significant elevation gains. The longest distance is 111 km with 4200 meters of elevation gain, featuring 9 refreshment points and 2 depot points, and a 20-hour time limit. The event location is Szentendre, with start and finish at Lázár Cár Square. A detailed map and information center are available for runners and their companions to ensure smooth organization.

9 refreshment points and 2 depot points on the longest route
Dense and dark forests, varied terrain

description: Children's Run 2026 is a competition dedicated to children aged 0 to 14 years, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers age-appropriate races, from Baby Run for those under 4 years old, to competitive timed races for older groups. It is an energetic event filled with joy and parental support, where every child is encouraged to participate and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Route in Central Park in Baia Mare
Races adapted for age groups from 0 to 14 years
Non-competitive Baby Run with medals and prizes for all participants
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 250, with 20 spots available for the Baby Run. Children's participation is only with parental consent. Prizes are awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places in timed races by age category, while the Baby Run is non-competitive with medals and prizes for all participants. The event includes medical assistance, medals, prizes, and surprises for children, with registration open until May 16, 2026.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event taking place in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude routes. The event includes five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and ending near Bran Castle, known as Dracula's Castle. The routes offer a combination of narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for mountain enthusiasts. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with narrow trails and ancient forests
Crossing mountain plateaus and exposed ridges in the Bucegi Mountains
Start and finish near Bran Castle, an iconic symbol
additional: To register, prior mountain trail experience is required, with different requirements depending on the distance. After May 1, 2026, SportHG technical T-shirts will be replaced with neck gaiters. Places are limited, and registrations are confirmed after online payment and verification of previous experience. The event also includes other mountain races, such as skyrace and half marathon, and offers prizes and mementos for finishers.

name: SH4H Concursul internaţional de alergare de anduranţă
location: Parcul Copiilor “Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: The S24H international endurance running competition is an ultramarathon race held in the 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara, on a lit and paved loop of 1222.75 meters. Participants can choose from 6, 12, or 24-hour events, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time. The event is open to both professional and amateur runners, offering a transformative experience and the opportunity to test their physical and mental limits. Organization standards are high, with international recognition and dedicated facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Loop course of 1222.75 meters, paved and illuminated at night
Events of 6, 12, and 24 hours, plus 50 km and 100 km races
Location in 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara
additional: The course is measured and homologated by IAAF, with individual distance monitoring and chip timing. Participants receive a race kit, finisher medal, access to the pasta party, hydration and feeding points, equipment storage area, free photos, recovery massage, and emergency medical services. The event also includes a technical briefing and pasta party the evening before the race. Paved route, night lighting, multiple events of duration and distance, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
location: Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu, Balatonfüred, Veszprém County, Hungary

description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultramarathon race held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The race is divided into multiple durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12, and 6-hour races, which are part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can compete in individual and team categories, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race center.
course_highlights: 898-meter loop course with minimal, 1-meter elevation gain
Race center located on the east side of Füred Camping
Central refreshment table with water, hot tea, isotonic drinks, soda, and coffee
additional: The race is divided into multiple durations: the 72H World Cup and 48H European Cup start on 2026-05-28 at 12:00, the 24H European Cup starts on 2026-05-30 at 12:00, the 12H European Cup starts on 2026-05-30 at 08:00, and the 6H European Cup starts on 2026-05-31 at 06:00. The opening ceremony and technical briefing will be held on 2026-05-27 from 17:00 to 18:30. Bib pickup is available at multiple times before and during the race. Accommodation and parking can be reserved from 2026-05-27 12:00 to 2026-05-28 10:00, with vehicle movement restricted during the event. Prizes are awarded in age and gender categories, as well as team competitions. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The race takes place at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred from May 28 to 31, 2026. Participants can choose different distances, and organizers provide the necessary infrastructure and services for runners.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a 3-day fully supported ultramarathon taking place on scenic mountain trails in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km through mountain paths, mineral water streams, and villages with a rich culture, suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun, and Fun Run to offer varied options for participants. After the race, participants are invited to an award ceremony and a traditional celebration with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognized, offering iTRA points and being voted among the top 50 ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: 100 km route on mountain trails, mineral water streams, and traditional villages
Spectacular landscapes with green meadows and authentic sounds of bells and flowing waters
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: Jacket/hoodie are included only for registrations made before May 1, 2026. The event offers 3 iTRA points for finishers. After the race, there is an award ceremony and a celebration with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese, and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers, and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race, and the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, offers iTRA points, and has international participation.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: The Brașov Marathon is one of the largest mountain running events in Romania, held in the heart of the Carpathians around the city of Brașov. The routes include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultramarathon, passing through the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs, offering stunning views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in the Council Square, passes by historical and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, providing ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes through the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in the Council Square, passing by the Black Church and Weaver's Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding areas
additional: Kit pickup is done in the Council Square with a schedule specific to each race. The Ultramarathon starts at 08:00, and the Half Marathon begins in two waves. Mandatory equipment checks are required for the Ultramarathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start zone offers revitalization between 10:30 and 23:00. The event features races for children and people with special abilities, dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that stretches across Mokra Gora Mountain, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo*, and Serbia. This trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the pristine nature of the Balkans. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, aiming to promote cross-border tourism and preserve the natural beauty of the region. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions that provide exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail stretches across Mokra Gora Mountain, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo*, and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for untouched nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata segments offer adventurous opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the cross-border Via Dinarica project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No price or registration details are provided for a race, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail, not a competition. The organizing contact is the Regional Cooperation Council based in Sarajevo. The event is related to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping, and signage installation, with the goal of promoting sustainable tourism and regional cooperation.

Various cycling trails and terrains

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: Hiking event Devica - Ozren, organized by PSK Pobeda, guides participants to ascend Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost Balkan mountains. The trail passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations with numerous caves, including the ascent to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, ending with a forest trail towards Ozren and the Ripaljka waterfall. The event is a one-day activity, departing from Belgrade early in the morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a valid hiking card from the Serbian Hiking Association for 2026 and appropriate hiking gear.
course_highlights: Ascent to Mount Devica with lush vegetation and limestone formations
Visit to the Marko Polo cave and ascent to Soko Grad
Golem Kamen viewpoint and forest trail to Ozren and Ripaljka waterfall
additional: Departure from Nebojsina Street at 06:00. Planned return to Belgrade around 22:00-22:30. Participants must bring a jacket, a thin cap, light gloves, a raincoat, sturdy shoes, gaiters, trekking poles, spare clothing, a flashlight, personal first aid kit, energy chocolates or nuts, magnesium for muscles, and at least 1.5-2 liters of water. There is no water on part of the trail. Organized lunch after the ascent or participants can bring food in their backpacks. Participants must have a valid hiking card for 2026. Equipment should include a jacket, cap, gloves, sturdy shoes, trekking poles, flashlight, first aid kit, food, and water.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The "Yordanka Arizanova" Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who created hundreds of excellent athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes disciplines such as 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, where the coach achieved her greatest successes. The event attracts both young and established athletes who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Competitions at Plovdiv Stadium
Disciplines: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditional participation of top sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes heats for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. Winners are awarded by Yordanka Arizanova's daughter - Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is held annually at Plovdiv Stadium and features disciplines such as 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards for the winners.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra is mountain running that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced, and experts, including ultra-long routes with stunning views and challenges. The unique night run Night Trail 6K and the children's race DECATHLON Kids Run complete the program, turning the event into a true celebration of sports spirit and love for nature. Organized by DECATHLON Plovdiv, the race promises impeccable organization and unforgettable experiences in the beautiful area of Shiroka Laka, Smolyan.
course_highlights: 95K ultra-long distance with challenging and scenic routes
Night run Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for 12K and 20K distances
additional: Every month DECATHLON distributes prizes through a raffle for registered participants. The event includes distances for all ages from 6K night run to 95K ultra. Organizer is DECATHLON Plovdiv with excellent organization rating. Routes for different distances, mountain running, registration for raffle, children's race

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: Vuk Karadžić's paths is a circular race of 25 km with a total ascent of 1000 meters. The course runs from Vuk's memorial house through the shade of centuries-old Monastery forests, past forest streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Trinoša Monastery, then across Small Tronoša and Lisine to Zajača, from where the Monastery candles trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin konak ethnographic complex, then back to Tršić and Vuk's house where the finish line is. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and cultural-historical landmarks of the region.
course_highlights: Circular course of 25 km with 1000 m total ascent
Passing through centuries-old Monastery forests and past forest streams and waterfalls
Visit to the 13th-century Trinoša Monastery and the Miličin konak ethnographic complex
additional: Trail race emphasizing nature and cultural heritage, participation is part of an international competition, and the race is intended for a wide range of runners.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica cross-country race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, attracting runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy years old. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children's races with about forty participants. This event promotes the tradition of sports, camaraderie, and spending time in nature, and organizers invite everyone to participate and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the sports tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Main race of 6.4 km in nature
Children's races with around 40 participants
Race in the natural environment of Mali Stapar
additional: Participants ranged in age from elementary school children to competitors over 70 years old. The race is part of the region's sports tradition and a prelude to larger sporting events like the Friendship Race in Kula. It takes place in a natural setting, focusing on promoting healthy living and sports camaraderie, with participation from various age groups.

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
location: Károlyi kastély és kert, Füzérradvány, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The V. Castle Loop Flow Running Race is a family-friendly recreational event held in the scenic surroundings of the Károlyi Castle and its garden, within the protected Natura 2000 area in Füzérradvány. The race offers various distances suitable for all ages, including 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km adult loops, as well as shorter distances for children. Runners will pass through the famous avenues of the castle garden and are allowed to run with dogs under specific rules. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, and participants have access to numerous amenities such as baggage storage, a changing tent, and restrooms.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with approximately 120 m elevation gain
80% gravel promenade, 20% forest dirt path
Running in the English garden of the Natura 2000 protected Károlyi Castle
additional: Running with dogs is permitted but only on a leash or secured harness, with veterinary health book verification. Participants running with dogs start after the main field, and their time does not count towards the results. Female and male podium finishers are awarded trophies in each age group, with special awards for the youngest, oldest, and dog runners. Instant online results and finish videos are provided. Parking is available in designated areas around the castle, with baggage storage, a changing tent, and restrooms on site. The race takes place within the Natura 2000 area, with parking permitted in the castle garden's designated zones. The event supports environmental protection and the local community.

description: The Zsámbék Run is a family-friendly race offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21.2 km). The course runs through the towns of Zsámbék and Tök, on asphalt and gravel roads, with the second half of the half marathon being trail running around the Nyakas Hill. The varied route features beautiful views and multiple refreshment stations. The event aims to allow everyone to find a suitable distance while enjoying the natural beauty of the Zsámbék Basin.
course_highlights: Varied route on asphalt, gravel, and forest trails
5 refreshment stations on the half marathon, 3 on the 10 km
Beautiful views from Nyakas Hill and the Zsámbék Basin
additional: Start times are staggered, but due to a common section at the beginning of the course, faster runners may catch up with slower ones. Chip timing and a personalized finisher medal are provided. The registration fee includes a bib number, medical services, and a finisher gift. The race is limited to 550 participants. Cancellations, transfers, and distance modifications can be made via email within specified deadlines. The course runs entirely on solid surfaces, with short cobblestone and gravel sections. Multiple refreshment points offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and biscuits. The race will take place on May 31 at the Piactér in Zsámbék, with the main goal of promoting sports and tourism among participants.

name: KASTÉLYKÖR FLOW
organizer: Laktát Sport Team és Kállai Krisztina
description: The V. Kastélykör Flow is a charming running event in Füzérradvány, around the Károlyi Castle. The race combines the enjoyment of nature and the historic environment of the castle, making it an ideal choice for both hobby and experienced runners. The event is organized by Laktát Sport Team and Krisztina Kállai, who warmly welcome participants on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Running in the beautiful park of Károlyi Castle and its surroundings
Natural, varied terrain
Cultural and historical environment
additional: The race takes place at Károlyi Castle, registration is required to participate, and detailed information is available on the Facebook event page.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in Zhelava village, Sofia. This is a challenging run that attracts mountain running enthusiasts and nature lovers. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and diverse terrain around Sofia. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with diverse ascents and descents
Beautiful natural views around Zhelava village
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria, aimed at both amateurs and professionals wishing to test their strength in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking race in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelava. The race offers three main routes with varying lengths and positive elevation gain, suitable for different categories of competitors, including hobby and electric bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrains, including the famous Zhelava Trail, which is popular among cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic - 62 km with 2505 m positive elevation gain
Murgash Classic - 40 km with 1348 m positive elevation gain
Zhelava Trail - iconic section with 9.9 km ascent
additional: The race includes categories for juniors and girls in various age groups, as well as a category for electric bicycles with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes with different lengths and elevation gains, suitable for various levels of preparation, including E-bike category.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
price_range: 8.000 dinara po timu (1.600 dinara po članu)
description: Charity IT race "Relay with Heart" will be held on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. This event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity for socializing, active living, and contributing to the community in the beautiful setting of the fortress.
course_highlights: Race takes place at the historic Niš Fortress
Atmosphere of charity and community spirit
Connecting the IT community through sport
additional: Registrations are open, and all proceeds will be donated to Nurdor to improve housing facilities for parents of children with cancer. The event also includes musical socializing after the race in the garden of the Mountain House.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling and running competition held in the spectacular landscape of the Măcin Mountains. The routes offer a variety of difficulties, from technical and challenging trails for experienced cyclists to more accessible routes for amateurs. The event emphasizes safety, fair play, and fun, making it suitable for outdoor sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sporting challenges. Registrations are done online, and the organizers ensure a well-organized and friendly experience.
course_highlights: The long route of 54 km with 1700 m elevation gain, technical and difficult, with spectacular ascents and descents
The short route of 32 km with 600 m elevation gain, easy-medium technical, with approximately 6 km ascent and a long 9 km descent
The half marathon trail of 23 km, technical and difficult, and the cross trail of 12 km, easy-medium technical, suitable for trail runners
additional: Registrations are exclusively online from March 1 to June 4, 2026. Participants under 18 must present a signed declaration from parents or guardians. The routes are unartificially maintained and offer various technical and physical challenges. Registration confirmation is done after payment of the fee, which can be made by card or bank transfer. Organizers recommend respecting safety and fair play rules on the trail. Participants must have mandatory equipment such as a well-maintained bicycle and a protective helmet. Registrations are online, with the registration period from March 1 to June 4, 2026. The event includes categories for different age groups and teams, as well as a race for companies.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of the first Serbian Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes place on the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his bravery and perseverance, and the goal is to pay tribute to his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. There are three trails available: the fast and shorter Vihor trail, the more challenging Rudnik trail with steep ascents and descents, and the recreational Domaćinska trail for those who want to enjoy nature without competition. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and unity.
course_highlights: Vihor trail runs above Stragar with views of Bukulja, Kosmaj, Avala, and Ramačke visove
Rudnik trail passes through real trail paths and forest roads with steep ascents and descents
On the Vihor trail, there are 2 refreshment stations with food and drinks, and on the Rudnik trail, there are 4 refreshment stations
additional: Domaćinska trail is a recreational type intended for those who do not want competition, and the race is held on June 6. The race is organized by the Association "Dušan Milošević - the first Serbian Olympian" as a tribute to his bravery and history. Three trails: 5 km domestic (recreational), start and finish in Stragar, organized support, safe conditions, sports and recreational character.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: Fruška Gora Run 2026 is a traditional sports competition and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The races include various trails, such as an ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon, and preparatory trails, with different levels of difficulty and distances. The event gathers runners from the country and abroad, offering challenges on the old trails of Fruška Gora and an opportunity to enjoy nature and the sporting spirit. Organizers provide organized transportation to the start, as well as rich support during the event.
course_highlights: Ultra-extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Preparatory trails with 1-2 ITRA points
additional: Organized transportation to the marathon start from Novi Sad at 6 AM on Saturday. On-site registration is possible on Saturday at Popovica for FUN trails. Start packages are collected before the race. The event is supported by numerous sponsors and sponsors. The event includes various sports challenges and activities in nature, with participation opportunities for recreationalists and competitors, with registration details and programs to be available soon.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elites and juniors in both men's and women's categories. It is held in front of the Ceptor hotel in the beautiful setting of Andrevlje and lasts four days, providing a top-notch atmosphere and intense competition. Competitors can expect electronic timing, complete trail marking, and a rich competition package with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the trail. This event combines sporting passion and the natural beauty of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trail with complete marking and GPS navigation
Refreshment zones on the trail and at the finish line
Electronic timing and start number with chip
additional: The competition package includes a start number with a chip, electronic timing, official race T-shirt for registrations until 15.03.2026., finisher medal, engagement of OTIS team on the field, 3 professional photographers with free photos, GPS track download, and online results. The race limit is 3 hours. Package pickup is from 09:00 to 11:30, and the winners are announced at 15:00. Participation includes electronic timing, bike washing, medical support, and parking; open registration; the event lasts four days with various races.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
location: Győr, Rónay Jácint u., Győr-Moson-Sopron, Hungary
description: The 24th Büchl Night Running Race will be held on June 6, 2026, in Győr, at the Tulipános Elementary School. The race offers options for multiple distances, including a children's run, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km individual runs, a 3-person relay for the half marathon, and 7 km Nordic Walking. The race provides a unique finisher medal, chip timing, refreshments, and medical assistance. The courses are well marked and secured with police presence. The start package is available for longer distances, and registration is finalized through prior registration and bank transfer.
course_highlights: Well marked route with guides and police security
7 km distance on a route through Sziget, Downtown, and Révfalva
14 and 21 km distances consisting of 2 or 3 laps on a designated course
additional: Registration becomes final upon bank transfer of the registration fee. On race day, pre-registered participants can pick up their bibs at two times: June 5, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 and June 6, 2026, from 9:00 to 12:00 at Dózsa György promenade 51. For on-site registrations, the unique finisher medal for this year's race is not guaranteed; only medals from previous years will be available while supplies last. The registration fee is non-refundable, but 50% of the paid amount can be credited towards a future race registration upon prior agreement. The race offers awards, race pack pickup, security services, and options for registration transfer and modification. Necessary equipment and support are provided on-site.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
location: Bisinger József park, Győr, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional night running race in Győr, offering multiple distances for running enthusiasts, including a kids' run, individual distances, and relay races. The race is centered at Tulipános Elementary School and is well-organized, featuring chip timing, refreshment stations, medical support, and police security. Participants receive a unique finisher medal, and race kits are provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The aim of the race is to provide an enjoyable and safe running experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.3 km kids' run, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km individual races
3-person half marathon relay and 7 km Nordic Walking distance
Marked route with guides and police security
additional: Pre-race number pickup is available on two dates: the day before the race and on race day. Unique finisher medals are for pre-registrants, with chip timing, downloadable certificates, refreshment stations, and medical support. After paying the registration fee, the registration is final; no refunds are available, but 50% of the fee can be credited towards a future race with prior arrangement. The race features chip timing, finisher medals, refreshment options, marked routes with guides, and medical support. Pre-registration is recommended.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
location: Majális park, Miskolc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary
description: The Bükk Mountain Marathon - Ádám Kisgyörgy Memorial Race is Hungary's oldest mountain trail marathon, scheduled to take place on June 6, 2026, in Miskolc, Majális Park. The race offers various distances, from a marathon to a mini-marathon, so everyone can find an ideal challenge. Runners compete amidst the natural beauty of the picturesque Bükk Mountains, while the race progress can be continuously followed at the 'forest stadium' at the race center. The event aims to foster sports friendships, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural values of Bükk.
course_highlights: Variable quality forest roads and asphalt sections in the Bükk Mountains
330 meters of elevation gain per lap on the 10.6 km course
Participants return to the forest stadium after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race continuously
additional: The race center is located at Miskolc, Majális Park-Királyasztal, where relay team members start their journey from the forest stadium. The course is almost entirely on variable quality forest paths, with a marathon time limit of 6 hours. The mini-marathon distance can be completed by running or hiking. Participants return to the race center after each lap, enabling spectators to follow the race continuously. Mountain trail race with multiple distances, suitable for amateur and professional athletes, set in a natural environment.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő, Cegléd, Pest County, Hungary
description: The 5th Cegléd Spa Running Festival will be held on June 6, 2026, at the Cegléd Spa and Leisure Center. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and introduce the joy of running to all age groups. Participants can choose from several distances, from a 300-meter toddle for the youngest to a half marathon and relay races. Runners can enjoy the view of the beautiful lake and the spa while running on a track similar to a tartan surface. Programs, awards, and entry to the spa associated with the race further enhance the experience.
course_highlights: The course runs within the Cegléd Spa and Aquapark area on a tartan-like running track
Multiple laps around the lake, allowing six opportunities to admire the spa's beauty
Music points and various styles of sound enrich the running experience
additional: On race day, the 300 m toddle and 800 m kids' run start at 8:20 AM, the 2 km fun run and walk at 8:40 AM, and the other distances (from 3.5 km to 28 km, including relays) at 9:30 AM. The half marathon and 28 km distance have a time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes. Participants receive changing, shower, and key locker facilities at the beach changing rooms. Finishers get a race pack and medal, as well as a ticket to the Cegléd Spa on race day. Registration fees are non-refundable in case of cancellation and depend on the payment time. Payment by card and bank transfer are available. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with wellness and leisure programs. Organizers pay special attention to ensuring everyone has a good time and can spend the day actively.

name: Crazy5K
location: Budaörsi Repülőtér, Budaörs, Pest County, Hungary
description: The CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle course race featuring 10 large inflatable obstacles. The race focuses on fun rather than performance, making it an unforgettable day to enjoy with friends, family, or colleagues. A special family race is also available, specifically for families with children under 10 years old, with surprises prepared for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is also available. The registration fee includes a bib number, a T-shirt, a finish pack, a custom medal, refreshments, access to the changing rooms, and medical supervision.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with 10 giant inflatable obstacles
Entertainment and playful challenges alongside the race
Family race for children under 10, with surprises
additional: The registration fee includes a bib number, a T-shirt (to be picked up on site), a finish pack, a custom finisher's medal, a refreshment station, free use of changing rooms, medical supervision, as well as access to women's and men's changing rooms. Parking is available on site at a cost of 1000 HUF per car. Obstacles can be bypassed, but for safety reasons, it is recommended to do so in a wide arc. Group registration discounts are available: 10% for 10-19 participants, and 15% for over 20 participants, applicable only to runners starting in the same time slot. Registration can be transferred for a fee of 2000 HUF per person, and on-site transfers are possible depending on availability. Inflatable obstacles, family race, entertainment, registration options.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea on June 6, 2026, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with revitalization points including still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruits, and energy bars. Participants receive a start package with a personalized technical T-shirt, race number, and electronic chip for time recording. Medical assistance is provided along the route through ambulances and specialized personnel. Kit pickup is scheduled for Friday, June 5, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Revitalization points with drinks and energizing snacks
Medical assistance with ambulances and specialized personnel along the route
additional: Kit pickup is scheduled for Friday, June 5, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The start package includes a personalized official technical T-shirt, race number, and electronic chip for time recording. Medical assistance is provided through specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the route. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and an identity card or passport. The registration fee is non-refundable in case of withdrawal but can be transferred until May 16, 2026. The event will take place on June 6, 2026, offering participants kits, hydration points, and medical support.

name: msg Maraton Apuseni
organizer: Clubul Alpin Român Filiala Cluj și msg Maraton Apuseni
description: .msg The Apuseni Marathon is an iconic mountain running event held in the picturesque landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains, in the Buscat Resort area, Cluj County. The race offers five varied routes, from ultramarathon and marathon to half marathon, cross country, and a family race dedicated to children and parents. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, crossing dense forests, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages, in a friendly and festive atmosphere. The event is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club Cluj Branch and will celebrate its 15th edition in 2026, promising sporting challenges and social moments in the mountain rhythm.
course_highlights: Technical routes with significant elevation differences: ultramarathon +3100 m, marathon +2531 m, half marathon +1110 m
Varied landscapes: dense forests, spectacular ridges, alpine meadows, and traditional villages
Festival atmosphere with activities for all ages, including family races and related events
additional: The ultramarathon starts at 05:00. Technical briefings are held for each event on race day. The Family race has staggered starts for different age categories at 12:30 and 13:00. The event includes activities for children, family yoga, a party, and an awards ceremony. The organizer recommends booking accommodation and transportation in advance. Routes for all preferences, mountain adventure event, promotion of nature and local traditions, volunteer activities, and a social cause for reforestation.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation differences, designed to test the physical and mental limits of participants. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, and careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can enjoy reconnecting with nature and the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation differences for each distance
Marked routes and well-prepared refreshment points
additional: Pickup of participation kits is on Friday, 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00 for BBB Ultra 60, with mandatory equipment check and only for staff. For the other distances, kits can be collected on Saturday, 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical T-shirt for the first 800 participants, disposable chip timing, refreshment points on the route and at the start/finish, finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products offered by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an award ceremony at 18:00. The routes include refreshment and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes the authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: Urlea Super Vertical

tiers.description: 21 septembrie – 31 octombrie 2025, pentru primii 36 de înscriși

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race held in the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique experience of vertical running and intense downhill. It is the first and only up-down relay race in Romania, where one partner climbs and the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course with a total elevation gain of 1833 meters challenges both the endurance and technique of runners, traversing forest roads, trails through woods, and alpine meadows. The event is dedicated to those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 1833 m elevation gain, up to 2474 m altitude
First and only up-down relay race in Romania, with a partner climbing and the other descending
Varied terrain: forest road, mountain trail, paths through deciduous and coniferous forests, alpine meadow
additional: A revolutionary awards system with individual and team rankings, cash prizes for teams, and bonuses for individual performances. The participation kit includes a personalized race number (for early registrations), a engraved finisher medal, a superlight technical tank top for the first 300 registrants, feeding and hydration points, medical assistance, and access to educational sessions and workshops. Parking is available for 360 cars. Payment is made exclusively by bank card, and registration is only valid after full payment. The event includes kit distribution, camping with tents and accommodation suggestions, as well as start and award ceremonies on race day.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling competition organized in the Greci area, Tulcea County, which emphasizes fun and fair play. The routes are mountainous, challenging but accessible, offering participants an authentic outdoor experience. The event is aimed at both experienced cyclists and those who want to enjoy an active day outdoors in a friendly and well-organized setting.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with inclined slopes and rough terrain
Passing through segments with reduced visibility and varied weather conditions
Route requiring navigation skills and adherence to safety rules
additional: Registrations are exclusively online from March 1 to June 4, 2026. Confirmation of registration is made after payment of the fee, which must be completed within 5 calendar days. Minors must present a signed declaration from parents or guardians. It is recommended to follow safety and fair play rules on the route. Event with activities for the whole family, promoting cycling and outdoor sports.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Maraton Apuseni is an emblematic mountain running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering diverse routes for all tastes and experience levels. Participants can choose between ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross, and a family race, enjoying scenic landscapes, shaded trails, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community, organized with passion by the Romanian Alpine Club Cluj Branch. The festival atmosphere and sporting challenge combine to create a memorable outdoor experience.
course_highlights: Trails through dense forests, spectacular ridges, and alpine meadows
Passing through traditional villages and alpine pastures
Significant elevation changes for each event, with varied landscapes
additional: Ultramarathon start at 05:00. Technical briefings are held for each event. Participation kits are distributed in the days prior and on race day. The event also includes activities for children and families, a party, and an awards ceremony. The routes are ITRA-rated, and some are UTMB Series pre-qualifications. Various routes, volunteer activities, partnerships with sports clubs and local sponsors, and a social impact event for reforestation.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites participants from home and abroad, amateurs or professionals, to test their limits on Long, Medium, and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a lively Art Nouveau city rich in cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting with numerous tourist attractions and modern facilities. Organizers offer attractive prizes to reward the determination and passion of each participant.
course_highlights: Varied distances: Long, Medium, and Olympic
Location in Oradea, a city with 89 Art Nouveau attractions
Event suitable for both amateurs and professionals
additional: Payment can be made online with a bank card via EuPlatesc (Visa/Maestro/Mastercard) without commission. The event is organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association, based in Oradea. Oradea is a city with multiple tourist attractions, including Oradea Fortress and Nymphaea Water Park, providing a pleasant setting for participants and companions. The event also includes X-Run races of 10 km and 21 km, with online registration and prizes for winners.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
location: Muntele Băișorii, Munții Apuseni, Alba, Romania
description: .msg The Apuseni Marathon is an emblematic mountain running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering varied routes for all tastes and experience levels. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain running enthusiasts.

Technical and varied routes, including races for families and beginners

Participants can choose from multiple trail running distances, and the event promotes ecological and reforestation initiatives in the Apuseni Mountains area.

Half marathon route of 22.9 km, shared for women and men

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event attracts participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain routes and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of routes, including peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can expect an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.

Picturesque nature of the Rhodope Mountains
