name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race that offers a unique experience amidst the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances with varying difficulty and elevation, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the routes pass through diverse terrain, including a climb to Cherni Vrah - the highest point of Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop the trail running culture in Bulgaria and promote an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Routes of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2000, 1300, and 600 meters
Passing through Cherni Vrah - the highest point of Vitosha (2290 m)
Diverse terrain: forest trails, wet peat, rocky paths, streams, and moraines
additional: Start number includes a timing chip. Awards are given at Aleko Hut after the finish of the third runner in each distance and group. Each participant receives a medal and a one-week fitness training card at Next Level. Participants with paid registration benefit from a 30% discount on Salomon products and 10% on Suunto at Sport Box store. Use of GPS devices for navigation on the routes is recommended. The routes vary from 12 km to 40 km and include a climb to Cherni Vrah; conditions include mud, stones, forests, and open fields; registration is available online or on-site.

Participation of young athletes under 18
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The competition will bring together young athletes from across the country and will be an important part of the national youth sports program.

The start and finish are at the Dunavska terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the race, there is an animation program for children and families, while runners can expect support from volunteers and an after-run party.

View of the Danube and Belgrade from the viewpoint
Passing by the protected bird habitat Pčelarica

The course mainly passes through forest roads and trails, with varied terrain and beautiful nature, part of the protected zone "Ostviche". The competition includes various disciplines such as running, cycling, duathlon, and triathlon with swimming in Pchelin Lake. The organizer is the "Green Step" club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event that combines running and mountain biking, held in the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between trail running races of 10 km and 21 km, as well as a 30 km mountain biking race, all starting and finishing in the Town Hall Square. A unique element of the competition is traversing a 7 km segment through the underground galleries of the Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits due to the ionized air. The event promotes an active and responsible lifestyle towards nature, involving also plogging activities for trail ecological cleanup.
course_highlights: Trails through forests, hills, and the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine
A 7 km underground segment at 240 meters depth with ionized air
Elevation differences: 250 m for 10 km, 740 m for 21 km trail, 800 m for 30 km mountain bike
additional: Start and finish in the Town Hall Square, Târgu Ocna. The mountain bike race takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, and the trail run races on Saturday, June 13, 2026. Payment is made exclusively by card at the time of registration. The event includes plogging activities for trail ecological cleanup. The routes include trail and mountain bike zones, with online registration and card payment available.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half-marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will cover sustained ascents, trails along the Firiza dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of the local peaks. The event is suitable for both experienced mountain runners and those seeking a trail running experience in nature.
course_highlights: Sustained climb of 7-8 km with a elevation gain of 560 meters
Panorama of the Firiza dam and Igniș peak
Spectacular trail along the dam with memorable views
additional: GPX files are available for download for the routes. The marathon route includes a 21 km loop through scenic areas such as Limpedea, Groapele Chiuzbăii, and Fântâna cu borcut. There are aid stations and checkpoints along the course, and the routes are marked with distinctive signs. Volunteers guide competitors along common and branching trails. Trail routes include mountain terrain, technical paths, and mountain ascents, emphasizing the natural beauty of the area. Participation includes official materials and access to event facilities.

name: Maraton Tarcău
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area, Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country events. The event emphasizes physical preparation and proper equipment, ensuring a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can benefit from the participation kit provided one day before the race and must adhere to the official competition regulations. The time limits for completing the courses are well established for each event, ensuring a competitive and organized pace.
course_highlights: Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country courses in the Tarcău area, Neamț
Time limit for completion: 7 hours for marathon, 4 hours for half-marathon, 2 hours for cross-country
Participation kit provided one day before the race
additional: The participation kit is offered on Friday, June 12, 2026, and participants must sign a statement of responsibility. There is a technical briefing before the start. The time limits for completing the courses are: 7 hours for the marathon (start at 9:00), 4 hours for the half-marathon (start at 10:00), 2 hours for the cross-country (start at 11:00). Registration takes place on June 12, with a participation kit and a statement of responsibility; races with time limits; spectacular mountain routes.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș, Romania
description: The Lord's Seat Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held in the Lord's Seat Natural Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several categories, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross, as well as races for families and children. The routes combine sustained ascents, forest roads, and segments with spectacular views, suitable for mountain runners eager for adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and control points along the route.
course_highlights: 42 km route with a positive elevation gain of 2100 m
Areas with spectacular views towards the Calimani Crest
Multiple refreshment and control points, including on the Lord's Seat Plateau
additional: Kit pickup is on Friday, June 12th between 17:00-23:00 and Saturday, June 13th between 6:00-8:00 for the main categories. The start for the main categories is at 09:00, and for Family and Mini races at 09:15. Mandatory equipment checks for safety are required. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, followed by a bonfire. Participants' parking is organized in a specially arranged area near the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the village of Bistra Mureșului. Mountain routes, registration details, and event schedule are available; registration closes on June 6, 2026.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a trail running event held in nature, on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a race for children. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sports competition; it is a call to live fully for body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message of direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes "the place of meeting," where sport, community, and faith meet authentically and relevantly for today's generation.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Bistrița area, conducted in nature
Half marathon for experienced runners
Accessible 5 km and 10 km races for all levels
additional: The event includes races for children (Cross Kids). Technical details and trail maps will be updated later on the website. Event T-shirts with size guides are provided. Trail running in nature, promoting health, community, and faith, with multiple race categories for all ages.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for athletes under 14 in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together over 300 young athletes from across the country. It is held at the "Hristo Botev" stadium and offers an opportunity for the youngest talents to showcase their skills in classic athletics disciplines. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation's sports calendar and is held concurrently with the international tournament "Nikola Vulchanov". This is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Competitions at the "Hristo Botev" stadium in Gabrovo
Classic athletics disciplines for under 14 years old
Two-day format with over 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at the "Hristo Botev" stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike and run event in Lovech, combining a sports challenge with historical and natural attractions. Participants pass through four iconic bridges and beautiful routes, including the Devetashko Plateau, Kăkrinsko Han, Hisarya Fortress, and the parks Bash Bunar and Stratesh. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees allocated to charity. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature, history, and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Passing through four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as Kăkrinsko Han and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is conducted online or on-site on designated days. In the last two weeks before the event, registration is possible with restrictions - without a personalized start number and with a merchandise item by size on-site. The fee is determined by the moment of payment. No medical examination is required for the 5 km run. Support stations with food and drinks are included, as well as medals for finishers, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. The duathlon includes 40 km cycling + 12 km running, charity campaign, historical routes, and natural scenery.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Teppe Jamboree is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv that combines running, movement, and culture through the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural activities such as jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through iconic city landmarks, hills, alleys, and green areas, suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race but an experience that unites the community and supports causes for people with unequal opportunities.
course_highlights: Champion Jamboree - 13 km with 450 meters of positive elevation, passing through all the hills of Plovdiv
Relaxed Jamboree - 7 km with 250 meters of positive elevation
Children's Jamboree - 1 km in Bunardzhik Park with a safe route and controlled environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops with theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, artists, and surprises. The start-finish zone features a party with music and entertainment. There is an opportunity for volunteering in the Jamboree Squad with support from participants and organizers. Corporate teams participate in a competition with team spirit and donations for the voluntary formation “Plovdiv112”. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km distances; the event is part of the Plovdiv 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 метра, 3000 метра, 1500 метра, 0.8 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at the Aprilov Stadium. It includes 17 disciplines, among them sprint races and shot put, for various age groups from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are the Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and features an official opening at 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: Competitions at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 disciplines, including sprint races and shot put
Participation of various age groups - from under 14 to men and women
additional: The official opening of the tournament is at 11:00 AM at Aprilov Stadium. Organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event includes disciplines for different age groups. The tournament features 17 disciplines, with participants from 23 clubs, and a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: The Wild Call Madjarovo is an annual race that combines cycling and trail running in the picturesque Eastern Rhodopes. The event takes place in the town of Madjarovo, located in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique nature and historical landmarks. The routes offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both amateurs and elite competitors. Organized by the Dimităr Madjarov Cycling Club, the race aims to showcase the beauty of the region and bring together sports enthusiasts in a spirit of adventure and environmental consciousness.
course_highlights: Trail running with elevation gain up to 900 m and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests, ancient paths, and near a waterfall
Unique nature in the volcano crater and close to the Arda River with impressive meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madjarovo. Services included are chip timing, mountain rescue service, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and camping options in the Arda River canyon or in a tent camp in the town park. Multiple distances for MTB, duathlon, and trail run, with races on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children's races and eco-activities.

name: Sunrise Marathon
location: Bačka Palanka, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka is an event that supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and contribute through running and fundraising to bring joy and happiness back to children fighting this disease. By participating in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.
course_highlights: Enjoy running through the beautiful nature of Bačka Palanka
Opportunity to participate in various race distances (marathon, half marathon, 10K, 5K)
Support humanitarian goals for children with cancer
additional: Race participants can join Team Sunrise and receive a personalized fundraising page, a Team Sunrise T-shirt, and donation tools. Registration for the race is done directly with the race organizers, and participants arrange their own travel. Charitable race bibs are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is often linked to humanitarian donations and fundraising for children with cancer; registration details and dates are available through the organizers.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its pristine nature and crystal-clear waters. The trail passes through a canyon rich in wildlife and diverse terrains, including forest paths, rocky shores, and crossings over streams. This race is a blend of natural splendor and adventure, ideal for runners who want to experience trail running in its most vivid form. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series that connects mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.
course_highlights: The trail passes through the canyon of the Gradac River with crystal-clear water
Diverse terrains: forest paths, rocky shores, stream crossings
Rich fauna and natural beauty of untouched nature
additional: The race is part of the West Serbia Trails series connecting mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia. Inspired by the otter, a symbol of liveliness and playfulness. No specific information about start time, registration, or prices for this race has been found. Trail running with diverse terrains along the Gradac River, focusing on natural beauty and adventure, takes place in June 2026.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails event series held in the beautiful natural landscapes of western Serbia. This race offers routes of 10 km and 19 km along the Gradac River, one of the cleanest rivers in Europe, known for its untouched nature. Participants have the opportunity to experience Serbia's pristine nature by running through forested and mountainous areas that are often accessible only on foot. This event is ideal for running and nature enthusiasts who want to test their abilities in an authentic environment.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 19 km
Running along the Gradac River with clear waters
Untouched nature and mountain landscapes accessible only on foot
additional: Organizers provide refreshments on the course with drinks and snacks at multiple points. Comfortable sports gear suitable for trail running in nature is recommended. The event is part of a series of races and hiking tours held throughout the year in western Serbia. Trail running and hiking in picturesque areas of Western Serbia, with experiences of local culture and nature.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 mountain running race will be held in the picturesque surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild parts of the Sopron Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km, and 25.9 km, with the Alpokalja Trail King series also included. The race features a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the best male and female runners will receive a prize. The race headquarters is located at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, which has restrooms and showers available.
course_highlights: Wildly scenic terrain in the Sopron Mountains
Timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances
Refreshment points on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances, environmentally friendly with no cups
additional: The start and finish are at Brennbergbánya main square. The award ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish line. Showers and restrooms/WC are available at the race headquarters. Due to environmental reasons, no cups will be provided at the refreshment points; participants are advised to bring their own water bottles or cups. Registration is done online via the E-registration system, with the deadline on June 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM. The race offers special prizes for the challenging uphill sections. The organizers implement eco-friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: The Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race between the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views and challenging ascents. The race takes place in a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet each other year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but registration without a medal is also possible. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards. The start/finish area is located at the Lussonium Romkert, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views between Paks-Dunakömlőd hills
Challenging ascents and varied terrain
Exciting start/finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and a maximum of 400 entries, including up to 100 preschool and elementary school children. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. The finisher medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at Lussonium Romkert in Dunakömlőd, offering sports opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a diverse trail running event offering various distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near the Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race is held over four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), mid-distance (13.5 km), and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km warm-up lap in the castle park. The courses traverse varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refresh at aid stations. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and organizers pay special attention to participants' safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on mini, 595 m+ on mountain half marathon
Two refreshment stations on the course, three on the mountain half marathon, use of personal soft-cup recommended
additional: The race starts twice: at 9:00 for the Mountain Half Marathon, and at 9:30 for the Mini, Short, and Mid-distance races. Use of a personal "soft-cup" is mandatory at aid stations during the mountain half marathon. The race is timed electronically, with rescue systems provided by off-road vehicles and medical personnel. Registration is available on SPORTNAPTAR.HU, with pre-registration from December 6, 2025. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The event features multiple distances, refreshment stations, medical services, parking, and an auto-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and an impressive start/finish location. The race takes place in a friendly, family-like atmosphere, where participants of all ages can test their strength over various distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, with an option for a cheaper registration without a medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, and on-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and first aid are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging ascents on the trail
Impressive start and finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and accepts up to 400 registrations, including a maximum of 100 preschool and elementary school children. On-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are provided. Finish medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Multiple distances, family and children categories, hilly terrain, medals, and refreshments are available for participants.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race held on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Kiseleff Avenue. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The routes are accessible and friendly, with an energetic, fun, and solidarity-filled atmosphere, where every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. Participants receive superhero-themed kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.
course_highlights: Urban, flat, and fully marked routes suitable for amateurs and experienced runners
Special route accessible to people with disabilities
Family-friendly atmosphere for families, children, and pets
additional: The race kit includes an official T-shirt, a superhero cape, themed accessories, a surprise bag, a participation number, and a medal. Medical assistance and hydration points are available along the route. The event offers dedicated zones for families, children, pets, and people with disabilities, a secure wardrobe, security team, and volunteers for guidance. After the race, participants can enjoy sports activities, wellness sessions, children's workshops, themed photo booths, and relaxation areas. The event is a charity, with recreational activities, family and children zones, T-shirt and accessory kits, hydration points, and first aid.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is the largest multi-sport event in Romania, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to June 14, 2026. The festival combines sports competitions, initiation activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique experience of sport and entertainment for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important component of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause, supporting the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive and friendly environment.
course_highlights: Superheroes Run: 5 km and 10 km races on dedicated routes
Via Transilvanica trail, a long-distance tourist route with markings and carved milestones
Sports and demonstration events in Prof Dr. Iuliu Hățieganu Sports Park
additional: Participation in the Superheroes Run supports the social project Via Transilvanica, with part of the registration fee donated to the community. The festival includes zones dedicated to children, food zones with healthy menus, concerts, and dance demonstrations. The race kit is provided to participants, and the event promotes sport as a way of life and social involvement. The event features activities for all ages, sports competitions, and support for social causes.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event dedicated to amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete to earn their place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and markings will be limited to respect forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including races for children and options for families with special discounts. In case of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled for a backup date.
course_highlights: Carefully marked route to protect forests and natural areas
Route markings will be communicated through the Participant Guide during the week of the event
Start location accessible via Google Maps
additional: The event has a limit of 1000 starting spots. The backup date for the race is June 20, 2026. Children between 5 and 13 years old must have a personal account on the Riders Club platform and be registered, and it is recommended that they be accompanied on the route. For families, there is a 20% discount for a minimum of 3 people. For E-MTB races, bicycles with electric motors that assist only while pedaling are permitted, with a single battery for the entire race. Participation requires prior registration, an event suitable for all experience levels, with the possibility to compete in electric races and prizes for participants.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes through three iconic huts - Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka, and includes a climb to the third highest peak in Stara Planina - Golyam Kademlia (2275.4 m). The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, starting from the picturesque village of Taja, which is the starting point for all three routes. This event is for mountain running and nature enthusiasts, combining challenge and the beauty of the wild mountain.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Sokolna reserve with pristine nature
Climb to Golyam Kademlia peak - 2275.4 m
Passing through three iconic huts - Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The start is in the village of Taja. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packets are distributed both the evening before the race and on the race day from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. Awards begin at 14:00. All winners receive a race logo t-shirt. There is an option to order a designer t-shirt during registration. Participants under 18 are only allowed to compete in the 12K and 20K with a parental declaration. Refunds are possible until 30.04.2026 with a 20% fee; after that, no refunds are issued. Organizers are seeking volunteers to assist with organization. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 spots is reached; option to order designer t-shirts during registration; the event includes social activities and camping opportunities.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Barefoot running with a smile is a unique event held in the picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers an opportunity for barefoot running, combining sport and pleasure amidst nature. The event is suitable for everyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running barefoot in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrains
Picturesque views of the Belogradchik Rocks
Unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race "U Tsarstvoto na TribaLete" is a unique event in the heart of Vrachanski Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with nearly 1000 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak waterfall and the peaks Dudil and Buk, combining steep ascents with technical descents. The race is intended for enthusiasts of natural beauty and mountain running, with prizes distributed along the course and including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwestern Bulgaria as a destination for sports and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with nearly 1000 m elevation gain
Passing under Borov Kamak waterfall over 70 m high
Technical and steep descent from Buzh peak with views of Vrachanski Balkan and Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance of Borov Kamak eco trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the most difficult with the greatest ascent. Prizes are distributed along the course. Registration by phone at 0878 259 772. The route includes waterfalls, ascents, descents, technical parts, and natural beauty.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić, organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes multiple disciplines: 6, 12, and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, and participants compete in absolute and age categories. Besides the competitive spirit, the race offers a rich refreshment station, a communal lunch, and awards for the best, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: Multiday races lasting 6, 12, and 24 hours
Races over distances of 50 km and 100 km
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is organized in hotel and motel facilities, as well as a communal tent for competitors without the need for overnight stay. During the race, a rich refreshment station is available, and after the race, a communal lunch for all participants. Awards are given in absolute and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training, competitions, and promotion of ultramarathon running in the region, scheduled for June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sports, friendship, family values, and recreation. This race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, the race has become the most populous sports event in the municipality of Kula, with over 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. Organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more attractive for all participants.
course_highlights: Promotion of sports and friendship
Mass regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the most populous sports event in the municipality of Kula and gathers runners from the entire region. Organizers are dedicated to the continuous improvement of the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is an associated activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant tradition and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transportation from Belgrade.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The I. Midsummer Flash Run is a night running festival in Balatonszárszó, at the Lakeside Park, held on Midsummer Night. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes runners, families, and community sports enthusiasts. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers points collection opportunities for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night run along Lake Balaton
400m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
5.25 km course with refreshment points around 2.6 km
additional: Number pickup at 10:00 AM in Lakeside Park. The relay exchange takes place at the finish gate with a chip timing bib, and it is recommended to use a bib holder. The registration fee includes refreshments (grape sugar, biscuits, salty pretzels, mineral water, syrup, gummy candies). Residents of Balatonszárszó receive a 30% discount, and seasonal discounts are also available based on previous participation. Technical shirts can be purchased separately for 8,500 HUF. The event supports the Ötpróba program, offering discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running opportunities and awards for participants.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Saint László Trail Run is a traditional trail running race in the Gerecse Mountains near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint László, the patron saint of soldiers and infantry, and has been held regularly since 2010, with the exception of 2013 when it was canceled due to flooding. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly areas. The event is a lively, community-oriented occasion, suitable for those interested in outdoor activities and sports.
course_highlights: Varied terrain of the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
Nature-oriented, challenging running course
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which operates several sections including athletics, triathlon, orienteering, outdoor activities, sport shooting, and other sports. The event traditionally takes place in June, and the 2026 race will be the XVI. edition. Maps and previous results are available on the organizers' website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories, detailed information not provided.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sports, eco, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition in 2026 celebrates the nature, history, and cultural heritage of the area, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The race includes marathon, half-marathon, cross-country, and children's race categories, on routes that combine mountain trails, local roads, and sections of asphalt. Participants can admire natural landscapes and old architecture along the way, in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with altitude variations on mountain trails and local roads
Combination of mountain and street running
Natural landscapes and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from June 19 to June 21, 2026, with kit pickup at the Central Square on the day before the race. The program also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain runners and street runners. The event features cultural and ecological activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, providing an opportunity to support the natural and cultural heritage of the area.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Tarnava Marathon is a trail running event organized by the Tarnaveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnaveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor running, aiming to increase ecological awareness and highlight the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located within the Ruck Ventilatoare company premises, and the competition includes several trail running routes suitable for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of passionate runners and environmental respect.
course_highlights: Start and finish within the Ruck Ventilatoare company premises
Various trail running routes: half marathon 21 km, cross 10 km, cross 4 km, and Kids Trail Running
Event held in the Transylvania region, in nature
additional: Kit pickup is available the day before and on the day of the race at the Ruck Ventilatoare factory. There is a warm-up led by a fitness instructor before the start. Races for children are organized by age categories. After the competition, a Gulaș Party, concert, and awards ceremony take place. Participants can choose between routes of 21 km, 10 km, 4 km, and children's races, with activities such as kit pickup, races, and award ceremonies.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a mountain running competition with tradition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain enthusiasts from the entire region. The event offers two races held in an authentic mountain setting, with real elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes include a 14 km Cross with 1000 m positive elevation gain and a semi-marathon of approximately 23 km with 1450 m positive elevation gain. Participants receive a participation kit, hydration points, and medical assistance, and the finish line is at Mountain Pearl Guesthouse.
course_highlights: Cross Route: 14 km with 1000 m positive elevation gain, sustained climbs and technical descents
Semi-Marathon Route: approx. 23 km with 1450 m positive elevation gain, additional challenge
Spectacular scenery and hydration points along the route
additional: The start takes place at Podul Berdu, Ferneziu neighborhood, at the base of Lake Firiza. The routes are marked with ribbons, signs, and paint. The participation kit includes a chip number, T-shirt, medal, access to hydration points, medical assistance, and guide. The finish is at Mountain Pearl Guesthouse, the main partner of the event. The routes are on mountain terrain, registrations close on June 9, 2026, participation includes a kit with number, T-shirt, medal, and hydration points, and the event takes place on June 20, 2026.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Run is a running race organized in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run on cool trails in Hoia Forest. The event includes distances of 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family-friendly race, suitable for runners of all ages and levels. Organizers Runners Club promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The run takes place in June, replacing urban asphalt with nature and providing an outdoor running experience.
course_highlights: Trail on the cool paths of Hoia Forest
Distances of 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family race
Outdoor event in nature
additional: Registration package includes a race number and other benefits. Prizes are awarded in categories. The event is organized by Runners Club, which supports free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The event takes place in Hoia Forest, with online registration and medals for participants. The route includes natural trails, suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and street runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children's Race, which takes place on age-appropriate routes in the historic center of the town. Participants can admire natural landscapes and centuries-old architectural heritage along the way.
course_highlights: Varied routes with elevation differences on mountain trails and local roads
Natural landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains and historic architectural heritage in Roșia Montană
Children's Race on age-appropriate routes in the historic center
additional: The Children's Race has different routes depending on age, from 700 meters for children 0-10 years old (with a parent/guardian required for 0-6 years) up to 2.3 km for children 13-16 years old. The start and finish are in the Central Square of Roșia Montană. The event also includes other races: Marathon 42.16 km, Half Marathon 25.2 km, and 10 km Cross. Participation kits can be picked up in the Central Square the day before, and the program includes cultural activities and concerts. The children's races include three different routes (700 m, 1.3 km, 2.3 km), with prizes and medals for participants. The event takes place on June 21, 2026, in the historic center of the commune, promoting the cultural and ecological values of the area.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship "Euro Folk 2026" is held in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dances, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and processed folklore performances. The event is part of the long-standing tradition of EAFF and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances of traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunity to participate and observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants apply via an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, with various folklore genres and a competitive nature. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO for consulting services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from all over Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities for exchanging traditions.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling race held in Bedekka Park and the southern slopes of the Middle Mountain near Stara Zagora. The event offers various distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the 'In Green' festival. The routes pass by the three ritual Thracian mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different levels of preparation. Participants receive a starter pack with a race number and support along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon 21 km through the three ritual Thracian mounds 'Green Pyramids'
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33, and 65 km near the city
Courses of varying difficulty suitable for all levels of preparation
additional: Participation for children up to 12 years old is free. The event is part of the 'In Green' festival from June 19 to 21 in Bedekka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation Cup with different categories. The festival includes sports competitions, workshops, music, cinema, and food; a new location - Cypress Grove has been added.

description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Kosmaj mountain, providing participants with the opportunity to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great chance for a trip and socializing in the race village located in the start and finish zone. There are three distances available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages with parental consent for those under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a good atmosphere, and participants receive a start package with a T-shirt if they register on time.
course_highlights: Trails through dense forests of Kosmaj mountain
Beautiful viewpoints and natural landscapes
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish zone
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 1000. The start package can be picked up in Belgrade ten days before the race. The registration fee is non-refundable but can be gifted or transferred to the next year. Changing clothes and leaving belongings is individual. The race is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Registration is open until June 10, 2025. The start is scheduled for 08:00 AM, and the race takes place near the monument of the Kosmaj Partisan Detachment. Participants will be able to enjoy nature and visit local attractions after the race.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, listed as a UNESCO site. The race offers several distances suitable for trail running and mountain running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in the natural beauty of Bulgaria, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, included in UNESCO
Impressive views and trail running route
Variety of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points respectively from a previous race are required for registration. Registration and gear check are mandatory and are conducted at specific times before the start. Transportation to the start area is organized for the 25 km distance. Awards are presented at the Central Square in Bansko. Multi-distance race, including ultramarathon and scalar routes, with exceptional natural scenery.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race from the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun, held in Vranata Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation change. Participants can choose between three distances - short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km), making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop approximately 5 km long
Held in Vranata Park, in the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation change on the course
additional: The race offers a choice of three distances - 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is a loop of about 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The elevation change is minimal, making it suitable for runners with different levels of preparation. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and includes various distances, taking place in Vranata Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumen Plateau 2026 is a race held on June 21, 2026, in Shumen Plateau Nature Park, with start and finish points near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloklub Ilchov Bair, the event includes disciplines such as cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various routes, with rules for safety and environmental protection to be followed. The race is suitable for mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes in Shumen Plateau Nature Park with diverse terrain
Start and finish near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument
Includes disciplines cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and distribution of race numbers take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center near the "Creators of the Bulgarian State" monument. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, the bicycle must meet EU requirements with a speed limit of up to 25 km/h and power up to 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 years old must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on-site.

description: Night marathon in Novi Sad is one of the most attended races in Serbia and represents a unique nocturnal athletic-recreational event. The main race is a marathon of 42 km, which requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and offers a special energy of the night race. Additionally, there is a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible for all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and pride of Novi Sad, with carefully organized participant packages and rich content on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: Night race through the streets of Novi Sad
Marathon of 42.2 km as the main discipline
Half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Start packages are collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a functional shirt, a start number with a chip, a finisher medal, refreshments on the course, and a massage after the race. Registrations are only possible through the portal trka.rs and are not allowed on race day. Participants under 18 years old cannot participate in the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini marathon and half marathon. The event includes multiple race distances and Nordic walking, with registrations via the platform trka.rs. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with details on registration and program available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Little Holy Mountain athletics race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course that runs through nature, providing runners with a unique experience and the opportunity to compete in different distances. Organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and participate in this sporting event that gathers runners from the entire region.
course_highlights: Courses through the nature of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Challenging and diverse running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural-historical landmarks and natural beauties, and is held within the broader tourist and sports environment of Ovčar Banja.

Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance, and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging race. Organizers aim to create a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, providing an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

Plogging race that combines running and cleaning the environment
Children's OCR races with obstacle courses suitable for different ages

Registration for children's races is mandatory, and participation is free. All participants receive race shirts and medals, with the most successful receiving gift packages. Trail and ecological activities, multiple route lengths, children's obstacle race, mandatory registration for the children's race, date 27.06.2026.

Challenging ascents and technical parts

description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special nighttime race in the heart of Budapest, on the illuminated Heroes' Square and Andrássy Avenue. Runners can compete in quarter marathon, half marathon, pairs, and trios distances while enjoying the magical nighttime atmosphere of the city. Thousands of runners from various towns across the country participate in the event, and each participant receives a unique finisher medal and a finisher package. The race starts at 21:00 on June 27, 2026, allowing runners to experience the joy of running amidst the city lights.
course_highlights: Running through Budapest's historic Heroes' Square and Andrássy Avenue
Night run in the illuminated city, with special light and shadow effects
Participation with thousands of runners, with a unique finisher medal and package

Assistance provided for minors and those without an email address to generate a unique email. Limited technical running shirts available for pre-order. name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, volunteer-entry running race held in Dióskert. Participants can complete the half marathon distance by running four laps, but it is also possible to run fewer laps. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, where all runners are greeted with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female finishers will also receive a special medal, and the award ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, in a natural environment
The half marathon consists of 4 laps, but fewer laps can be run
Family-friendly, welcoming atmosphere, voluntary entry fee per lap
additional: Registration is on-site, with a recommended voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap. All runners are greeted with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. The award ceremony is at 12:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a unique medal. The half marathon is 4 laps, but fewer laps can be run. Registration is on-site, with refreshments and medals provided.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodnei Mountains, in the Borșa area, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes, adapted for different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, intended for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a medium challenge for prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast trail with a large descent difference. The race is part of the Carpathian Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature, among spectacular mountain landscapes. Organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to participate in an active outdoor weekend.
course_highlights: Puzdrelor Route: 29.5 km with 2200 m elevation gain, recommended for experienced runners
Gărgălău Route: 21 km with 1300-1500 m elevation gain, suitable for prepared but less experienced runners
Musceta Route: 16 km with 500 m ascent and 1500 m descent, a fast and technical trail
additional: The race location is Borșa, in the Rodnei Mountains, a mountain area with spectacular landscapes and a tradition in mountain sports. There are multiple accommodation options near the start, from guesthouses to campgrounds, at distances ranging from 190 m to 17.6 km from the start. The routes combine marked and unmarked trails, forest roads, and steep slopes, offering an authentic mountain running experience. The race is part of the Mountain Running Circuit of the Carpathians. The mountain trail requires mandatory equipment checks, starting from the Borșa cable car base, with GPX download, and information about accommodations and registrations. Fees include hydration points, photos, goulash, and parking access.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race with start and finish in Piața Primăriei Sinaia. The routes pass through picturesque areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain running enthusiasts, with races of 10K and 21K. Participants receive a race kit with bib number, timing chip, and medal, and organizers provide free digital photo galleries.
course_highlights: Mountain route with ascents up to Cota 1000 and Cota 1400
Passing through marked tourist areas with red and yellow tape
Start and finish in Piața Primăriei Sinaia, on Bd. Carol
additional: Kit pickup is only available in person with an identity document. The maximum time to complete the 10K route is 4.5 hours, and for the 21K is 6 hours. Participation of minors aged 14 to 18 is only allowed if accompanied by an adult with written consent. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 50 RON, while the special children's T-shirt is free. Access to the route is only permitted to participants with a valid bib, officials, and authorized personnel. The routes include varied mountain terrain, with details about the races and cultural and historical attractions in the area, such as Peles Castle and Sinaia Monastery.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes and thousands of amateur runners and children. The festival combines performance sport with the joy of movement and the city's energy, offering a flat and fast course, ideal for all running levels. The event includes races dedicated to children, open races of 5 km and 10 km, as well as an elite race with top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course in the heart of Cluj-Napoca
Children's races with distances adapted to age
Presence of international and Romanian elite athletes
additional: Children's races take place on Saturday, June 27, while adult and elite races are on Sunday, June 28. Children's distances: 800 m (6-9 years), 1200 m (10-13 years), 3000 m (13-15 years). Amateur races: 5 km (minimum 14 years), 10 km (minimum 16 years). The event is organized by the team behind Brașov Running Festival. All children participants receive medals and surprises. Includes children's races, open categories, and an international elite competition with a World Athletics label; the event takes place in Cluj-Napoca and promotes urban running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: The Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with the City Hall and the Cultural Center of Mioveni. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on various routes of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km, plus special races for young children. The atmosphere is lively, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic moments, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sports fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.
course_highlights: Routes of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km in the Civic Center of Mioveni
Special 'DINO' races for children
Lively atmosphere with music, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic moments
additional: The event includes raffles with prizes and surprises for participants, offered by sponsors such as UHU and WD-40. Participants are both adults and children, with the youngest runner being 3 years old and the oldest 78 years old. Routes of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km, races for children, an event promoting health and sports, with support from sponsors TEMAD, WD-40, and UHU Romania.

description: Hoia GlobalLogic Run is a running race organized in Hoia Forest, Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run on cool forest trails. The event includes distances of 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family-friendly race, suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The run is an excellent opportunity to swap urban asphalt for fresh air and beautiful forest scenery.
course_highlights: Trails on cool forest paths in Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family race
Event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The registration package includes a technical t-shirt and a race bib. Prizes for winners in each category. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Trail through Hoia Forest, online registration, fee includes medal, timing, and medical assistance.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting the spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded soldiers. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sports competitions. Participants are encouraged to join to support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating environment.
course_highlights: Route held in the civic center of Mioveni
Event dedicated to wounded soldiers and war veterans
Atmosphere of solidarity and community support
additional: The event includes several sports activities, but details about the route and registration are not specified

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The National Under 20 Championship, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that gathers the best young athletes in Bulgaria. It is held at a stadium in Sofia and provides an opportunity for development and exposure for youth in athletics. The event is part of the BFLA sports calendar for 2026 and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics with a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Competition at a stadium in Sofia
Participation of the best young athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation with a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will gather young athletes from across the country.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The Cross-Triathlon "In the footsteps of the Thracians" is the first edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Dam, Kazanlak. Participants will go through challenging routes for swimming, cycling, and running amidst beautiful nature and diverse terrain. The event is suitable for both amateurs who want to test their strength and willpower, and for those seeking fun in nature. Organized by the sports club "Trayana-Triathlon" Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: Swimming 2 km in the sandy shores of Koprinka Dam
Cycling 60 km in the forests of the Middle Mountain with rugged terrain
Running 15 km in the forest and along the shores of the dam with panoramic views
additional: Control times: swimming - 1:40 hours; cycling - 5:30 hours; running - 2:30 hours. The time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is only for persons over 18 years old. The day before the race, there is a children's competition for different age groups. Routes for swimming 2 km, cycling 60 km, running 14 km; registration with different prices; medals, refreshment points, professional timing, medical services, bike service, awards, and photos included.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. This race gathers sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging trail through forested areas and mountain terrains. The festival of healthy spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy way of life in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trails through forested and mountain areas of Ovčar Banja
Natural environment with clean air and beautiful views
Challenging terrains suitable for trail running
additional: The event is part of the Healthy Spirit festival, which emphasizes healthy living, sports, and outdoor activity.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
location: Jankovich Kúria, Rácalmás, Tolna County, Hungary
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a family-friendly trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the Danube River. The varied terrain offers shaded forest trails, farmland panoramas, riverside routes, and asphalt sections with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide sports opportunities accessible to all ages, whether running, walking, or cycling. The race center is the historic Jankovich Mansion, which is an ideal location for the start and finish, as well as for accompanying programs. Participants receive unique medals and T-shirts, and the event offers a friendly, nature-oriented atmosphere.
course_highlights: Protected Nagy Island and Danube riverside routes
Varied terrain: forest trails, farmland panoramas, asphalt sections
Minimal elevation gain, shaded trees, and a route along a charming boat dock
additional: Race bib pickup is from 8:00 to 10:00. Multiple refreshment stations along the courses. Free participation for RSE members, but registration is required. On-site registration is limited; pre-registration is recommended. Various accompanying programs, health measurements, and gastronomic offerings are available on race day. Custom medals and T-shirts can be ordered in advance. Finisher medals, refreshment points, medical services, and family programs await participants. Registration is available online through Köridő.hu with favorable prices and pre-registration options.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultra marathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with diverse terrain. Organizers emphasize environmental protection and conduct the race without waste. Participants receive start packages and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Circumference of Vitosha in 9 stages through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultra marathon with diverse terrain and altitude
Start and finish at Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Start numbers are distributed at ALPI store in Sofia and at the start line up to 60 minutes before the race. The race is conducted with an emphasis on environmental protection - participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. There is a special soft bottle SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels. The awards ceremony takes place on the race day after the finish. The race includes disciplines of running, cycling, and duathlon. The route includes hard-to-reach parts of the mountain with a total elevation gain of over 2000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of the mountain ultra marathon and cycling.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Ócsai Cellar Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail running event that passes through notable sights of the town of Ócsa. The race takes place over a distance of 10.5 km, which can be repeated multiple times for longer distances, with options for 21 km and 42 km. The run features unique chip timing, and the goal of the event is to connect sport and community in honor of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Center, and the course includes varied asphalt and dirt paths.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route passes through Ócsa's sights, including the Old Cellar Row and the Reformed Church
The 21 km distance is two laps, and the 42 km distance is four laps of the 10.5 km course
Varied terrain: asphalt streets and dirt roads, 100% trail running along the cellar row
additional: The race features unique chip timing that measures both net and gross times. The rankings are based on gross time. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the registration fee upon presenting proof of residence. Registration is free for those born in 1960 or earlier. A maximum of 550 participants can compete. The start and finish are located on the street section in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Center. The event includes multiple distances, including memorial runs and community activities fitting the local spirit, open to all participants, with the course set on varied terrain.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Bajina Bašta, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers multiple distances tailored to different levels of preparedness, from a vertical ascent to an ultra-long course of 62 km with significant elevation gains. The routes pass through hidden and attractive parts of Tara, providing runners with an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events are organized at the finish line, creating a unique atmosphere for all participants and visitors.
course_highlights: The TUT 62 route runs from the Rača Monastery through hidden parts of Tara National Park to Bajina Bašta with 2600 m of elevation gain
Viewpoints Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača canyon offer spectacular views during the race
Diverse terrains include single-track, gravel roads, asphalt sections, and technical descents
additional: Registrations open on January 1, 2026, at midnight. Participants under 18 years old cannot participate in TUT 62, and those under 14 can only run with parental supervision. An all-day outdoor festival and Bašta Fest short film festival are held at the finish line. The children's race (ages 4-12) is free and designed for the youngest competitors. Online registrations open on January 1, 2026, and the races include various distances and categories, with activities for all ages and ITRA points.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The First Balkan Championship in mountain and trail running will be held from July 2 to July 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition includes four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, which gather the best mountain runners from the Balkans. The courses are diverse and demanding, with spectacular landscapes and technical ascents, providing a true challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers are Balkan Mountaineering Union, Serbian Mountaineering Association, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Mountain Uphill: 6 km with over 1000 m ascent, ending at Sjenic viewpoint with panoramic views of Tara
Mountain Classic: 13.6 km with 550 m ascent, starting near the Rača monastery, passing through the Rača canyon, and finishing in Bajina Bašta
Mountain Trail: 36 km with around 1900 m ascent, a technically demanding course with two ascents to Tara plateau and spectacular viewpoints
additional: Races are intended for runners born in 2008 and older for Mountain Uphill and Mountain Classic, while Mountain Trail is for runners born in 2006 and older. Mountain Uphill is the only race that does not start at the Rača monastery nor finish in Bajina Bašta. The courses include technical single-track segments, fast descents, and demanding ascents, with final sections suitable for a strong finish. Multiple race categories, including U18, focus on mountain terrains and natural beauty; organized by regional and local mountaineering and sports organizations.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Tara Mountain, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Serbia, on the first weekend of July. The race offers multiple distances tailored to different levels of runners, from a vertical ascent to an ultra-long course of 62 km with significant elevation gains. The routes pass through hidden and attractive parts of the mountain, providing unforgettable landscapes and challenges. Besides the race, an outdoor festival and accompanying events for all ages and fitness levels are organized at the finish line. This event is an opportunity to feel and experience the mountain in its full beauty and grandeur.
course_highlights: 62 km course with 2600 m cumulative ascent through Tara National Park
Spectacular viewpoints such as Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača canyon
Diverse terrains including technical single-track sections, gravel roads, and asphalt
additional: The children's race (ages 4-12) is free and designed for the youngest competitors, with the possibility for parents and guardians to join. An all-day outdoor festival and cultural events, including the short film festival 'Bašta Fest', are organized in Bajina Bašta. All races earn ITRA points and count towards the ITRA National League. Multiple distances, Balkan championship, outdoor festival, children's race, registration via prijavise.net.

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

description: The TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Selmecbánya and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 sections that pass through the Selmec Mountains and the Danube-Ipoly National Park, featuring rich natural and cultural sights. Runners can participate in various team sizes and individual categories, allowing everyone to find a suitable challenge. The goal of the race is to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region's natural and historical values.
course_highlights: Passing through the Selmec Mountains and the Danube-Ipoly National Park
18 sections, each 8-16 km long with varying difficulty terrain
Historical and natural sights such as Drégely Castle, Esztergom Basilica, Prédikálószék
additional: The race is open to teams of 3-8 members and individual runners. Teams switch between 18 sections, each ranging from 8 to 16 km. Solo runners can complete the entire distance at their own responsibility, with their own escort, and may use refreshment stations. During the race, runners pass through protected natural areas and historical sites. The route includes crossing through the Danube-Ipoly National Park and other natural reserves, emphasizing both natural beauty and cultural heritage.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
location: Népkert sor, Szeged, Csongrád County, Hungary
description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running event in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night-time half marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy the joy of community sports. The race takes place on Népkert Street, providing an ideal environment for running and family activities. The event is traditionally very popular, with over 1100 participants.
course_highlights: Night-time half marathon distance
Family-friendly sports day programs
Népkert Street, Szeged's green environment
additional: The race is organized for charitable purposes and as a family sports day event, offering night running. It attracted more than 1100 participants in previous years. The event location is Szeged, Népkert Street, and the program includes the half marathon and the family sports day.
