description: The VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route consists of 80% dirt roads, wagon paths, and trails, offering varied terrain and unparalleled panoramic views for the runners. There are five different distances to choose from, with the 22 km and shorter routes also suitable for hiking. The race features unique finisher medals, refreshment points, and hot meals for participants, while the organizers maintain an environmentally conscious, green event.
course_highlights: 80% dirt roads, wagon paths, trails
Magnificent panorama of the Balaton Uplands
Refreshment points at wine cellars
additional: Unique finisher medal for every participant. Refreshments along the route and at the start and finish zones include water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruits, chips, nougat, and greasy bread. Hot meals are available at the finish line, meatless options included. The race is a "green" event, so participants are asked to bring their own cups and water bottles. Timing chips require a deposit of 1000 HUF. The top 3 male and female finishers will be awarded medals, trophies, and supporter gifts during the award ceremony. Registration is online. Refreshments and food are provided. The event emphasizes environmental sustainability, with a registration fee and eco-friendly practices.

description: The Full Moon Run is a night race in Esztergom, taking place along the scenic routes of Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside bike path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km, and 15 km, with the 15 km route also passing through Prímás-sziget. Participants are required to wear a headlamp or other lighting device, as some parts of the course are unlit. The event is organized by the Esztergomi Futóművek Amateur Sports Club and is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Esztergom Várhegy, Víziváros, and riverside bike path route
15 km distance passing through Prímás-sziget
Cobblestone sections and unlit bike path segments
additional: A functioning headlamp or other lighting device is mandatory for the race. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, awarding 1 point for the 4 km, 2 points for the 10 km, and 3 points for the 15 km. Online registration confirmation will be sent as an attachment to the email receipt, while on-site registration results will be available within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and ECO registration options without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include terrain conditions, registration information, and event rules; additionally, the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Complex, Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi Mountains, Leaota Mountains, and Piatra Craiului. The event offers six individual race options, with distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultra-marathon. Participants can enjoy spectacular landscapes and a unique outdoor experience in a friendly and well-organized setting. Registrations are limited and can be made online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountains: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to 102 km ultra-marathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: The start will be on the same day, July 4, 2026, from Cheile Grădiștei Complex, the event's epicenter. Registrations are limited and can be made online. The organizer may grant wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. A code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the routes and ensure safety. Participation is via an online form, with registration limits and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and the peaks of the Nemira massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suitable for experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shaded forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
Tourist marking in 90% of the course and additional signage in difficult areas
Significant elevation changes with spectacular ascents and descents
additional: The routes include marathon, half-marathon, and cross races, with positive elevation gains between 700 m and 2400 m. The start is from the Central Park of Slănic Moldova resort. The courses are 80-90% runnable, featuring forest roads, alpine trails, and rugged zones. Organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a race for children to encourage outdoor running. The event includes routes for children, emphasizing ecotourism and community involvement, providing information about registrations, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and fundraising for humanitarian causes. Participants cover three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race, all runners are invited to a lunch at the Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation changes (e.g., 30 km with 2000 m elevation gain)
Passing through localities, alpine meadows, wooded areas, and mountain peaks
Routes including segments with fixed ropes and rugged terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Number distribution takes place in two stages: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The start for the Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes is at 08:00, and for the Turnu (4 km) route at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children's race is held at the Turnu Monastery Camping with a start at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to a lunch after the Holy Liturgy at the Turnu Monastery. Mountain routes, 8-hour time limit, for participants over 18 years old, emphasizing running and hiking, promoting the natural and cultural beauty of the area.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the cause of Vasil Levski. The competition offers various routes with different levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. The organizers are the association "Troyan in the Future," which works to promote the historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sports. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of different lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km, and 70 km with varying elevation
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan with natural and historical landmarks
Opportunity to participate for both professionals and amateurs
additional: Start packages are received on-site with priority given to longer distances. It is mandatory to wear a race number, carry a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and have a mobile phone with the organizers' contact number. The program includes a technical conference and an award ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events for an active lifestyle.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Vârșeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural environment of Vârșeț, with the start located in front of the Medicus Hotel. Participants can choose between an ultra distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. This race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for active relaxation in the Vârșeț national resort.
course_highlights: Mountain running with diverse distances
Start in front of Medicus Hotel in Vârșeț
Routes through picturesque natural environment
additional: Registration package available at Vârșeț municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12-13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start from Medicus Hotel. Online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Piasatsi is a unique running event held on July 4, 2026, on Bulgaria's longest beach strip between Kamchia Holiday Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River with safety measures and auxiliary equipment provided. The race offers two main distances - 10 km and 21.1 km, as well as a children's run of 2.2 km. The organizer is the 'Green Step' club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely sandy and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River
Distances are 10 km and 21.1 km with refreshment points approximately every 5 km
Opportunity to run barefoot and safety measures are provided for river crossing
additional: The start is in the evening, with race numbers distributed from 15:00 and luggage storage available. Cut-off time is 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3:30 hours for 10 km. Children can participate free of charge in the 2.2 km children's run. Participants are required to carry a water container for refreshment points. Timing is with RFID chips. In adverse conditions, crossing the river may be done by boats provided by the organizers. Distances include 10 km and 21.1 km, with refreshment points every approximately 5 km, online registration options, fees via EasyPay or ePay, and options for accompaniment and children under 7 years with a guardian.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour with Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short trail of 650 meters leads to an impressive peak at 1622 meters above sea level, offering beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well-marked and suitable for all guests, with the ascent taking about 30 minutes, providing an opportunity to enjoy nature and take photographs. Organized tours are available for all accommodation guests, with transportation to the starting point of the trail.
course_highlights: Ascent of 52 meters from 1570 m to 1622 m above sea level
Panoramic views of Pančićev vrh, Radočelo, Golija, and surrounding mountains
The trail is well-marked and safe for hiking
additional: Transportation to the starting point of the trail is organized by the host's minibus for accommodation guests. The return trip takes approximately 30 minutes in total. The tour is available only for Kežman Mountain Houses guests. Participants can expect a guided tour, a short walk with spectacular views, a steep ascent, and a well-marked trail.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: Athletic race around Avala is a traditional event organized by the Athletic Veterans Association of Serbia. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Avala and gathers runners of various ages and levels of preparedness. This race is an opportunity for sports socializing and promoting athletics among veterans and recreational runners. The start and finish lines are at an attractive location, and the course offers challenges and enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Course around Mount Avala
Natural environment and forested areas
Race adapted for veterans and recreational runners
additional: Participants can expect competitions over various distances, including a half marathon, with the possibility of scoring for national and international series. Registrations are open to a large number of competitors, and the event is supported by local sponsors and the community.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the proximity of nature, allowing participants to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and offers an engaging program for both runners and spectators. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike and is an important event in the local sports scene.
course_highlights: Relay running on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-oriented course with forest and agricultural sections
Family-friendly, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club, which supports multiple sports. The event is part of the Sprint Running Club's activities, with several sections traditionally involved in organizing. Maps and previous results are available on the website, but specific prices or start times are not listed on the provided page. In addition to relay running, the event offers other sports activities, with detailed registration and participation information available on the organizer's website.

name: Вършец рън
description: Vâršeț Run and Vâršeț Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, including children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort of Vâršeț, with the start line in front of the Medicus Hotel. The routes include an ultra distance of 48 km, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, providing opportunities for participation at different levels. Registration is done through the platform runbulgaria.org, and start packages are received in the municipality of Vâršeț.
course_highlights: Mountain running with an ultra distance of 48 km
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
Children's and beginner's distance of 1 km
additional: The start is in front of the Medicus Hotel. The start package is received in the municipality of Vâršeț. Registration is via the platform runbulgaria.org. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of the Medicus Hotel; registration at www.runbulgaria.org.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnički ultramaraton 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia that brings together enthusiasts of nature, endurance, and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, starting and finishing at the Cultural Center Plaza. All routes are new and do not repeat from previous editions, and the races are adapted to different levels of preparedness and race categories. Participants receive a start package with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher's medal, and the organization also provides support for accommodation and meals.
course_highlights: Three races of different lengths: Maxi (60.9 km), Midi (24.8 km), Mini (14.6 km)
Routes are completely new and do not repeat from the previous ultramarathon
Time limits: Maxi 12h, Midi 7h, Mini 5h
additional: The start package includes a T-shirt (size guaranteed for registrations with payment by June 20, 2026), promotional materials from the Prijepolje Tourist Organization, finisher medals for all who complete the race, medals and trophies for winners in categories. Free accommodation in the gymnasium of Elementary School "Valter" (sleeping bags required). The organizer reserves the right to modify routes with prior notice. Participants can expect details about registration, medals, T-shirts, and timing on official platforms. The event also includes services such as timing and event promotion.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in the spectacular landscapes of the Carpathian Mountains, in the Stâna de Vale resort, Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner-friendly routes to challenging mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked trails, full support along the way, and a friendly atmosphere after the race. The race weekend includes an 8 km vertical race, an 11 km classic race, and a 33 km long race with significant elevation changes.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 33 km with 1500 m positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
11 km trail suitable for beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
8 km vertical race with 1100 m elevation gain, with continuous and demanding ascent
additional: The event takes place on July 10-11, 2026, with race packets pickup at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The 8K Vertical Race starts on Friday at 10:00 AM, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30 respectively. Organizers provide a meal after the race and a celebration after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35-79 age category. The routes are in mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to match their level of preparation.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including an ultra race of 103 km with a elevation gain of over 5000 meters. ZUT is more than a competition; it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting the spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, providing an authentic trail running experience in impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: ULTRA route of 103 km with 5255 m elevation gain
Well-equipped refreshment and control points along the route
Variety of races: from 2.5 km for children to the 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races adapted to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and refreshment points offer water, isotonic drinks, fruits, and hot food along the ultra route. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also has an ecological awareness component.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was organized for the first time by the Citizens' Association "Jadovnik" on the eponymous mountain. The race aims to highlight the beauty and richness of the flora and fauna of Jadovnik Mountain, which has been little known to the public so far. This ultramarathon offers a unique opportunity for runners to experience the challenge and special thrill of running in pristine nature. The organizers wish to preserve and promote this mountain through sport and community.
course_highlights: The trail runs through Jadovnik Mountain, rich in flora and fauna
The race takes place in untouched nature with a specific mountain environment
A unique opportunity to explore a lesser-known mountain in Serbia
additional: Participants must have mandatory equipment, the race is limited to 100 runners, and the route includes forest paths and asphalt sections.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Starry Night Run is a special night run event held at the Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are expected on July 11th in the summer Balaton lakeside environment. The new location offers the advantage of a wider start-finish corridor, a solid paved surface throughout, and full lighting along the route. Participants can choose from distances of 3.5 km, 7 km, and 10.5 km, as well as walking and a 500-meter distance for children. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of night running together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár Platán Beach in a beautiful Balaton lakeside setting
Wide start-finish corridor and solid paved surface
Full lighting along the entire route ensuring a safe night run
additional: Walking is also an option for the 3.5 km distance, and children can compete over 500 meters. Full route lighting ensures safe night running. The new location features a wider start-finish corridor and a solid paved surface. The event is part of Balaton's summer activities, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer running race held between Barcs and Heresznye, now in its fifth edition. Participants from several counties take part in the race, which is divided into separate categories for men and women. The route is diverse, and in previous years, record times have been set, demonstrating the race's seriousness and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, providing a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance between Barcs and Heresznye
Diverse route allowing for record times
Participants from six counties
additional: The event also features multiple sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and races are generally held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake Running Race is a traditional, family-friendly running event near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the picturesque Köcsi Lake. The race warmly welcomes all who wish to run or walk, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity of nature and the community sports experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sports and environmental protection. The race offers multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge.
course_highlights: Nature-close running track around Köcsi Lake
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
Multiple distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, categorized by age groups. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Participants can access photos on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment stations, beach bathing options, finisher medals.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail running routes suitable for all levels of fitness, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, providing a complete mountain running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Piatra Mare mountain.
course_highlights: 100% trail run routes through forests and mountain trails
Challenging ascents, including over 500 m elevation gain over 4 km at K24
Spectacular views from Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Piatra Mare Peak, and Garbova Cabin
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cross, K24 Half Marathon, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Marathon, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is from the base of the Clăbucet slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape with the Predeal Forest Run red logo and are supported by volunteers. Time limits and refreshment points are set for the competitive races. The participation kit will be announced later. Participants can register for various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Details about registration and rules are available on the official website.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
location: Язовир Батак, Батак, Бургаска област, България
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, Полумаратон, 10 km, 1.9 km, 0.9 km

description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The competition offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and provides support stations, and the atmosphere is filled with friendliness and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swimming, 90 km cycling, 21 km running
Turbo: 0.9 km swimming, 52 km cycling, 10 km running
Legend Relay: same distance as Legend, but in teams of two or three
additional: Marked course, support stations, limited spots for each distance (Legend - 120, Turbo - 60, Legend Relay - 20 teams). The event promotes community and friendship among participants. Distances: Legend (1.9 km swimming, 90 km cycling, 21 km running), Turbo (0.9 km swimming, 52 km cycling, 10 km running), Relay (same as Legend, in teams). Registration with different prices and locations. The event is part of the legendary experience in the Rhodopes and is suitable for both advanced and beginner athletes.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérci Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationwide running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of Sri Chinmoy, the peace philosopher. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on diverse terrains in a scenic environment. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcomed.
course_highlights: Close-to-nature, diverse terrain
Scenic environment in the Lázbérci landscape
Organized in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will be held in 2026, and the organizers aim to unite the community of peace and running.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an amateur competitive athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of various levels of preparation. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for everyone interested to participate in a sports atmosphere that supports diversity and community.
course_highlights: Middle and long distances
Organized but amateur competition
Held in Sofia
additional: The event is part of an initiative to promote running and a healthy lifestyle in Bulgaria.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race caters to both children and adults across multiple distances, with unique finisher medals that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The start/finish point is located at the Lussonium Ruin Garden, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available. The race is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging terrain with steep ascents
Exciting start and finish location at the Lussonium Ruin Garden
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid registrations and accepts up to 400 runners, including a maximum of 100 in the preschool and elementary school categories. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. Registration without a medal is also possible at a lower cost. The race is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments will be available for participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, making it ideal for families.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Bate Toaca Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main routes: the Dochia Race of 18 km with an elevation gain of approximately 1500 m and the Bate Toaca Race of 31 km with an elevation gain of approximately 2700 m. The routes pass through spectacular landscapes, including Dochia Cabin, Lespezi Peak, and Toaca Peak, providing an authentic and challenging mountain experience for runners. Organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation differences (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular landscapes in the Durău area, including Toaca Peak and Dochia Cabin
Marked routes with various symbols (red ribbon, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The routes are well marked with different symbols and include ascents and descents on stairs at Toaca Peak. Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is the SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț Association. Phone contact is available for logistics and secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registrations and participation.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running competition organized by the Association Sport fără Limite Vâlcea, which promotes the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in the town of Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers various races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose between children's races, cross-country runs, and mountain trails of 11 km, 18 km, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular landscapes and authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Buila-Vânturarița National Park
Spectacular landscapes and protected nature
Various events: children, 11 km cross-country, 18 km and 36 km trails
additional: The event promotes ecotourism, nature, and local culture, providing an opportunity for trail running and mountain hiking enthusiasts.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
price_range: semi-maraton 200 Lei, cros 175 Lei, cursele copiilor 50 Lei
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running race held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on July 18, 2026. The event includes three courses on picturesque subalpine trails, with significant elevation changes, suitable for both adults and children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the registration fee, and after the race, runners are invited to a brunch with local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the conservation of the mountain cultural heritage of the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.
course_highlights: Picturesque subalpine trails with elevation differences between +30 m and +1000 m
14 km cross with +900 m elevation gain and 21 km half marathon with +1000 m elevation gain
Trails for children and teenagers with small elevation differences, adapted to age
additional: Number pickup is between 06:30 and 07:30, the technical meeting is at 07:45, and the start for adults is at 09:00, while for children it is at 11:00. Hydration stations are located every 5 km along the route. Parking is available at the school in the village center and in the Beberani area, approximately 100 meters from the start. After the race, participants are invited to a brunch with local products, and a 50 lei donation is included in the registration fee to support the Țara Colibelor project. mountain trails, online registration, included donation, post-race brunch

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon race offering challenging distances in the beautiful nature of the Balkan around the town of Tryavna. The race includes runs of 100 km, 42 km, and 21 km, as well as cycling routes and duathlon. The courses feature diverse terrain and include numerous support points, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. The organizer is the iRun association, which has extensive experience in organizing sports events and building a sports community.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances from 21 km to 100 km
Diverse mountain terrain with elevation profiles up to over 1500 m
Multiple support points along the courses
additional: The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon with combined distances. The organizer iRun is an association with over 50 sports events held. The website provides information on accommodation, the history of the race, and results from previous years. Multiple distances for running, cycling, and duathlon; event with technical conferences and starter packs; held in the town of Tryavna, Bulgaria.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: The FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, non-profit running race scheduled for Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM in Dunabogdány. The race offers two challenging distances: 6.1 km with 205 meters of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 meters of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique, metal finisher medal measuring 60x60 mm, and the top performers are awarded in both age categories and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and on-site registration modifications are available. The participation is limited to a maximum of 200 runners.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m elevation gain
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal
additional: Registration is also possible on-site with an increased fee. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit for the race. During registration, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and if available, their race bib number from home. Those without a bib will receive a paper bib. Participants' names will appear on the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation differences, awards, age categories, unique metal finisher medals, online and on-site registration, limited to 200 participants.

name: FUTABUDA
description: The FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM at the Dunabogdány, Kisoroszi ferry dock. The race features two distances: 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes, posing a challenge for runners. Participants receive a unique metal finisher medal, and the top performers are awarded prizes. The event is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it. Registration is simple and can be done online or via email, with on-site registration available at an increased fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal for finishers
additional: At registration, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and optionally a bib number. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a nonprofit, self-funded event with a limit of 200 participants. Prizes are awarded for breaking male and female course records, the absolute 1st to 3rd places, and the top 3 in each age category. On-site registration is available at an increased fee. Bib numbers can be collected on-site or via advance transfer after 9:30 AM. The event offers medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is possible online and on-site, providing a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: Trail race Kopaonik 2026
description: The Kopaonik trail race is a traditional event that brings together trail running enthusiasts and nature lovers in the Kopaonik National Park. With three routes of different lengths - 7 km, 15 km, and 24 km - the race offers an opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners to enjoy beautiful forest and meadow landscapes, clean mountain air, and pleasant temperatures. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a music program, organized walks, and a children's race. Organizers provide complete trail marking, electronic timing, T-shirts, medals, refreshments, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: The 7K Kopaonik route passes through the Crvena Bara region and near the Markov Kamen picnic area
The 15K Kopaonik route goes over Gobelja peak, Mekih Presedla, and Likina Česma
The 24K Kopaonik route has a elevation difference of 900 meters and a time limit of 6 hours
additional: The start of all routes is at the Sports Valley at 10 AM. The routes have time limits: 7K - 3 hours, 15K - 4 hours, 24K - 6 hours. Refreshment zones and medical assistance are provided along the routes. Participants who register by July 6, 2026, receive an official race T-shirt. Electronic timing with chip, online results, and diplomas are available. The race is individual, and registrations are only accepted online via njuko.com; same-day on-site registration is not possible. Participation includes electronic timing, finisher medals, refreshment zones, medical assistance, and GPS navigation; registration through njuko.com only.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe's last authentic wilderness regions. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes traverse rocky ridges, UNESCO untouched forests, medieval shepherds' huts, and stunning natural landscapes such as Cheile Moara Dracului and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with each kilometer offering a unique experience in European wilderness.
course_highlights: Trails through Slătioara Forest, a UNESCO candidate
Steep ascents and technical trails in the Carpathian Mountains
Spectacular natural landscapes: Cheile Moara Dracului and Pietrele Doamnei
additional: The Ultra Rocks (114 km) race starts just before midnight from Câmpulung Moldovenesc. The route includes an initial loop through the town, followed by passage through wild areas and control points with facilities such as Live Cooking. The event takes place in the Ultra Trail Village at the Central Plateau of Câmpulung Moldovenesc, near the Town Hall. Multiple mountain race distances, technical routes, location in Romania, registration details, and rules are available on the official websites and social media channels.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: The Gaja Valley Trail is a trail running event organized by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on July 25, 2026, in Fehérvárcsurgó, around the Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances, with the focus not on competition but on the joy of movement, community experience, and close contact with nature. The event aims to promote running at all levels, from beginners to advanced, in a pleasant summer forest environment. The start and finish are at the visitor center of the Károlyi Castle, and the sound of the Gaja stream and the silence of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Path along the castle, water reservoir, and bubbling Gaja stream
Spectacular forest trails in the Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle visitor center as the start and finish point
additional: The Gaja Valley Trail is not a race, with no timing, so beginners, amateurs, and hobby runners can participate. Every participant receives a finisher medal. The event has a community atmosphere, promoting a healthy lifestyle and close contact with nature. In addition to trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling endurance tours. The location is easily accessible, the terrain is varied, and rich in natural values.

name: Балкан ултра
description: The Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area of Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The routes include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountaineering skills. Participants can choose between two main distances - Sky and Ultra, each with a unique route through beautiful and difficult mountain terrains. The race offers stunning views and diverse trails, including crossing peaks such as Botev and the Milk Chute.
course_highlights: Technical sections with significant elevation gain and ascent to Botev Peak
Riding along the mountain ridge with varied terrain and steep descents
Long ridge running and passing through multiple huts and control points
additional: Participants in the Ultra distance must have valid mountain insurance and have completed two races with at least 4000 meters of elevation gain in the last 3 years. For the Sky distance, participation is free. A GPS device is mandatory for navigation along the provided GPS track. There are control points with cut-off times, for example at Petolachka - 10 hours. The routes include technical sections; options for accommodation include Pleven Hut, camping, or Apriltsi; the race length is approximately 78 km, with a record under 13 hours.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National Championship for boys and girls under 18 is one of the most popular competitions in the sports calendar of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The competition includes various disciplines, with discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championship gathers young athletes from across the country, providing them with the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Athletics disciplines for boys and girls under 18
Discus and hammer events at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad
Held at the National Stadium "Vasil Levski"
additional: Location: Pravets; disciplines: long jump and triple jump; date: July 25, 2026

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly and family-oriented race held every year in Monorierdő at Makkos Park. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes at Makkos Park. The event's highlight is the live music refreshment point, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and movement, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and ends at Makkos Park
Live music refreshment point with "The Little Pea" band
Various distances available to suit runners' preferences
additional: The train station is only 200 meters from the race venue, making it easily accessible by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that ensures timely arrival for bib pickup. The event is part of the Ötpróba series, with online registration available until July 18, and additional sports and leisure events are organized for participants related to the race.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Stone Land Half Marathon is a running race held on July 26, 2026, in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose between three races of different distances, running on routes that pass through the historic and natural landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains, imbued with the spirit of the ancestors. The start is scheduled at 8:00 AM, and transportation to the starting line is provided by coaches. The race kit can be picked up on Saturday and Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Historic route on Avram Iancu's path
Hydration points at km 5, 12.5, 17.5, and 20
Total ascent of 178 m and total descent of 332 m on the 22 km route
additional: Transportation is provided by coaches from 7:00 AM from the center of Câmpeni to the start line; race kits can be collected on Saturday between 14:00-20:00 and on Sunday until 07:00; hydration points along the route; meeting and registration between 05:30-07:30 at the Avram Iancu Statue in Câmpeni. Participation includes multiple starts, transportation to the start with partner Arieșul SA, race kit pickup, and artistic and traditional programming during the event.

name: FAGARAS ROCKS!
organizer: A C U M - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event that offers a unique experience on spectacular routes in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic landscapes and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, with multiple peaks over 2500 m and over 50 km of running at altitudes above 2000 m, taking place in a semi-autonomous regime. The event includes several races with varied distances, aimed at both experienced runners and younger or amateur participants, providing a friendly atmosphere and related activities for participants and their families. Organizers provide facilities such as refreshment points, medical assistance, hot meals on the route, finisher medals, and cash prizes for mountain races.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of routes in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks over 2500 m and 15 peaks over 2200 m
50 km of running at altitudes above 2000 m
additional: Participants receive a personalized race number (non-personalized after July 15), live satellite tracking for #TheWildTruth, hot meals on the route for #TheWildTruth, engraved stone finisher medals, a superlight technical tank top for the first 300 registered in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and thematic workshops, refreshment and hydration points, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. Multiple race categories, information about camping and parking, the event includes ultra and skyrace.

name: Fagaras Rocks ~ 2026
organizer: ACUM - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event in semi-autonomous mode, offering a unique experience on spectacular routes in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic landscapes and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, reaching peaks over 2500 meters and providing 50 km of running at altitudes over 2000 meters. The event includes several races with different distances and difficulties, aimed at both experienced runners and younger or amateur participants. Participants benefit from a complete registration package, with dedicated services and facilities for a full and safe experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of routes arranged in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks over 2500 m and 15 peaks over 2200 m
50 km of running at altitudes over 2000 m
additional: The participation package includes a personalized race number (for registrations until July 15), live satellite tracking for the #TheWildTruth race, cash prizes for mountain races, hot meal on the route for #TheWildTruth, engraved stone finisher medal, superlight technical t-shirt for the first 300 registered in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and thematic workshops, medical assistance, refreshment and hydration points, parking for 360 cars, massage tents and post-race feedback. The event includes camping, parking, and details about the competition schedule, providing an opportunity to experience mountain adventure and discover the natural beauty of the area.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports-recreational event intended for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three trails of different lengths: Fan hiking (7 km), Hobby trail (11 km), and Sport trail (19 km). The start is at 9 PM at the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the trail, allowing even the slowest to successfully finish the race. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the night in the nature of Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: Three trails: 7 km, 11 km, and 19 km
Start at 9 PM at the Na Vencu restaurant
Trail limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes
additional: The trails are limited to 4 hours and 15 minutes, enabling even the slowest participants to finish. The event is designed for hikers, runners, and nature enthusiasts, as well as lovers of Fruška Gora. It includes trails suitable for different levels of fitness, and the routes are appropriate for both hikers and runners. The competition promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in nature.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriško venac, Fruška gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the pristine nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Memorial Sloboda, Iriški Venc. Participants can choose between two routes of 7 km and 13 km that pass through dense forests and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake. The race combines adrenaline-fueled obstacles with beautiful landscapes and concludes in an atmosphere of camaraderie and season-end celebration. This event is part of the Invictus OCR league and is open to everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Trails through dense forests of Fruška Gora
Water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake
Night race with mandatory headlamp and adrenaline-filled darkness crossing
additional: Start and finish are at Iriški Venc near the restaurant “Na Vencu”. A headlamp is mandatory for the night race. The competition is part of the Invictus OCR league with scoring at three locations. Each participant receives a medal at the finish line. The race is adapted to different levels of physical fitness. The event is part of a challenge that combines obstacle search and trail running, providing a unique experience in the nature of Fruška Gora.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: The Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Participants start from the starting area next to the sports field and can choose from various distances, which lead through diverse terrain, forests, and hills. The organizers promise excellent organization and a pleasant running experience, while participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on diverse forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and its surroundings
Various distances, including a strictly trail half marathon
additional: The race center has toilets, washbasins, and showers. Parking is available on the grassy area next to the football field. Technical shirts or T-shirts can be ordered at a flat rate of 4600 HUF during registration. There is a participant limit: a total of 300 people for the three longer distances, and an additional 100 for the Bulifutam. Registration for the race is open from March 12, 2026, to July 30, 2026; the start is scheduled for August 1, 2026, at 09:00. Race packets can be picked up between 07:00 and 08:30 at the venue or at the Cultural Center. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is a traditional race organized by the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large parking lot near Lake and Beach in Orfű. During the race, participants must circle Lake Pécs once or twice on a public road, in the same direction as the clock, not on the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event where participation is at everyone's own risk, and both professionals and amateurs can compete. The event is supported by Barta Textile House and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on time results.
course_highlights: 6.2 km loop around Lake Pécs on a public road
12.4 km distance by circling Lake Pécs twice
The race takes place on the public road, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and results announcement are only available for the race, with winners awarded a trophy. Material prizes are distributed by raffle, giving all participants an equal chance. The event also serves as a family program, with well-equipped playgrounds available for children. Participants run at their own risk; the venue is around Lake Pécs and the large parking lot of the beach. The event date is August 3, 2024.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
price_range: 140 Lei - 220 Lei, cu reduceri pentru copii și juniori

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Copii și juniori sub 18 ani 120 Lei

description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, accumulating laps on the mountain trail to reach a total elevation of Everesting. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging and community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Participation fees are affordable, and registrations are open until spots are filled.
course_highlights: Mountain trail with elevation accumulation similar to Everesting
Ability to compete individually or in teams
Scenic location at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș
additional: Participants can compete both individually and in teams (minimum 5 members). The team ranking is based on the total number of laps completed by all members. Participation fees are non-refundable. Confirmation of registration is sent immediately after payment processing via email. There is an official T-shirt and partnerships to support participants. The event also includes endurance cycling, scheduled for July 31 and August 1, 2026, with participation fees, regulations, and results available on the website.

name: MOGOȘA EVERESTING
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, in Mogoșa, Maramureș. Participants can compete individually or in teams, with the team ranking based on the total number of laps completed by all members. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers an authentic mountain running experience, emphasizing effort and team spirit. Participation fees are affordable, and there is a special category for children and juniors under 18.
course_highlights: Mountain running on a trail with multiple laps
Team ranking based on the total number of laps completed
Individual and team participation (minimum 5 members)
additional: Participants receive a participant kit. After July 26, registrations are accepted subject to availability. Teams must have at least 5 members officially registered with the same team name. Confirmation of registration is sent immediately after payment processing via email. Participation fees are non-refundable. Participation includes a kit and official T-shirt. The event features multiple categories and takes place on mountainous terrain with repeated ascents; registration fees vary depending on the date.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour events for MTB and trail running, both individual and team categories, as well as a 12-hour running race and a 10.5 km loop race. The course is a loop approximately 10.5 km long with a elevation gain of 215 meters, mostly through the forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and passion for outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Trail course of 10.5 km with 215 m positive elevation gain
Mostly through the forest of the Cornești Plateau
Course marked with visible bands during the day and reflective signs at night
additional: The event includes 24-hour MTB and trail running races for individuals and 4-member relay teams, a 12-hour individual race, and a 10.5 km loop race. The time limit for completing a loop is 2 hours for MTB and 3 hours for running. Participants can store their personal equipment in tents at the start/finish area. Rankings are based on the distance covered within the allocated time. The event features multiple categories, awards for the best performers, and takes place in the natural environment of the Cornești Plateau, Târgu Mureș.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: Luminous Circles, 11th edition, is a running event organized in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara, taking place on August 1, 2026, starting at 8:30 PM. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor race in an urban natural setting, ideal for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation for adopting running, encouraging community involvement.
course_highlights: Route in Franz Joseph Park, Timișoara
Night event with start at 8:30 PM
Friendly atmosphere and active running community
additional: The event is part of the Alergotura series, which offers free access to the Politehnica Timișoara running base for club members and organizes team-building activities. No information was found about participation fees or online registration for this edition. The event also includes weekly runs and other sports activities in Timișoara, promoting health and socialization within the community.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
