description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will be held in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The competition includes distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon, as well as starts for children and beginners. The event is part of the "Run Bulgaria" series and offers a prize fund of over 4000 BGN. This is an important opportunity for amateurs and professionals to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and World Championships.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 mile (1609 m), 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon 21.1 km
The race takes place in Plovdiv, one of the major cities in Bulgaria
Includes starts for children and beginners at 1 km
additional: The mass 1 km run is free for everyone. Before the championship, there will be activities in Children's Athletics and a press conference with awards for the best runners of 2024. The event is part of the "Run Bulgaria" series and serves as preparation for the European road running championship. Distances: 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, 1 km for children and beginners; online registration; fee of 40 BGN for some distances; free mass start for 1 km.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting Trail Run competition held in Northwestern Bulgaria, in the area of Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose between different routes with varying difficulty and technical elements, running amidst stunning mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of achievement on each trail. Organizers recommend using trail running shoes and remind that the event may be canceled in adverse weather conditions.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with varying difficulty and technical elements
Breathtaking views in Northwestern Bulgaria between the Iskar and Timoch rivers
Opportunity to summit peaks and run in nature
additional: Reservation must be made at least one week before the chosen date. The races do not include transportation to the venue. Participants are required to use specialized trail running shoes. The voucher is valid for one participant. The event may be canceled in bad weather conditions. Information about the course, registration, and participation conditions is not available; the event is part of trail running in Northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slavyanski Mountains Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the vicinity of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers various distances from 9 to 56 km with different levels of difficulty and elevation gain up to 2900 meters. Participants can enjoy picturesque forests, panoramic views, and clean air, combining sport, adventure, and love for the mountain. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both advanced runners and cyclists, as well as enthusiasts seeking new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with elevation gain up to 2900 m
Trail through picturesque forests and panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The starter pack includes a medal, a souvenir with the event logo, timing, a race number, trail marking, photo coverage, and refreshment points. It does not include additional or mandatory equipment. Registration with lower fees until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59, payment by May 2 at 12:00. Early registration fees include medals, starter packs, and refreshment points.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event from the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, Western Rhodopes. The start and finish are at "Olympic" Square at an altitude of 1,062 meters. The routes pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic mountain trails with a maximum elevation of 1,872 meters. Participants can choose between three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.
course_highlights: The routes pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
Panoramic mountain trails with a maximum elevation of 1,872 meters
Three distances with ascent up to +1,887 meters and descent up to −1,885 meters
additional: Free parking opens at 05:00 at SOU "Vasil Dechev". Registration and distribution of start packages are from 6:30 to 8:00 at "Olympic" Square, with the possibility of paying on site via Revolut, PayPal, or ePay. Starts for mountain biking and running are divided by distances and begin between 8:30 and 9:30. There is a children's run and a children's program with yoga, games, and cake. Awards for children and all distances are scheduled for the afternoon hours. The event includes various distances and participation packages, with the start for mountain biking scheduled for 08:30 on August 1, 2026.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúr Overachievement Running Festival is a family-friendly race that combines the closeness of nature with the spirit of surpassing oneself. The race takes place in the Keresztúr Forest near Budapest and offers challenging distances including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km, and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. This event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has been supporting running enthusiasts since 1977. The goal of the race is for every participant to experience sports camaraderie and the joy of exceeding their limits.
course_highlights: Keresztúr Forest, nature-close running track
Forest nature trail and running circuit with short road sections
Yes, I can! race with hourly starts, approximately 5,274 m per lap
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The registration fee does not include a T-shirt, but there is an option to pre-order a commemorative technical T-shirt. The Yes, I can! race consists of 6 laps, with starts every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 focuses on surpassing oneself. Participants support each other in completing the race, and late starts will result in disqualification. Multiple distances are available for participation, and registration on-site is possible. Detailed fee and T-shirt information can be found on the organizer's website.

name: Balkaniada West

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: От 05.01.26 до 31.01.26 включително ще можете да се възползвате от 10% намаление при регистрация с промо код "BALKANIADA10"!

description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on August 2, 2026, starting at 06:00 AM. The race includes several distances of varying lengths and positive elevation gain, with routes passing through scenic mountain areas around the Gorski Ray hut. The event has a limited number of participants and requires prior approval of registration applications. Organizers provide transportation, overnight stays, food, and branded clothing for those who finish within the control time.
course_highlights: Vertical Kilometer: 3.8 km with 830 m positive elevation gain
Distances: 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Prologue of 10 km with 900 m positive elevation gain from Chuprene village to Gorski Ray hut (no time tracking)
additional: The race is limited to 30 participants (for the first edition). You must have completed races with control times from 2025 or provide evidence of similar achievements. Organized transportation is available from Sofia to Kom hut and from Kom hut to Chuprene village. Accommodation, dinner, and breakfast are included at the Kom and Gorski Ray huts. Every finisher receives branded clothing. The event includes a prologue, organized transportation, overnight stays, breakfasts, and branded clothing for finishers. Participation is limited to 30, with selection based on experience.

name: Ultra Race Romania

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Avans de 500€ urmat de 5 rate lunare de 475€ fiecare

description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race held over 250 km divided into 6 stages, in self-sufficient mode, exploring the pure wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu, Buzău area. Participants will traverse a challenging route in the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary landscapes and places filled with stories and local mysteries. After completing the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania's traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions such as Peles Castle and Bran Castle. The event emphasizes life experience, long-term friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.
course_highlights: 250 km route divided into 6 stages in the Carpathian Mountains
Legendary sites such as Vulturilor Lake and Cascada Cașoca
Wild landscapes and local mysteries in the Buzău area
additional: The race is self-sufficient, with camping in tents during the 6 stages. Medical assistance, water at control points and camps, hot meals, bus transportation before and after the race, medals, and finisher T-shirts are provided. After the race, a 2-day cultural tour is organized in Brașov, Bran, and Sinaia, with hotel accommodation and meals included. Satellite SPOT live tracking is available for competitors. Participants must be prepared for wilderness conditions, with mandatory equipment and strict safety rules; the event also includes a cultural excursion after the race.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run in Kecskemét is held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center and offers a running experience as a sporty addition to the jazz festival. The event traditionally emphasizes the joy of running and community experience, open to all age groups and running types. The race is not only a sports event but also strengthens the local community, allowing participants to move in a beautiful environment with fresh air. The organizers also value charity, making the run an opportunity for support.
course_highlights: Runs take place in a beautiful natural environment under lovely trees
The race is a sporting side event of the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, with community programs and charity actions connected to it alongside the run. Runners can enjoy movement in a pleasant natural environment with good air quality. Multiple distances are available for participation, with online or on-site registration. Participants receive a T-shirt with the race logo and snacks and mineral water at the finish line. The festival programs are free for runners.

name: Retezat Mountain Run
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Râușor area, Hunedoara, offering four races with different difficulties and distances, from Easy Run to Marathon. The routes pass through wild and hard-to-access landscapes of Retezat National Park, with support points in spectacular natural areas, including the Bucura glacial lake. The event is organized by a non-profit association dedicated to mountain conservation and involves a team of volunteers and professionals to ensure safety and smooth operation. Participants enjoy an authentic mountain running experience, with cash and object prizes, as well as a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation differences, up to 3340 m D+ at the marathon
Support points in wild areas accessible only on foot or by air
The route passes near Bucura glacial lake, the largest glacial lake in Romania
additional: Registration and kit distribution take place on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, the base of the slope. There is a technical briefing and a Pasta Party before the race. Mandatory equipment includes mountain running shoes and windstopper/rain gear. The routes are marked and supervised by volunteers, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between support points. It is recommended to leave the car in the parking lot at the end of the asphalt road, with a 10-minute walk to the race area. Varying distances, extensive logistical support, online registration option, event with tradition and recognition in the mountain community.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Dumbrava Running is a social-sport-charity event promoting outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle, held in Homu Forest, north of Glogoveanu village, Dâmbovița County. The event includes marathon, half-marathon, and cross races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an experience in nature with accessible trails on paths and dirt roads. The atmosphere is complemented by recreational activities such as Latin dances and a campfire, creating a warm and welcoming community. This is a traditional edition, in its seventh organization, which also supports an important social cause by assisting the Mia’s Children Association.
course_highlights: Easy trails on paths and dirt roads in Homu Forest
Varied landscapes between ancient forest and colorful agricultural lands
Trails without asphalt or concrete, ideal for natural running
additional: The event includes races for children "In Memoriam" Professor Liviu Marinescu, Latin dances, and a campfire (depending on weather conditions). Participants must send proof of payment of the participation fee via email or WhatsApp. The fee can also be paid via bank transfer or Revolut. The trails are accessible and without major difficulties, without asphalt or concrete. The event is dedicated to the memory of local personalities and supports the Mia’s Children Association. Semi-marathon routes (21 km), cross (10 km), and children's races (4.2 km), staggered starts, social and cultural activities.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
location: Rausor, Retezat Mountains, Hunedoara County, Romania
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes ascending to the Retezat peak. The event offers four races with different difficulties and distances, from Easy Run of 8.5 km to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3300 m of elevation gain. The routes traverse wild landscapes, with support points in hard-to-access areas, and the organization relies on dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term continuity plan.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation differences, up to 3340 m D+ at the marathon
Support points in wild areas accessible only on foot or by air
The marathon route passes near Lake Bucura, the largest glacier lake in the country
additional: Registrations and kit distribution are on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, Râușor ski resort base. There is a technical briefing and a Pasta Party before the race. Mandatory equipment includes mountain running shoes and windstopper/ rain gear. The routes are marked and supervised, and runners must manage their nutrition and hydration between support points. It is recommended to leave the car in the parking lot at the end of the asphalt, a 10-minute walk to the start. Routes with large elevation differences, difficult mountain terrain, limited support in certain areas, and mountain weather conditions should be taken into account.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized annually by the Szigethalmi Ultrafutók Lelkes Alakulata on the second weekend of August. The 2026 anniversary, the 20th running festival, will be held in Tököl Park Forest, featuring a variety of distances including ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter runs, and hiking. The race has a friendly atmosphere, and in addition to runners, many programs await children. The event aims to promote sports and support the local community, with a special focus on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 meters of elevation gain
Relay race over 52 km with 2-4 person teams
Refreshment points every 3 km with a generous selection
additional: The race features chip timing, with a chip deposit fee of 2000 HUF, which is refundable at the finish or can be donated to charity. Starts are staggered, with on-site registration beginning at 7:00 AM on race day. Several children's programs are available, including face painting, glitter tattoos, creative corner, and bouncy castle. The race closes at 3:00 PM, which is also the cutoff time. Refreshment points are located every 3 km with a wide selection. Participants can register online or on-site; the event includes ultramarathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival emphasizes community and love for sport.

name: RILA RUN
description: Ride Or Run - Rila is a popular and unconventional race held in the Rila Mountains, starting from the village of Pastra and ending at the Kalin Dam. The course is 15.3 km of ascent along a high mountain road with a positive elevation gain of over 1800 meters. The event attracts both cyclists and runners who face a serious challenge in mountain conditions. After a few years of pause, the event again gathers the best athletes in this discipline.
course_highlights: 15.3 km ascent along a high mountain road
Positive elevation gain over 1800 meters
Course from Pastra village to Kalin Dam in the Rila Mountains
additional: The course is 15.3 km with ascent along a high mountain road, includes support points at 5, 10, and 15.3 km, and offers races in running, cycling, and duathlon.

name: Oltenia Forest Run
description: Oltenia Forest Run is a running and orienteering competition held in the forested area of Băile Govora, aimed at running and orienteering enthusiasts of all ages. The running course is marked and adapted for participants in good health for physical effort. The event promotes respect for the environment and participant safety, providing a race kit with a bib number and a gift. It is a sport combined with nature, suitable for children, youth, adults, and veterans.
course_highlights: Marked running course in forested areas
Orienteering section for all age categories
Respect for environmental protection and safety norms
additional: The race kit includes a visible bib number and a gift. Registration can be done online via a form or on-site, subject to availability. Participants must adhere to environmental protection rules during the race. Trail running and terrain orienteering, online or on-site registration (limited spots), event in August 2026, with prizes and diplomas for participants.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances - 38 km with 2200 meters of elevation gain and 16 km with 1000 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Ludmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, providing stunning views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and the Balkan Mountains. The race combines technically difficult sections with fast descents and requires strength, speed, and skills. In addition to individual competitions, there is a team run, as well as a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2200 meters of elevation through peaks Yastrebets, Aleko, Musala, and Mancho
16 km Yastrebets Trail Run with 1000 meters of elevation on a marked trail
Technical rocky and steep sections with panoramic views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and the Balkan Mountains
additional: Start and finish at the slope in front of Rila Hotel. Distribution of race packets the evening before the race and on the morning of the start. Award ceremony for the winners at 11:00 for Yastrebets Trail Run and at 15:00 for Musala Extreme. Opportunity to participate in a team run with no participant limit per team. Duathlon with cycling the next day along the Lakatska Rila route. The course includes technical sections requiring mountain running skills; registration and participation fee; mandatory equipment; options for shorter distances and team runs; duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, with a distance of 38 km and 2200 meters of elevation gain. The course passes through peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina. The race requires technical skills to navigate rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and attention. A shorter race, Yastrebets Trail Run, with a distance of 16 km and 1000 meters of elevation gain, is held simultaneously, suitable for runners seeking an easier route. Organizers also offer team running and a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2200 m elevation gain through peaks Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho
Technical rocky and steep sections requiring skills and attention
Panoramic views of Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina
additional: Start and finish at the track in front of Rila Hotel. Distribution of race packets the evening before the race and on the morning of the start. Awards ceremony after each race distance. Opportunity to participate in team running and a duathlon with cycling the next day. The course is 38 km long with 2200 meters of elevation gain, including ascent to Musala Peak and passing through mountain shelters and trails. Registration deadline is August 10. The race supports initiatives for vegetation restoration.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by Tata Mass Sport and Tájfutó Honvéd Sports Club. The race is a trail run on a varied and challenging route that combines the proximity of nature with the sport experience. The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all ages, and also strengthens the community experience among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth execution and participant satisfaction.
course_highlights: Trail running on a varied, nature-close route
Challenging sections and diverse terrain
Friendly, community-oriented race
additional: The race is part of county running competitions, with categories in trail running and trail races, on various distances.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kŭtina is a mountain running race, part of the XLkmrun series, held in the area of Kŭtina village, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths suitable for different levels of preparation. The routes pass through natural trails and cart roads, providing a challenge and beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: Mountain running in the area of Kŭtina village
Three distances: 4.8 km, 9.6 km, and 14.4 km
Routes on natural trails and cart roads
additional: The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities. Each event offers a choice of several distances. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. There is no specific information about start times, fees, or participant caps. The event includes three distances and takes place in August 2026.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of various ages and levels. The course starts and finishes at the modern 'Krepost' stadium and passes by the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The event offers two main distances - 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and youth. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with cultural and historical attractions of the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at 'Krepost' stadium
The course passes by the Roman fortress wall
Passes through two beautiful parks in Hisarya
additional: The race includes both professional athletes and children and youth. There are also lectures and an academy for children related to athletics. The event is part of the larger initiative RUN BULGARIA. The dates for the next races are August 16, 2026, as part of the RUN BULGARIA series, with prizes for the winners and participation opportunities for all ages.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially arranged trails in the middle of nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize overcoming personal limits and the joy of running in community.
course_highlights: Night trail in Dumbrava Sibiului, outdoors
Running on natural terrain with forest scenery
A 10-year tradition event in Sibiu
additional: Marked and illuminated trail, races for children, prizes and medals for participants

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
location: Muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului, Sibiu, Romania
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is the most beautiful night cross-country race in Romania, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Open Air Museum in Dumbrava Sibiului, offering participants a unique running experience on marked trails after dark. There are races for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as races for children over distances of 500 m, 1000 m, and 1300 m. The competition is open to all age categories between 5 and 75 years old, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.
course_highlights: Fully marked night trail at the Open Air Museum in Dumbrava Sibiului
Distances for adults: 4.5 km and 9 km, for children: 500 m, 1000 m, 1300 m
Start after sunset, beginning at 20:00 for children's races
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited: 150 for children's races, 300 for the 4.5 km race, and 300 for the 9 km race. Kit pickup is done after signing a liability waiver, which will be sent via email and must be signed and brought when collecting the kit. Prizes are awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places in 22 male and female categories. The event includes outdoor trail races, awards for the best, and takes place at locations such as the Open Air Museum, the Zoo, and Astra Museum. Registrations are made online, and the event promises an energetic and fun experience.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of the leading trail running races in Bulgaria, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event attracts runners from around the world who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through the wildest and most beautiful corners of the mountain, including the Wonder Bridges, the Chimneys, and the Cirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers through the heart of the Rhodopes
Passing through the Wonder Bridges and the Chimneys
The route includes Cirikova Church and wild natural beauty
additional: The race is a benchmark for wilderness and natural beauty, combining sport and culture in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
location: Planinarski dom u Rastištu, Tara, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, with start and finish at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište. This race features three different routes that are technically demanding and physically challenging, designed for experienced mountain runners. The event also includes sports and recreational activities for all ages, making it attractive to a broader audience. The routes are certified according to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the National Mountain Running Series PSS.
course_highlights: Technically demanding and physically challenging routes in Tara National Park
Three races of different lengths and elevations: 46 km with 3300D+, 24 km with 1700D+, and 10 km with 700D+
Start and finish at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište
additional: Registrations open on February 1, 2026. Routes are certified according to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards. The race counts as the 5th round of the National Mountain Running Series PSS. Sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish zone. The competition includes three races of different lengths and difficulties, focusing on technically demanding and physically challenging terrains. In addition to the races, sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish zone.

description: The Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, scheduled to take place on August 22-23, 2026, in the rear park of the Festetics Castle. Participants can choose from several distances, ranging from 3 km to half marathon, in individual and relay categories. Additionally, children's races are available for the youngest participants, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and the Balaton lakeside environment offers a unique experience for runners.
course_highlights: Takes place on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Castle
Distances from 3 km to half marathon, individual and relay races
Children's races for different age groups, family-friendly program
additional: The race office is located on-site, by Lake Balaton, at the Mole, where bib pickup and on-site registration are also available. A separate registration desk is available for children's races. Participants are advised to arrive in good time due to traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. Children's races are held at different distances for each age group, and the youngest can participate with parental supervision. Results are announced after each race. The event features multiple distances, children's and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, and weather-dependent start times.

name: 2X2 Race
price_range: 500,00 lei (X1 Race), 250,00 lei (X2 Race), 350,00 lei (2X2 Race)
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely at over 2000 meters altitude in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main route of 45 km with a positive elevation gain of 4200 meters passes through Romania's two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2400m D+) and X2 Race (18 km, 1900m D+), are also very technical and intense, aimed at experienced mountain runners. Participation is limited and conditioned by experience to ensure the safety of competitors against the high physical and mental effort.
course_highlights: Entire route at over 2000 meters altitude in the Făgăraș Mountains
Passes through the peaks Moldoveanu (2544m) and Negoiu (2535m)
Large elevation differences: 4200m D+ for 2X2 Race, 2400m D+ for X1 Race, 1900m D+ for X2 Race
additional: Kit pickup is at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac on August 23 between 18:00-22:00, with an exceptional possibility for pickup on Saturday morning. Participants must present their ID and complete a self-declaration. Race spots cannot be transferred, but the kit can be collected by another designated person. Limited number of participants: 200 for each race. The race is governed by the principle of total self-sufficiency, with no feeding stations along the route (except for feeding points for the 2X2 Race). Trail ultramarathon, registration at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac, kit pickup on August 23, technical high-altitude mountain terrain.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates the unique nature and heritage of Romania, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1292 meters, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized control and hydration points, as well as activities dedicated to children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.
course_highlights: 39.3 km route with an elevation gain of 1292 meters
Control and hydration points with water and snacks every 5-10 km
Panoramic landscapes and crossing the villages of Ciosa and Lunca Ilvei
additional: The 2026 edition T-shirt can be purchased additionally at registration. The event also includes activities for children with a special 1 km race, supported by volunteers and animators. The marathon has 5 control and hydration points, and participation in all is mandatory for race validation. Participants can purchase T-shirts and other merchandise, and the event includes activities for families and children, promoting a healthy lifestyle and connection with nature.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița, Romania. Participants run a 6.8 km course in repeated loops, starting every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests the physical and mental limits of runners, offering an intense and community-driven experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Based on Lazarus Lake's concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous and supportive environment.
course_highlights: 6.8 km course on a loop run every hour
Spectacular scenery in the Brebu area, Dâmbovița, Romania
Continuous format until the last runner remains
additional: The race takes place in 6.8 km loops with a start every hour, and the competition continues until only one runner remains. Community is a central element, and organizers provide support and assistance to participants throughout the event. Participation is open after July 21 if spots are still available; volunteering and sponsorships are welcome.

The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the best in male and female categories for both distances.

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci that combines running, cycling, orienteering, water jumps, hiking, movies, music, and volleyball. This sports and entertainment festival gathers participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities along the Danube coast. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program that lasts throughout the day. We invite everyone to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and sports challenges.
course_highlights: Running and cycling along the Danube coast
Orienteering and water jumps
Hiking and outdoor sports activities
additional: The event also includes film screenings, live music, and volleyball matches, creating a rich and diverse program for participants and visitors. Registration is open for the Inđija Trail 08 race, which is part of the Dunavske Čarolije series of events, with early registration discounts available.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Buda Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night through the scenic forest trails of the Buda Mountains. Participants run with headlamps on their heads, providing a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, both with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and the start is at Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running through the forest trails of the Buda Mountains
Headlamp running across diverse terrain conditions
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start time: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance, 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race pack pickup: 18:00-19:15 (M distance), 18:00-19:45 (S distance). Cut-off time: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is only available online, no on-site registration. The maximum number of participants is 600 across both distances. The event takes place in nature, in darkness, with headlamps, offering a special experience for participants.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in the main square of Szombathely, offering opportunities for children and amateur runners alike. The special atmosphere of the race is provided by the sunset and the ambiance of the city center, creating a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all ages while also providing a community experience.
course_highlights: Running in Szombathely main square
Evening, post-sunset atmosphere
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race's uniqueness lies in the evening and night run, which has not been held before in Szombathely. Organizers also share preparation tips for the 6 km distance, emphasizing gradual training and 3-4 sessions per week for successful completion. Night running event, location in Szombathely's main square, starting at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: The SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and aids the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible within 6 hours on a 3.5 km flat, accessible loop. The race starts at midnight, guaranteeing a sunrise view. Entries are open for individual and team categories, with teams consisting of 2-10 members and unlimited relay changes allowed. Additionally, the Midnight Half Marathon starts at midnight on the SUHANJ! 6 course, with a limit of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 3.5 km long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 meters asphalt road on the central road of Margaret Island
400-meter synthetic track at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre
additional: Number pickup is available from August 25-29 between 08:00 and 20:00 at the SUHANJ! Fitness (Budapest, 13th district, Tátra Street 6). Use of a headlamp during the race until dawn is mandatory. Participants are advised to use their own cup or bottle at refreshment points. The race center provides changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage, and a dedicated refreshment zone. From 22:00 to 23:00 before the race, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with disabilities takes place at the MAC track. After the race, breakfast and a charity raffle await participants. The race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation; participation is possible via online registration, and the program includes a map-based course, breakfast, and raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, circuit-style running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Participants complete the half marathon distance over four laps, but it is also possible to run fewer laps. The registration fee is voluntary, 500 HUF per lap, which supports the event costs. Every participant receives an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and the top three male and female finishers will receive a special medal. The award ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, Törökbálint
The half marathon consists of 4 laps, but fewer laps can be chosen
Friendly, voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap
additional: Registration is on-site. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers will receive a unique medal. Participants are welcomed with an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine. The award ceremony is at 12:00 PM. The race allows for fewer laps, on-site registration, commemorative medals, awards for the top three male and female finishers, and refreshments: apple, hot tea, and mulled wine.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. The event, organized by the Valea Jiului Alpine Club, continues the tradition of mountain running in the area, offering four daytime races that highlight spectacular routes amidst nature, at the confluence of the Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience with challenging trails and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children's race, as well as related social and cultural activities.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan mountains
Traversing trails amidst nature at the confluence of two national parks
Four main races and a children's race
additional: Kit pickup is available from 16:00 to 22:00 the day before and between 7:00 and 8:00 on race day. The start for the Scorota trail is at 8:00, and for the Paltina, Oslea, and Șarba trails at 9:00. All participants who finish within the time limit receive a finisher medal and a limited edition cap. Support points are available along the route and at the finish line, with individual timing and online rankings, wine tasting, traditional dinner, ambulance at start/finish, and access to workshops and social space with a campfire and live music. The event takes place on mountain and natural trails, with accommodation options in the Valea Iarului area and other facilities for participants.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan mountains, in the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massif area, organized by the Valea Jiului Alpine Club. The event continues the tradition of mountain running in the region, offering four daytime races that highlight spectacular routes amidst nature, at the confluence of the Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, participation kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan mountains
Support points and individual timing with online ranking
Access to Retezat National Park and traditional culinary experiences
additional: Kit pickup is available between 16:00 and 22:00 the day before and between 7:00 and 8:00 on race day. Starts are scheduled at 8:00 for the Scorota route and at 9:00 for the Paltina, Oslea, and Șarba routes. Participants receive a limited edition cap, finisher medal, support points along the route, individual timing, wine tastings, access to camping, and a traditional dinner. Practical first aid courses and photographic exhibitions are also organized. Material prizes are awarded to the top 3 overall male and female positions, as well as for age categories. The race covers 26 km with approximately 2000 meters of elevation gain and is recognized as a landmark event in trail running in Romania. Participation includes access to accommodation zones and information about the race kit.

name: Adventure Sky Run
description: Adventure SkyRun is a mountain race held since 2016 in the Rila Mountains, offering three distances with varying difficulty and length. The routes pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Lakes Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest trail, a 25 km ski track, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers stunning natural views and the opportunity to surpass one's own limits.
course_highlights: 12 km forest trail through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km single track with ascent to Zeleni Preslap and panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
55 km route connecting Borovets and Malyovitsa resorts with ascent to Musala Peak and passing through Ribni Lakes and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Start packages are distributed on August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 20:00 at Rila Hotel, Borovets Resort, and on the morning of August 29, 2026, before the start. There are separate starts: 06:00 for 55 km, 09:00 for 12 and 25 km. Awards ceremony after the race and organized transportation for participants of the 55 km to Samokov and Borovets. Distances: 12 km, 25 km, and 55 km; registration and equipment requirements; held in Borovets and Malyovitsa; mountain running in Rila.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2026
location: Malyovitsa Sports Center, Bansko Ski Resort, Samokov, Bulgaria
description: Adventure SkyRun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, featuring three distances that pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Lakes Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest trail, a 25 km course with climbs and single tracks, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting Borovets and Malyovitsa resorts with technical and rocky sections. The race offers stunning natural views and challenges for runners of different levels of preparation. Organizers provide control points and transportation after the finish of the longest distance.
course_highlights: 12 km forest trail through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km with single tracks and ascent to Malyovitsa Peak with panoramic views
55 km ultramarathon with ascent to Musala Peak and crossing Ribni Lakes and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Start packages are distributed on 28.08.2026 in front of Rila Hotel in Borovets resort and on 29.08.2026 in front of Malyovitsa Sports Center for the shorter distances. Control time for 55 km is 14 hours, for 25 km - 9 hours. Participants must carry their own water container, as bottles are not provided at checkpoints. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the 55 km finish, organized transport to Samokov and Borovets is available. Pre-registration and payment are mandatory; equipment is required for the 55 km participants; the race is intended for advanced runners; no registration on the day of the event, except for the children's run.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race, part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in the Western Stara Planina. The start is at "Yordan Radichkov" Square in Berkovitsa at an altitude of 405 meters, and the routes ascend to Mount Kom (2016 meters) offering stunning views of the Danube Plain, Rila, and Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose between three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children's run and a rich program for children after the race.
course_highlights: Ascent to Mount Kom (2016 m) - the westernmost two-thousand-meter peak in Bulgaria
View of the Danube Plain, Rila, and Rhodope Mountains
Three distances with significant elevation gain and start at 405 meters above sea level
additional: Free parking at "Yordan Radichkov" Square next to the Municipality. Payment on site via bank transfer, Revolut, PayPal, or ePay during registration from 6:30 to 8:00. Program includes children's yoga, games, and cake after the race. Starts for mountain running and biking at various distances, as well as a 1 km children's run. The race is part of the ultramarathon series and is intended for runners seeking a serious mountain challenge.

The course is naturalistic, passing through agricultural dirt roads and forest sections, with refreshment points every 4-5 kilometers. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and foster community spirit. Participants are required to respect nature and follow the rules; mountain bikers must wear helmets.

description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city race held in the town of Ócsa, around the Gábor Egressy Leisure Center. The race offers challenges at multiple distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km runs, which pass through the town's landmarks. The event features unique chip timing, and the rankings are based on gross time. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with age restrictions and a limited number of participants.
course_highlights: City environment, route passing through Ócsa's landmarks
10.5 km loop, to be completed multiple times for longer distances
Varied terrain: asphalt, dirt paths, wine cellar area
additional: The race uses a unique chip timing system that measures both net and gross times. Placements are determined based on gross time. The maximum number of participants is 550. Residents of Ócsa are eligible for a discount on the registration fee, which must be verified with a residence card. Registration is free for those born in 1960 or earlier. The race is part of the Ötpróba point collection system, and there is an opportunity to support the local community and promote sports on site.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event organized in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic nature experience for runners of all levels. The race includes two main events: an 11 km cross with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain and a half marathon of 21 km with 550 meters of elevation gain, both taking place on varied, unpaved routes that combine forest roads, trails, and rugged areas. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with the support of the Păulești City Hall and promotes respect for the wild environment and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a noble cause, supporting the rehabilitation of wildlife in Romania.
course_highlights: 11 km cross with approx. 350 m elevation gain and a time limit of 2.5 hours
21 km half marathon with approx. 550 m elevation gain and a time limit of 4 hours
Unpaved routes marked with tape, spray paint, and signs, crossing wild areas and forest roads
additional: The routes are not closed to traffic; participants must respect traffic conduct rules. The event has a time limit for each race: 2.5 hours for the cross and 4 hours for the half marathon. Organizers provide training guides for mountain running. The first 350 participants benefited from free registration in previous editions. The start and finish are located on the plateau near the Salvamont Păulești Base. Mountain routes with elevation differences of 350 m D+ for the cross and 550 m D+ for the half marathon, online registration and results, event supported by Păulești City Hall.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
location: Parcul Zăvoi, Râmnicu Vâlcea, Vâlcea County, Romania
description: Oltenia Marathon is a comprehensive sporting event that includes running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing connections among participants and shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a solid tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied routes and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socialization.
course_highlights: Routes for running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint in Zăvoi Park
Event dedicated to group athletes, with an emphasis on motivation and connection
Friendly atmosphere and support for nature and sustainability
additional: Physical races in Râmnicu Vâlcea on August 30-31, 2026, and a virtual race available anytime and anywhere for participants worldwide.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a traditional running race held around Edelény. The race offers various distances, providing opportunities for runners of all levels to find a suitable challenge. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and provides professional timing with an RFID chip system. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and the diverse terrain.
course_highlights: Varied distances: from 500 meters to marathon
Natural, diverse terrain in the Bódva Valley
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Registration is available on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment options are also provided. Bibs are distributed with safety pins. The event features multiple distances and race categories, so every family member can find a suitable option. Several distances are available for the race, but specific details and registration fees are not included in the sources.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events in the world, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their endurance and stamina. The event is traditionally the highlight of multi-day ultrarunning, where world records have been set. Runners face a unique challenge that tests both physical and mental strength.
course_highlights: Six days of continuous running on the Balatonfüred course
Venue of world records in multiple categories
A challenging multi-day ultramarathon race
additional: The focus of the event is on achieving multi-day ultramarathon records; details of the race and terrain type are not specified.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
location: Kisfaludy tér, Sümeg, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The Sümeg Trail running race is a prominent sporting event in the city of Sümeg, attracting running enthusiasts for the fifth year. The race offers challenges across four different distances, which participants can complete in the unique and beautiful environment of the city. The event also features numerous sports and health screening programs, including yoga classes, meditation, and other physical activities. The Sümeg Trail is a lively, community-oriented event that promotes sports and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Sümeg's special and beautiful course
Four types of distances: sweet, treat, spicy, and strong challenges
Sports programs and health screenings in the Courtyard of the Memorial House
additional: On the day of the race, the program is enriched with yoga, warm-up sessions, health screening programs, singing bowl meditation, skill games, jiu-jitsu training, and performances by local dancers. The event also offers environmentally friendly and cultural programs, and the venue showcases the natural beauty of the surrounding area.

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Alba County, Romania
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all levels of preparation: ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross, and a children's race. The routes are varied, with significant elevation differences, providing a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, being dedicated to both experienced runners and those looking to transition to ultramarathon. The atmosphere is friendly and supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon of 69.4 km with a positive elevation difference of +2730 m
Half marathon of 23.9 km with a positive elevation difference of 918 m
Silviu Pîclișan Cross of 10 km, dedicated to the memory of the Cugir runner Silviu Pîclișan
additional: Wave starts: Ultramarathon at 07:00, Half marathon at 09:00, Cross at 09:30, Children's race at 12:00. Multiple refreshment points along the routes. Technical briefings are held before the starts. After the race, a Gulaș Party and awards ceremony are organized for all events. Time limits and safety rules are communicated and enforced. The routes include trails, forests, hills, and areas with beautiful natural scenery. Mountain trails, trail running event, various events for different levels, promoting outdoor movement.

description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set in the viticultural and historic landscapes of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races suitable for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross, and the Popular Race, each with spectacular routes through vineyards, forests, and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions, in a friendly and energizing atmosphere.
course_highlights: Popular Race (5 km) on an accessible route through the forest and along the Milcov River
Cross (12 km, +500 m elevation gain) with challenging climbs through the vineyards of Crama Sârba Odobești
Half Marathon (22 km, +850 m elevation gain) combining mountain running with vineyard and historic scenery
additional: Kit pickup and participant registration are from 07:30 to 09:30. Start times are staggered: Half Marathon at 10:15, Cross at 10:30, and Popular Race at 10:40. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30, with official closing at 14:30. The start location is in the leisure area of Odobești, with parking available. Access can be made by train to Focșani station and then by local transport or taxi. Participation is by donation, and the event includes prizes for the fastest runners and those demonstrating team spirit and perseverance. The routes and full details are available on the official website.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
price_range: 100 lei (Early Bird), 150 lei (normal), 180 lei (Last Minute), 119 lei (tricou tehnic)
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race that offers a unique experience through the heart of the medieval city of Sighișoara, combining sport with discovering the city's historical treasures. The event includes 10K, 5K, a children's race, and an Up Stairs challenge, open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is organized in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and an active citizen involved in the city's sports and cultural life.
course_highlights: Course through the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, with unique historical scenery
Start and finish in the Citadel Square, the central point of the city
Accessible and dynamic course for all levels, including an Up Stairs challenge
additional: All participants in the 5K and 10K events are automatically entered into a raffle with prizes. The race kit includes the race number, timing chip, and products offered by sponsors. The technical T-shirt can be ordered additionally during registration, at a cost of 119 lei. Kit pickup is recommended on Saturday, September 6, but it is also possible on race morning. There are 5 age categories for the 10K and 7 for the 5K. Cash prizes and medals are offered by the main partner AS World Cargo. Complaints can be made within 15 minutes after finishing to designated jury members. The course includes areas from the historic city center, with opportunities to win cash prizes and medals, as well as the option to purchase a personalized technical T-shirt.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: Vlasinsko Triathlon Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose between Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a start number, a diploma, and a medal for completing the race.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the shore of Vlasina Lake with beautiful natural surroundings
Multiple distances adapted to different ages: from Mini Kid to Olympic triathlon
Changing rooms located in close proximity to the start and finish lines
additional: Registration is only complete upon payment of the registration fee. An exception for payment upon receipt of the start package must be approved in advance. Foreign competitors can pay upon receipt of the start package due to difficulties with international transfers. Changing rooms are provided near the start and finish lines. Participants compete at their own risk. Participation includes various competition categories, information on registration, water conditions, drafting rules, and accommodation suggestions in the area.

name: 41. Wizz Air Budapest Félmaraton
location: Budapest, Pázmány P. rakpart, Budapest, Hungary
description: The 41st Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon is Hungary's largest half marathon, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Budapest. The race runs along a beautiful and varied route through the most scenic parts of Budapest, with over ten thousand runners participating. The course is fast, panoramic, and the atmosphere is lively, with music points and enthusiastic supporters cheering on the runners. The half marathon is an ideal distance for both beginners and advanced runners, featuring a unique finisher medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: Fast course through Budapest's most beautiful areas
Varied, panoramic route
Joyful music points and enthusiastic crowd
additional: Currently, registration is only open for the 21.1 km individual race, but the 10 km, pairs, and trio categories will be available soon. Online registration is exclusively via credit card at nevezes.futanet.hu. A BSI account registration is required to register. The finisher medal is unique and can be collected at the finish line. Tips related to the race include preparation for warm weather, hydration, and race readiness, as well as the option for virtual participation.

description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Mountaineering and Tourism Club Ploiești, which promotes outdoor activity and mountain sports. Various races, from short vertical to ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Massif, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a tradition of over 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain landscapes and diverse routes, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Varied mountain routes: Babeș Vertical 3.8 km with +624 m elevation gain
Semi-marathon of 21.6 km and 8.8 km Cross in the Ciucaș Massif
The Ridge, a 38.5 km race for experienced runners
additional: Kit pickup is done before the races. The event includes races for children (Kids Race) with separate starts. There are control posts and refreshment points along the routes. The detailed start program is available on the website. Registrations are open from April 15 to August 20, 2026, offering participants the opportunity to prepare for an unforgettable mountain experience.

name: Teteven's Peaks
price_range: от 39 EUR до 115.39 EUR в зависимост от периода на регистрация
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and tourism enthusiast in the beautiful nature of Teteven Balkan. The race includes several distances - a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical ascent, a light 6 km route, and a hike with a mountain guide. Participants will enjoy fresh air, picturesque views, and well-organized support stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, providing medals, T-shirts, and personalized chip timing numbers.
course_highlights: Start in front of the municipality in Teteven with ascent to Petrahila Peak
Support stations with water, isotonic drinks, and food at key points along the route
Impressive views of Stara Planina and Teteven Balkan
additional: All participants receive a personalized number with RFID chip for timing and can be tracked in real time. Medical teams and volunteers are present on the route and in the start/finish area. Support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy bars, and fruits are provided. After the race, there are opportunities for walks in the natural beauty around Teteven. Changing rooms and baggage storage are available in the start/finish zone. Terrain: mountain trails, registration includes T-shirt, medal, insurance, RFID chip for precise timing, support points, medical assistance.

description: The Transborder Marathon Via Pontica is held annually and offers a unique running experience crossing Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route near Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal villages Vama Veche and 2 Mai, without stopping at the border. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a children's race of 2 km, with the finish at the beach near the village of Krapets. The organizer is the 'Green Step' club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The route passes along a dirt road and a cart track with sandy sections near Lake Durankulak and the 'Cosmos' camping site
Crossing the border between Bulgaria and Romania without stopping
Coastal promenade through the Romanian villages Vama Veche and 2 Mai
additional: Children run free of charge and do not cross the Romanian border. Control times: 4:30 hours for 28 km and 3:00 hours for 16 km. The fee includes fruits, water, electronic timing, bus transport for 16 km, medical assistance, and toilets at the start/finish. There is an option to change the distance for an additional fee and price difference. T-shirts with original designs are available for an extra charge. Two running distances (16 km and 28 km) and a children's 2 km race; transportation to the start points; registration and fees; prizes for the top three finishers; includes coastal routes and crossing the border with Romania.

name: Екиден маратон
location: Национален стадион „Васил Левски“, София, София-град, България
description: Ekyden Marathon Sofia is a relay race held on September 6, 2026, at the Vasil Levski National Stadium. The event promotes road relay running and commemorates the 140th anniversary of the Union of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total distance of 42.195 km, divided into six segments with different lengths and color-coded numbers. The race is organized by the Sports Club "Sports for All Sofia in Europe" and the Bulgarian Federation "Sports for All" with the aim of selecting national champions in relay running.
course_highlights: Total distance of 42.195 km divided into 6 segments: 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 7.195 km
Start and finish at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Cut-off time for all teams: 4 hours and 1 minute
additional: Receiving start numbers and relay exchange bands on September 5 from 10:00 to 19:30 and on September 6 from 7:30 to 8:30 at Vasil Levski National Stadium. Teams register mainly through the website 5kmrun.bg. There are specific cut-off times and limits for passing each segment. Registration takes place on September 5 and 6, 2025, at Vasil Levski National Stadium. The event includes relays and various distances such as 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 7.195 km.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championship in Râșnov brings together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail running course combined with the rich cultural heritage of Transylvania. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on a challenging and scenic terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail running course in the Carpathian Mountains
Scenic landscapes and Transylvanian cultural heritage
Historic location in the town of Râșnov, Romania
additional: The event takes place from September 10 to 13, 2026. The organizers published the first edition of the event program along with the opening of registrations. The competition is organized in collaboration with the Local Organizing Committee (LOC). Registrations are open with discounts for early sign-ups before August 10, 2026. The event includes trail and mountain running races, with details about routes, rules, and logistics available in the official event manual.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race organized in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, requiring adherence to clear participation conditions, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race number throughout the race. The start is scheduled in the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated area for start and finish. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque landscapes of Râșnov.
course_highlights: Route in the center of Râșnov
Unique medieval atmosphere
Timing and first aid facilities provided
additional: Participants must be accompanied by an identity document when collecting their participation kit. Presenting a medical certificate or assuming responsibility for physical capacity is mandatory. The race number must be worn on the front of the T-shirt throughout the race, from start to finish. Participants must present identification, a medical certificate, and wear the race number visibly; registrations are online, with on-site registration available subject to availability.

name: Пирин ултра
price_range: от 48 до 118 EUR в зависимост от датата и дистанцията
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, included in the UNESCO list. The event offers a unique experience for trail running enthusiasts with impressive views and challenging routes of various lengths. The race attracts runners from around the world competing in four distances, passing through beautiful and wild mountain terrains. Organizers provide medical examinations and strict safety rules to ensure participant safety.
course_highlights: Routes of 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km through Pirin National Park
Mountain terrain with technical sections and scenic views
Passing through control points and supported stations
additional: Mandatory medical examination before receiving the start package. Registration and equipment check are mandatory and conducted at specified times. ITRA points are required for registration for the 38 km and 160 km distances. Awards are held at the Central Square in Bansko. Transportation is organized for participants of the 25 km distance to the start point. Registration requires ITRA points for the longer distances; the race includes routes of 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: Bukovac Marathon - The Long Route is a challenging hiking race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The route length is 47.8 km with a total ascent and descent of 1350 meters each. The trail is well-maintained and marked with a red and white hiking marker, passing by significant sites such as the Novo Hopovo Monastery, Old Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, Velika Remeta, as well as Brankov Grave and Monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the nature and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: Route length of 47.8 km with a total ascent and descent of 1350 m
Passing by Novo Hopovo Monastery, Old Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, and Velika Remeta
Well-maintained and marked trail with red and white hiking markers
additional: The trail was mapped out in 2004 and last marked in 2014. The start and finish are in Bukovac at an altitude of 180 meters. The estimated time to complete the trail is about 12 hours. The trail is demanding and intended for experienced hikers. There are control points (CP) along the route. The trail race with a marked route and control points at attractive locations takes place on the second Saturday of September, starting at 9:30 AM.

name: Arilje TRAIL
description: Arilje Trail is a race that combines challenge, nature, and adventure in the heart of western Serbia. Participants can choose between three routes of different lengths and difficulty levels: Green route (8 km, 250 m elevation), Blue route (18 km, 900 m elevation), and Red route (31 km, 1200 m elevation). The race passes through beautiful landscapes of the Rzav River, Žuta Stena, and the foothills of Arilje, offering technically demanding sections and unforgettable scenery. This event gathers runners of all levels, from recreational to professional, and provides a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and sport.
course_highlights: Trails through dense forests and clear mountain streams
Beautiful viewpoints and landscapes of the Rzav River and Žuta Stena
Technically demanding sections with significant ascents
additional: After the race, participants can enjoy free food, refreshments, and live music. There is also a children's race with different categories based on age. Organizers emphasize respect for nature, safety, and fair play, as well as mandatory wearing of race bibs and adherence to race rules. Multiple route lengths (8 km, 14 km, 18 km, 31 km), volunteer and local support, a rich start package, and an organized closing festival.

name: III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás 5 / 10
description: The III. Pannonhalma Decem Run is a friendly and diverse running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Pannonhalma, Fenyvesalja. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometers, providing running enthusiasts the opportunity to enjoy nature and well-marked routes. The aim of the event is to offer a motivating and enjoyable sports experience for all ages while allowing participants to explore the beauty of the local landscape. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, which includes multiple sports and events as part of a leisure sports program.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km distances around Pannonhalma Fenyvesalja
Nature-oriented, diverse terrain
Well-marked and safe routes
additional: Participants receive medals, gifts, and refreshment stations; the venue is easily accessible and emphasizes community experience.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The 11th Moonlight Run is a charming running race in the city of Szob, scheduled for September 12, 2026. Participants will receive timing, a bib number, and a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, and traditional bread with onions awaits runners at the finish. The event takes place under medical supervision, and organizers prioritize the experience of participation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city of Szob
Refreshments on the course and at the finish line
Unique finisher medal for every participant
additional: Medical supervision is provided during the race. Traditional bread with onions is served at the finish. Every participant receives a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish line. Participants receive a certificate of participation, and refreshments are provided at the finish; the event is conducted in Hungarian.

description: The ATOM Run is a popular running race in the city of Paks, scheduled to take place on September 12, 2026, around the ASE sports hall area. The race offers multiple distances, allowing runners to find a challenge suitable for them. The event traditionally welcomes participants with significant early bird discounts and is held in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The goal of the race is to promote sports and community, while participants can enjoy diverse courses and the beauty of the Paks environment.
course_highlights: Runners can choose from 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 32 km distances

At the end of the race, organizers serve homemade goulash, ensuring a communal experience after the run.

21.1 km two-loop half marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances
Refreshments every 5 km and at the finish

Participants receive start kits with electronic chips and refreshment points along the route.

Route marked with blue arrows, with multiple laps for the half marathon and 10.5 km

The race is run in a single direction, without turns, along the most beautiful streets of the capital, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, open to all running enthusiasts. Organizers emphasize an energizing atmosphere, with encouragement points along the route and a complete participation kit for runners.

Start at the National Stadium Arcul de Triumf and finish at the National Arena
Feeding and hydration points at km 1.8, 5, and 7.5

Dynamic and friendly atmosphere supported by Runners Club

The event includes both individual and team races, with registrations limited to 1300 participants. Participation kits can be collected from Cluj Arena between September 19-21, 2026, and include medals, timing services, and other amenities. The route is urban, in the Unirii Square area, and takes place in a friendly environment suitable for participants of all ages.

Registration is mandatory for all over 18 years old, and young participants have special participation conditions.

33 km - combines the dynamics of 12 km with the technicality of 21 km

The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km cross-country races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to elevation differences. Participants can enjoy a beautiful natural setting and a friendly atmosphere, with social and health objectives.

The event aims to support palliative care patients at St. Luke's Hospital Sucevița and St. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those in difficult moments. Participants can choose from three medium-difficulty races suitable for both experienced runners and less experienced ones, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The routes offer spectacular views of the Sucevița valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

Participation includes multiple race distances, online registration, and a festive closing event with music and traditional food.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon covering the border area of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, as well as special support along the course. The event is a qualifier for UTMB and awards points for ITRA ranking, and all finishers receive a medal and a special starter pack with a T-shirt and gifts.

Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruits, and Rhodope specialties

Stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruits, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. Minimal asphalt sections on the course. Electronic result tracking. Information on accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photo and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, emphasizing nature, history, and adventure, with support for ecological causes.
