description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is an emblematic event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. In its 9th edition, the main race Ultra 50k is favored by trail runners for its challenge and the beauty of the route, which includes forests, ascents, and spectacular descents. Participants can support one of Romania's 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-equipped refreshment points and personalized medals for finishers. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: 50 km route with ascents and descents through the forests around Cluj
Control and hydration points with varied food (water, isotonic drinks, fruits, sweets, salty foods)
Scenic views over Cluj Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, Muzeul Poarta de’ Feleac, and Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The runner's kit includes a race number with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and real-time rankings, a personalized finisher medal, access to hydration and refreshment points with sweet, salty, isotonic drinks, and fruits. There are races for children and team races with special distancing rules between members. Time limits: 9 hours for Ultra 50k, 5 hours for Half 25k, 3 hours for Cross 15k, 1 hour 30 minutes for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various Romanian historical regions and enjoy diverse routes, from trail to cross, with open registrations and early bird prices.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a cozy, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their strength over a 3 or 6-kilometer distance. A portion of the registration fee goes to charitable causes, making the run not only a sport activity but also a helping initiative. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to participate in a pleasant winter running program.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 or 6 km distance
Family-friendly, charity-focused running event
In the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: 500 forints of the registration fee will be donated to charity. Participants can choose to run either 3 or 6 kilometers. There is also an option for a family registration on a 2 km course, with up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes; registration fee payment is mandatory. Participation is open to all age groups. The race takes place in Bölcske, Csorda út 1435/6.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jogging is a charity running event held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center in Kecskemét. The purpose of the run is to raise funds to support children fighting Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes, for the NM Muscles Healing Foundation. The event offers community solidarity and a sporty experience for participants while serving a noble cause. The organizers thank all runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center
Charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Community and sporty experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also participate in the background work of the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and sick children. The event is part of the Advent preparations, with the run supporting the healing of sick children, and it is traditionally held every year to foster community unity.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who wish to support a noble cause through sport. The event offers a pleasant running experience in a friendly environment, promoting the local running community and social involvement. This is the first edition of this race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km route in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarie' Palliative Care Center for severely ill children
Options of 2 km race (family, non-competitive) and 6 km race (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, which was held for the 33rd time in 2025. The race features three distances: 200 meters for young children, and 1900 and 5900 meters for adults and seniors. More than 200 participants took part in the event, each receiving a unique finisher medal, and Santa's gifts are also waiting for the youngest runners. The atmosphere of the race is family-like, with many prizes and special awards given out by the organizers, and participants can celebrate December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1900 m, and 5900 m
Unique finisher medal for the 1900 m and 5900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere with Santa gifts for children
additional: At the race, runners over 70 years old are honored with a certificate, and the most sporty families are recognized with special awards. The main sponsors of the event are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which offer cake and pastries to participants. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, award ceremonies, gifts, and a joyful winter running celebration.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race from the 5kmrun calendar held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances - 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km, suitable for different levels of preparation. The event offers an opportunity to run in a natural environment with varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. This is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating ascents and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow for selection according to capabilities and desired intensity. The race is part of the winter calendar of XLkmrun and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running. The event includes different distances and is part of a series of events promoting an active lifestyle in Sofia.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on December 11-12, 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with a positive elevation gain of 9,250 meters, considered difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 meters of elevation difference, of intermediate difficulty. The race is recognized for its demanding mountain terrain and the Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking top endurance competition. Participants can track their performances through a personalized results board.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with positive elevation gains of 4,600 m and 9,250 m respectively
Mountain terrain with intermediate and difficult difficulty levels
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event features a personalized results board for participants to track their performance. There are no details about registration fees or start times. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Reciklažni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Recycling Marathon in Novi Sad is a traditional race held for the 11th time, marking the end of the running year. This event has an international character and gathers runners from the region. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere and camaraderie, with a unique feature of recycling medals and plaques from previous races. The start is from Sunčani Kej, and runners receive certificates for the distances they complete, motivating those attempting a half marathon or marathon for the first time.
course_highlights: Start from Sunčani Kej, opposite Đački igralište
Race without giving up, everyone receives certificates for the completed distance
Recycling medals and plaques from previous races
additional: The marathon begins at 10:00 AM, the half marathon at 11:00 AM. ARK "Fruška Gora" Club celebrates its 15th anniversary at this event. Runners from the region traditionally participate, and the race is known for its positive atmosphere and support for recreational athletes. The Recycling Marathon promotes medal recycling and camaraderie, with the start at Sunčani Kej, distances include marathon and half marathon, and the event has a relaxed character.

name: Deliblatska Peščara 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Za prijavu je potrebna uplata akontacije u iznosu od 1000 din.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful environment of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with trails ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers, leading through rolling terrains of sand dunes and groves. The trail is easy with negligible elevation change, suitable for individuals with light to moderate fitness. After hiking, participants have a rest break and an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and socialize in a mountaineering spirit.
course_highlights: Trails through rolling terrains of sand dunes and groves
Two hiking groups: 15-16 km or 8-10 km
Easy trail with negligible elevation change
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street near the Holy Savior Church. Recommended equipment includes protection against wind, rain, and cold, good hiking shoes, layered clothing, a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter), a flashlight, and hiking poles. For the organized lunch, prior notice and registration with the guide are required. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring a mountaineering membership card, health and personal ID. Seating arrangements in the bus are made by the guide based on registration and payment order. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The 'Down Argeș Half Marathon' is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The routes start from Strand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a unique natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children's races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is lively, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strand Park, near the Summer Theater
Route through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks
Running along the Argeș River promenade, with scenic views
additional: Kit pickup is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theater for those outside Pitești. The start of the half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races is at 10:00 AM in Strand Park. The children's race begins at 12:30 PM, and the awards ceremony is at 1:00 PM. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at registration and kit pickup. The event includes online registration, kit pickup on 12.12.2026, and results and photo verification after the event.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run is a New Year's race held at Kalemegdan in Belgrade, with the goal of entering 2027 with energy and a positive spirit. The race takes place at a historic site, Kalemegdan Fortress, and represents a new sports tradition of the city. Participants can choose between two distances, 5.5 km and 11 km (two laps), and part of the registration fee is donated to vulnerable individuals or groups. Organizers from the sports association Samo Hrabro guarantee a good atmosphere and quality organization, along with an entertainment program before, during, and after the race.
course_highlights: Routes of 5.5 km and 11 km (two laps)
Race held at Kalemegdan Fortress, at the viewpoint near the main promenade
Entertainment program before, during, and after the race
additional: Participant packages include a running shirt for registrations made by November 23. Each participant contributes to a humanitarian campaign. Official results will be published on runtrace.net. There are absolute male and female categories, and the top three places receive trophies. Information about pickup of race kits and program details will be announced later. The winter race registration is open until December 15, with a shirt included for early registrations, limited to 1500 participants, with options to participate in the entertainment program and after-party.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, volunteer-run race held in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. Participants can complete the half marathon distance in four laps, but there is also an option to run fewer laps. The event has a cozy atmosphere, with participants being greeted with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Every runner receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM. Registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary registration fee.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half marathon consists of 4 laps, but fewer laps can be chosen
Friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine
additional: Registration takes place on-site, with a suggested voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a unique medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00 PM. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. There is an option to run fewer laps, registration is on-site, and refreshments and medals are provided. The race supports the community and local runners.

name: Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is the last race of the year intended for trail running, hiking, and Nordic walking enthusiasts. Participants can choose between two routes, 10 km for a shorter dynamic tour and 17 km for a greater challenge. The race starts at Iriški Venac, and after finishing, participants can enjoy socializing with hot mulled wine and tea. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape of Fruška Gora and end the year actively and in good company.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 17 km through the nature of Fruška Gora
Start at Iriški Venac with a winter atmosphere
Refreshments with hot drinks and socializing at the finish line
additional: Participants need shoes with crampons for safe walking on uneven terrain. During the race, stations with water and juices are provided, and at the finish line, refreshments with water, electrolytes, and energy drinks. All participants receive a medal as a reminder of the challenge completed. Registration on race day is possible if there are available start numbers, but without a T-shirt and at a higher fee. Two routes (10 km and 17 km), start at Iriški Venac, socializing with hot mulled wine and tea, winter landscapes of Fruška Gora.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports-competition-recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race includes various routes, from ultra-extreme to preparatory, with challenging ascents and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event gathers runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and love for nature.
course_highlights: Varied routes with ITRA scoring from 1 to 5
Mountain terrain with significant ascents and descents
Beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora and natural environment
additional: The races are scored according to the ITRA system with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA). There are ultra-extreme, ultra, middle, small, and preparatory marathons. The preparatory southern marathon is 22 km long with an ascent and descent of 898 meters. Both group and fun registration systems are available for shorter routes. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is in December. Participation includes various route lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focusing on trail and mountaineering sports. Registration details are not available.

name: MALACVÁGTA
distance_verbose: Maraton, 29.5 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km
description: The Malacvágta is a pre-New Year's recreational running race held on December 30, 2024, at Bókay-kert in Budapest. The race is open to multiple age groups, including junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories, as well as a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a gift T-shirt, making it a friendly and community-oriented event.
course_highlights: 6000-meter distance for junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories
3000-meter stroller race
The race takes place at Bókay-kert, Budapest
additional: Every runner receives a gift T-shirt. There are two races: a 6000-meter race for junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories starting at 12:20, and a 3000-meter stroller race starting at 13:00. The event is held at Bókay-kert, with race times at 11:35 and 13:40, and is part of the year-end community programs.

name: Велинград Ултра
price_range: 23 евро за тениска, други цени не са посочени
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon race offering three challenging courses in the Spa capital of the Balkans - Velingrad. Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain routes with varying elevation, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, trail marking, support stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature combined.
course_highlights: Courses with lengths of 11 km (520 m elevation gain), 27 km (1420 m elevation gain), and 43 km (2100 m elevation gain)
Mountain terrain with marked trails and support stations
Start and finish in the center of Velingrad - the Spa capital of the Balkans
additional: Start packages include a medal, a souvenir with the event logo, timing, and a race bib. Registration and collection of start packages are from 07:00 to 11:00 on race day. Cut-off times are set for the 27 km and 43 km distances. There is an option to purchase a T-shirt for 23 euros. Additional mandatory gear is not included in the start package. The routes include different lengths, registration is on April 4, 2026, the race includes medals, photos, and support stations; additional gear is required.

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged that supports young people living in child protection services. The race starts from the Dome Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic and have a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, dedicating a day to movement, community, and care. The registration fees fund developments and experiences for the supported youth.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic with a solid surface route
Start and finish at the Dome Square, an iconic Szeged location
Secured course with police and volunteers
additional: The race offers distances for various age groups and fitness levels, including children's races and adult distances. A parental consent form is mandatory for children. Bicycle escorts and multiple checkpoints ensure the safety of participants. After the race, special bathing offers await participants, and the official ice cream flavor will be mango-passion fruit. Race participants support the ÁGOTA® Foundation. The event features multiple distances and categories, with the course starting from the Dome Square and running through the city environment. Participation is possible through online registration.

The race starts from the Dóm Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic, with a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, either individually or in teams. The event is not only a sports competition but also a community gathering that helps disadvantaged youth with increasing support year after year.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic, flat, paved route
Start and finish at Szeged Cathedral Square
Bicycle escort and police security at intersections
additional: The race offers options for various age groups and distances, including children's races (100 m, 400 m, 800 m), adult distances (3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 21 km), and a 4x3 km relay race. Bicycle escort and police security ensure safety during the event. Registration is available online, with limited on-site registration. Participants under 18 must have parental consent. After the race, special bath offers and gifts await participants. The participation supports child protection youth, with online registration available, multiple running options, and categories.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Fuss charity running festival with a ostrich will be held in Győr at Aranypart in 2026 for the third time. Participants can choose from several distances, open to all ages from the youngest to the oldest. The goal of the running festival is to support child care, especially the procurement of a special EEG device for the diagnosis of children with epilepsy and severe conditions. Well-known athletes and public figures will also participate in the event, creating a friendly, community atmosphere. The proceeds from the registration fees will support the Child Intensive Care Foundation.
course_highlights: The run takes place on the scenic hillside of Aranypart
Distances: 4, 7, 14, and 21 kilometers
Family-friendly event where four-legged pets can also participate
additional: Proceeds from the registration fees will be used to purchase a special EEG device for diagnosing children with epilepsy and severe conditions. Well-known athletes, artists, police officers, and volunteer firefighters in operational gear will participate, running in uniform. Families and pets will be among the runners, and spectators will cheer from the Aranypart hillside. The festival attracted over 600 participants, with registration fees supporting epilepsy diagnosis for children, and the event is organized as a charity for children's recovery.

description: The Vértes Terrain Marathon is a challenging trail running race through the scenic paths and forestry roads of the Vértes Mountains. The race offers multiple distances for runners, from ultramarathon to mini-marathon, each with varied elevation gains and well-marked routes. The event features refreshment stations, personalized bib numbers, timing, and a rich finish line celebration, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity to nature and the sporting experience. The race has a friendly atmosphere, and organizers pay special attention to the comfort and safety of runners.
course_highlights: Runs on paths and forestry roads of the Vértes Mountains
Ultramarathon 50 km with 1410 m elevation gain
Multiple refreshment stations, including Squeezy gels on ultramarathon and marathon distances
additional: Personalized bib number and timing (Traxpace). Hungarian-made metal finisher medals painted by people with disabilities. Feminine hygiene products available at stations and the center. Massage services for marathon and ultramarathon runners. Two types of finish line beer (non-alcoholic). No cups provided, participants must bring their own. Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, ID, at least 0.5 liters of fluids. Race packet pickup times: Ultra and Marathon 08:00-08:45, Half-Marathon and Mini-Marathon 08:45-09:45. Results announcement on race day from 12:30 to 15:00. Trail running in the Vértes Mountains, multiple distances, elevation gains, refreshment stations, registration opens from January 2025, held in Szár.

location: Erkel utca 39, Szombathely, Vas County, Hungary

description: The Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run is a community-building spring running festival in Szombathely, offering various distances for corporate, friends, and school teams in individual and relay categories. The race starts with a 2.5 km children's run and includes 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances, supplemented by relays. The event aims to promote sports and movement culture, featuring a unique finisher medal, electronic timing, and live result tracking. A health day is also part of the event, where mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations await participants. Free parking is provided at the Vasi Skanzen parking lot.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loops with relay zones, relay change every 2.5 km
Relay categories: women, mixed, general, and school relays
Electronic timing and continuously updated live results
additional: Free parking at the Vasi Skanzen parking lot. Unique finisher medals for the first 200 registrants, with options for previous medals. Electronic timing with the KORIM endurance timing system. Professionally taken, free downloadable race photos. Sponsorship gifts for category, relay, and overall winners. Bag storage at the race center. Selected health day programs with mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations. Relay teams require a minimum of 2 members, with change every 2.5 km, including separate categories for women, mixed, and school relays. The first school relay team registration fee is waived if registered by April 10. The race takes place in Szombathely, around Erkel Street 39. The event includes awards, live results, photos, and participation in various categories, including school teams.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: UFM Aréna, Mosonmagyaróvár, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The 23rd Motherson Szigetköz Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Mosonmagyaróvár, promoting recreational sports. The race is part of the Olympic Five-Contest and offers point-scoring opportunities at distances of 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which provides changing, showering, and cloakroom facilities. Chip timing is provided for the race, and there is a time limit for the longest distance. Participants' bibs can include their name or nickname if they register by April 10.
course_highlights: Chip timing for individual races at 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Time limit for the half marathon: 2 hours 30 minutes
Name or nickname printed on bibs if registered by April 10
additional: Bibs must be worn on the front at chest height; triathlon bib clips are permitted. The chip is located on the back of the bib and must not be removed or folded. The race timing is managed by Agni-Timing. There is a time limit for the longest distance; the 21.1 km must be completed within 2 hours 30 minutes, otherwise disqualification. The small bridge in front of the UFM Arena will be closed from 8:30 to 12:00 on race day. Registration is online and will be accepted only until April 11; the race is open to everyone, from beginners to professional runners.

name: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2026
location: Satul Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania
description: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA 2026 is an official endurance running competition organized by the TIME TRIAL RUNNING community, supported by the Chiajna City Hall and local parishes. The event takes place in the village of Roșu, Chiajna commune, on April 17, 2026, starting at 14:00, at the Sports Hall of the "Doamna Chiajna" Technological High School. It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single event covering a distance of 6.706 km, alternating between two different routes, one during the day and one at night. The challenge is to complete the route in less than 60 minutes and to be present at each hourly start, with the last remaining competitor declared the winner.
course_highlights: Unique distance of 6.706 km with two different routes alternated
Day route along the dyke/west side of Lake Morii
Night route through the streets of Roșu village and Chiajna promenade
additional: The start is given exactly on the hour, every hour, and participants must complete the route in less than 60 minutes to continue. The base camp includes indoor spaces (Sports Hall with changing rooms and toilets) and outdoor spaces (synthetic grass park). A refreshment and hydration point is available at the start/finish area, and hot meals will be offered according to the schedule. The winner (Last One Standing), second place (Assist), and the best-placed girl (Last Woman Standing) will be awarded. Each participant receives a personalized trophy at the end. The event includes routes along the shores of Lake Morii and the Chiajna promenade, with participation limited to 100 competitors, and offers hot meals and personalized trophies.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition organized in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Natural Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross with 680 m elevation gain and a 23 km semi-marathon with 1300 m elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes with dramatic landscapes and mountain trails. Participants can experience running under limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and ascending to impressive panoramic points. It is a race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular landscapes with limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb towards the Săndulești Cross with 360° views over the Apuseni Mountains
additional: Start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Salvamont Base. The participation kit includes a personalized textile bag and a finisher medal; technical T-shirt or sweatshirt is purchased separately. There are refreshment and hydration points along the route with water, Cola, isotonic drinks, fruits, and snacks. Kit pickup is on Friday, April 17, between 16:00-20:00 at Iulius Mall Cluj-Napoca and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00-21:00, with the possibility of pickup on the morning of the race. Awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on tourist trails in the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the natural and historical heritage of the area, connecting the castles of Șoimoș and Șiria by running, as well as other points of interest. The routes offer an adventure experience with spring landscapes and a medieval atmosphere, suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendar.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with tourist trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation differences: 445 m (9 km), 1026 m (22 km), 2075 m (44 km)
additional: The participant kit is guaranteed for registrations until April 12, 2026. The routes are marked with bands and arrows, and participants must pass through all control points. Medical assistance and monitoring are available on the route. On-site registrations are only possible for the 9 km cross and 22 km half marathon, without kit guarantee. Cancelling registration before February 28, 2026, refunds 50% of the participation fee. The routes include tourist trails from the Zărand Mountains, with details about registrations and participation conditions; the event takes place on April 18, 2026.

name: Maratonul Argonauților
location: Dobrogea Gorges, Gura Dobrogei, Constanța County, Romania
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, a picturesque area in Romania, with a marathon route that includes a positive elevation gain of 1600 meters. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and offers participants a unique experience in nature, on routes that promote the beauty of the natural reserves of Dobrogea. In addition to the marathon, other races are organized such as the half marathon, cross country, family race, and the canyon circuit, targeting a wide audience of runners. The marathon has a tradition and a story inspired by the Argonauts, heroes from Greek mythology, which adds a special charm to the competition.
course_highlights: Marathon route with a positive elevation gain of 1600 meters
Course through Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, protected natural reserves
Picturesque landscapes and promotion of local tourist routes
additional: The event includes several races: Marathon, Ioan Chifu Half Marathon, Cross Country, Family Race, and Canyon Circuit. The organizer is the Activ Pontica Sports Association. The routes are promoted as part of the natural and tourist heritage of the Dobrogea region. The event promotes local tourism and the natural beauty of Dobrogea, with varied routes and multiple race categories.

name: Maratonul Argonautilor
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Dobrogea Gorges, Dobrogea, offering a unique experience on routes with a positive elevation change of 1600 meters. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and promotes the natural beauty of the Gorges and Gura Dobrogei area, inviting runners to discover spectacular landscapes and natural reserves. The course is suitable for both experienced runners and those who wish to enjoy nature and outdoor sports. The marathon has a tradition that evokes the legend of the Argonauts, the heroes who set out in search of the Golden Fleece, adding a mythological touch to the competition.
course_highlights: Route with a positive elevation change of 1600 meters
Course through the Gorges and Gura Dobrogei, areas with natural reserves
Spectacular landscapes and promotion of the local tourist trail
additional: The course includes areas of gorges and natural reserves, registrations and regulations are available on the website, the event takes place on April 19, 2026

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
price_range: 250 lei pentru înscriere de ultim moment fără kit
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forest roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked route with control points and a friendly atmosphere, complemented by an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch at the end. The start is scheduled at 10:00 AM, after a technical briefing and a coffee warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Varied terrain route: forest trails and forest roads
Visibly marked route with tape, arrows, and signs
Control points with time limits for each stage
additional: Validation and kit pickup between 08:00 and 09:30. Last-minute registrations available for only 20 spots, without a start kit, with a fee of 250 RON. Mandatory equipment for stages: mobile phone, visible race number, liquid container (minimum 0.5 liters) for the 21 km stage, survival blanket. The champions' lunch with beans and sausages after runners arrive. Awards ceremony at 14:30. The event concludes at 16:00 with group photos and socializing. The route includes trail terrain, details about registration, event schedule, and post-race activities.

description: Brăila 10K is a running race organized in Monument Park in Brăila, on April 19, 2026, offering an energizing and friendly experience for runners of all ages. The event includes races of 10.5 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, children's races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal record on a fast and well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes, and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of movement and outdoor health. Organizers emphasize safety and smooth conduct of the competition, with volunteers and referees present on the course.
course_highlights: Fast course of 10.5 km, 7 km, and 3.5 km through Monument Park
Well-marked routes supervised by referees and volunteers
1.5 km Family Fun Run for the whole family
additional: Kit pickup is on Saturday, April 18, 2026, at Braila Mall between 10:30 and 19:00, and on Sunday, April 19, 2026, at the tent in the start/finish area. There is baggage check for the competitive races and the Family Fun Run. The Family Fun Run is non-competitive and accessible to everyone. Start times for children's races are separated by age categories. No registrations are accepted on race day for the competitive events. The event includes warm-up sessions with specialized instructors before the starts. Participants can receive medals, prizes, and surprises, and the event features activities for the entire family. Details about the course and registration are available on the official website.
